reference: 观赛:利物浦队的丹尼尔·斯图里奇( Daniel Sturridge) 一脚远射逼平切尔西队

source: Daniel Sturridge saved Liverpool from a Premier League loss to Chelsea with a score in the 89th minute on Saturday at Stamford Bridge in London.
reference: 周六，在伦敦“斯坦福桥“球场举行的 有一场英超联赛，利物浦对阵切尔西，丹尼尔·斯图里奇在第 89分钟打入一球，挽救了利物浦队。

source: Sturridge received a pass from Xherdan Shaqiri while about 30 yards out from the Chelsea goal with his team trailing 1-0.
reference: 斯图里奇在距离切尔西队球门大约 30 码处接到沙奇里( Xherdan Shaqiri)的传球， 此前利物浦队0:1落后。

source: He tapped the ball to his left before scooping a shot toward the far post.
reference: 他将球轻拨到身体左侧后，对着远处门柱一脚吊射。

source: The attempt sailed high above the box as it drifted toward the right top corner of the net.
reference: 此次射门高高越过禁区，直奔球门右上角而去。

source: The ball eventually dropped over a leaping Kepa Arrizabalaga and fell into the net.
reference: 球最终穿过跃起的阿里萨巴拉加（Kepa Arrizabalaga）的十指应声入网。

source: "It was just trying to get into that position, to get on the ball and players like Shaq always play it forward as much as possible, so I just tried to create myself as much time as possible," Sturridge told LiverpoolFC.com.
reference: "我正好要到那个位置接球，像Shaq这样的球员总是会尽可能地往前带球，因此我刚好要为自己争取尽可能多的时间，" 斯图里奇告诉 LiverpoolFC.com。

source: "I saw Kante coming and took one touch and didn't think about it too much and just took the shot on."
reference: "我看到Kante 冲过来，就垫了一下球，不假思索地就射门了。“

source: Chelsea led 1-0 at halftime after getting a score in the 25th minute from Belgian star Eden Hazard.
reference: 比利时球星埃登·哈扎德（Eden Hazard）在第25分钟打进一球，上半场切尔西队1:0 领先。

source: The Blues striker heeled a pass back to Mateo Kovacic on that play, before spinning off near midfield and sprinting into the Liverpool half.
reference: 蓝军射手中场附近转身直奔利物浦队中场后，脚后跟把球回传给马特奥·科瓦西奇 （ Mateo Kovacic）。

source: Kovacic did a quick give-and-go at midfield.
reference: 科瓦西奇在中场拨球给队友，摆脱防守，再接球前进。

source: He then fired a beautiful through ball, leading Hazard into the box.
reference: 然后一脚妙传，哈扎德紧跟突入禁区。

source: Hazard outran the defense and finished into the far post netting with a left footed shot past Liverpool's Alisson Becker.
reference: 哈扎德快速摆脱防守队员，左脚射门，足球穿过利物浦队球门员阿利松·贝克尔（Alisson Becker）的十指关，应声直入球门。

source: Liverpool battles Napoli in the group stage of the Champions League at 3 p.m. on Wednesday at Stadio San Paolo in Naples, Italy.
reference: 周三下午三点，利物浦队将在“欧洲冠军杯”小组阶段在意大利那不勒斯San Paolo球场迎战那不勒斯队。

source: Chelsea faces Videoton in the UEFA Europa Leaguge at 3 p.m. on Thursday in London.
reference: 周四下午三点，切尔西队将在“欧洲联赛”在伦敦迎战维迪奥顿队。

source: Police arrest man, 32, on suspicion of murder after woman is stabbed to death
reference: 女子被刀捅死后，警察逮捕了一名涉嫌谋杀的32岁男子

source: A murder investigation has been launched after woman's body was found in Birkenhead, Merseyside this morning.
reference: 今天早晨在Merseyside Birkenhead 发现了该女子尸首后，已展开了谋杀调查。

source: The 44-year-old was found at 7.55am with stab wounds on Grayson Mews on John Street, with a 32-year-old man being arrested on suspicion of murder.
reference: 早上 7:55 在John 大街的 Grayson Mews 发现该名女子（ 44 岁），身上有刀伤，一名 32 岁男子涉嫌谋杀被拘捕。

source: Police have urged people in the area who saw or heard anything to come forward.
reference: 警察已敦促该地区居民挺身而出，提供相关线索。

source: Detective Inspector Brian O'Hagan said: 'The investigation is in the early stages but I would appeal to anyone who was in the vicinity of John Street in Birkenhead who saw or heard anything suspicious to contact us.
reference: 探长 Brian O'Hagan 说:“案件调查还在开始阶段，但我呼吁在Birkenhead 的John 大街附近发现可疑线索的任何人与我们取得联系。

source: I would also appeal to anyone, particularly taxi drivers, who may have captured anything on dashcam footage to contact us as they may have information which is vital to our investigation.'
reference: 我还将呼吁任何人，如果可以提供对于我们调查至关重要的信息的话，可与我们联系，尤其是出租车司机，因为他们可能可以从其行车记录仪中获取任何线索。”

source: A police spokesman has confirmed the woman whose body was found is local to Birkenhead and she was found inside a property.
reference: 警方发言人已确认，该名女子是 Birkenhead 本地人，其尸首是在一处房子里找到的。

source: This afternoon friends who believe they know the woman have arrived at the scene to ask questions about where she was found this morning.
reference: 今天下午，自认为是该女子的朋友们到达了犯罪现场，询问了一些关于今早是在哪里找到该名女子尸首的问题。

source: Investigations are ongoing as police have said they are in the process of informing the victim's next of kin.
reference: 犯罪调查正在进行当中，警方已经表示他们正在通知受害人的直系亲属。

source: A taxi driver who lives in Grayson Mews has just tried to get back into his flat but is being told by police no one is allowed in or out of the building.
reference: 一位居住在 Grayson Mews的出租车司机刚设法回到其住处，但被警察告知任何人不得进入该大楼。

source: He was speechless when he discovered what happened.
reference: 他发现有情况后，无言以对。

source: Residents are now being told it will be hours until they are allowed back in.
reference: 居民被告知还要几个小时才能进入。

source: A police officer was heard telling one man that the entire area is now being treated as a crime scene.
reference: 据闻一名警官告诉一名男人，整个区域目前被视为犯罪现场。

source: A woman appeared at the scene in tears.
reference: 一名出现在现场的女子流着泪。

source: She keeps repeating 'it's so awful'.
reference: 她一直反复在说“太可怕了”。

source: At 2pm two police vans were inside the cordon with another van just outside.
reference: 下午二点，封锁区内有两辆警备车，另一辆警备车停在封锁区外。

source: A number of officers were stood inside the cordon monitoring the block of flats.
reference: 封锁区有众多警官在检查公寓。

source: Anyone with information is asked to DM @MerPolCC, call 101 or contact Crimestoppers anonymously on 0800 555 111 quoting log 247 of 30th September.
reference: 有知情人可通过 DM @MerPolCC, 或拨打 101 或匿名拨打”阻止犯罪"热线 0800 555 111 ，联系时请引述九月三十日的第 247 号日志。

source: Hurricane Rosa's remnants to bring widespread heavy rain to southwest US
reference: 飓风“罗莎”余威致美国西南部大范围暴雨

source: As forecast, Hurricane Rosa is weakening as it moves over the cooler waters of the northern coast of Mexico.
reference: 据预测，随着飓风“罗莎”行进至墨西哥北部海岸温度较低水域，其强度将变弱。

source: However, Rosa will bring flooding rains across northern Mexico and the southwest U.S. over the coming days.
reference: 不过，“罗莎”将在未来几天会给整个墨西哥北部地区以及美国西南地区带来暴雨。

source: Rosa had winds of 85 mph, a Category 1 Hurricane, as of 5 a.m. Eastern time Sunday, and was located 385 miles southwest of Punta Eugenia, Mexico.
reference: 截至早上 5 点。“罗莎”风速达到 85 mph, 为一级飓风。周日东部时间，它位于墨西哥 Punta Eugenia 西南 385 英里处。

source: Rosa is expected to move north on Sunday.
reference: 预期“罗莎”将周日向北行进

source: Meanwhile, a trough is beginning to take shape over the Pacific Ocean and move east toward the West Coast of the U.S. As Rosa approaches the Baja California peninsula on Monday as a tropical storm it will begin to push deep tropical moisture northward into the southwest U.S.
reference: 同时在太平洋将开始形成一低压槽，向东向美国西海岸行进。随着“罗莎”作为热带风暴“周一靠近下加州半岛，它将开始向北方向将热带水汽纵深推向美国西南部地区。

source: Rosa will bring up to 10 inches of rain in parts of Mexico on Monday.
reference: 周一，“罗莎”将会使墨西哥部分地区的降水最多可达 10 英寸。

source: Then, tropical moisture interacting with the approaching trough will create widespread heavy rainfall in the Southwest over the coming days.
reference: 这样今后几天，热带水汽与靠近的低压槽共同作用，将使西南大部分地区会有强降雨。

source: Locally, 1 to 4 inches of rain will cause dangerous flash flooding, debris flows and possibility landslides in the desert.
reference: 局部 1 至 4 英寸的降雨将会造成洪水暴涨，泥石流，并且可能在沙漠地区发生滑坡，情况会很危险。

source: Deep tropical moisture will cause rainfall rates to approach 2 to 3 inches per hour in spots, especially in parts of southern Nevada and Arizona.
reference: 热带深层水汽将会造成局部，尤其是内华达州和亚利桑那州南部部分地区每小时的降雨量接近 2 至 3 英寸。

source: As much as 2 to 4 inches of rain is expected in parts of the Southwest, especially over much of Arizona.
reference: 预期西南地区，尤其是亚利桑那州的大部分地区会有 2 至 4 英寸的降雨。

source: Flash flooding is possible with rapidly deteriorating conditions due to the scattered nature of tropical rain.
reference: 由于热带雨的分散性，随着雨情急剧恶化，可能会发生洪水暴涨。

source: It would be extremely ill advised to venture out into the desert on foot with the threat of tropical rainfall.
reference: 受热带降雨的影响，步行前往该沙漠地区将会是极不明智的做法。

source: Heavy rain could cause canyons to become raging rivers and thunderstorms will bring locally gusty winds and blowing dust.
reference: 大雨可能导致山谷成为汹涌的河流，雷暴会带来局部阵风和飞尘。

source: The approaching trough will bring some locally heavy rain to parts of the Southern California coastline.
reference: 低压槽临近，将会给加州南部海岸线部分地区带来一定程度的局部大雨。

source: Rainfall totals of over half an inch are possible, which could cause minor debris flows and slick roadways.
reference: 总降雨量可能会超过半英寸，这可能会造成较小程度的泥石流并导致道路湿滑。

source: This would be the region's first rainfall of their wet season.
reference: 这将是该地区雨季的首场降雨。

source: Some scattered tropical rain showers will begin to approach Arizona late Sunday and early Monday, before the rain becomes more widespread late Monday and Tuesday.
reference: 周日晚间及周一早间，一些零星的热带阵雨将开始造访亚利桑那州，周一晚间和周二，降雨范围将会更广。

source: Heavy rain will spread into the Four Corners on Tuesday and last through Wednesday.
reference: 周二，大雨将会扩散至Four Corners ，并持续到周三。

source: October can see some intense temperature swings across the U.S. as the Arctic gets cooler, but the tropics remain quite warm.
reference: 由于北极地区日渐凉爽，整个美国十月份温度可能会有一些急剧波动的情况发生，但热带地区仍旧相当暖和。

source: Sometimes this leads to dramatic changes in temperature over short distances.
reference: 这有时会导致短距离内的温度发生急剧的变化。

source: There is a great example of dramatic temperature differences through the central U.S. on Sunday.
reference: 周日整个美国中部的温差巨大就是明证。

source: There is nearly a 20-degree temperature difference between Kansas City, Missouri, and Omaha, Nebraska, and between St. Louis and Des Moines, Iowa.
reference: 密苏里州的肯萨斯与内布拉斯州的奥哈马以及爱荷华州的圣路易斯与得梅因之间的温差将近 20 度。

source: Over the next few days, lingering summer warmth will try to build and expand again.
reference: 今后几天，迟迟不去的温暖夏季将再次蓄势、席卷而来。

source: Much of the central and eastern U.S. is expected to see a warm start to October with widespread 80s from the Southern Plains to parts of the Northeast.
reference: 预计十月份，美国中部和东部的很多地区开始变暖，从南部平原到东北部分地区的温度会普遍达到80华氏度。

source: New York City could reach 80 degrees on Tuesday, which would be approximately 10 degrees above average.
reference: 周二，纽约市温度可能达到 80 华氏度，这将比平均温度高出大约 10 度。

source: Our long term climate forecast is indicating high chances for above-average temperatures for the eastern U.S. through the first half of October.
reference: 我们长期的天气预报显示，美国东部十月份的上半个月的温度极有可能出现高于平均温度的情况。

source: More than 20 million people watched Brett Kavanaugh hearing
reference: 超过 2000 万人收看了卡瓦诺（Brett Kavanaugh）性侵听证会

source: More than 20 million people watched Thursday's gripping testimony by Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh and the woman who accused him of a sexual assault that allegedly occurred in the 1980s, Christine Blasey Ford, on six television networks.
reference: 周四，超过 2000万人通过六套电视网络收看了高院提名人卡瓦诺与一名女子为各自辩护的听证会，场面扣人心弦。该名女子叫克里斯汀·布莱西·福特 （Christine Blasey Ford），她指控卡瓦诺，据称是在上世纪八十年代对其实施了性侵犯，

source: Meanwhile, the political standoff continued, with broadcasters interrupting regular programming for Friday's last-minute twist: an agreement engineered by Arizona Sen. Jeff Flake for the FBI to conduct a one-week investigation of the charges.
reference: 同时政治僵局还在继续，广播公司中断了正常播放的节目，插播了紧要关头的大逆转消息：经亚利桑那州参议员杰夫·弗雷克促成，同意 FBI 对该指控进行为期一周的调查。

source: Ford told the Senate Judiciary Committee that she's 100 percent certain that Kavanaugh groped her drunkenly and tried to take off her clothes at a high school party.
reference: 福特告诉“参议院司法委员会”，她百分之百确定卡瓦诺在高中的一次聚会上酒醉后对她进行了猥亵，并试图脱掉她的衣服。

source: Kavanaugh, in impassioned testimony, said he's 100 percent certain that it didn't happen.
reference: 卡瓦诺则在其证言中满怀激动地表示其百分之百确定没有发生过这种事情。

source: It's likely that more than the 20.4 million people reported by Nielsen on Friday watched it.
reference: 据尼尔森公司报道，周五可能超过 2040 万人收看了这场听证会。

source: The company was counting average viewership on CBS, ABC, NBC, CNN, Fox News Channel and MSNBC.
reference: 该公司正在统计 CBS、ABC、NBC、CNN、Fox 新闻频道以及 MSNBC 的平均收视率.

source: Figures weren't immediately available for other networks that showed it, including PBS, C-SPAN and the Fox Business Network.
reference: 其他电视网络，其中包括 PBS、C-SPAN 和 Fox Business Network 也播放了听证会，但其收视率还未及时统计出来。

source: And Nielsen usually has some trouble measuring people who watch in offices.
reference: 通常尼尔森公司统计在办公室收看的收视率时会有些棘手。

source: To put that in perspective, that's an audience size similar to that for a playoff football game or the Academy Awards.
reference: 也就是说，那是类似于 美式足球季后赛或奥斯卡奖的观众人数。

source: Fox News Channel, whose opinion hosts have strongly backed Kavanaugh's appointment, led all networks with an average of 5.69 million viewers during the all-day hearing, Nielsen said.
reference: 尼尔森表示，Fox 新闻频道在全天听证会期间的平均观众人数为 569 万，在全部电视网络中位列第一，其观点主持人强烈支持对卡瓦诺的任命。

source: ABC was second with 3.26 million viewers.
reference: ABC 位列第二，其收视观众为326万。

source: CBS had 3.1 million, NBC had 2.94 million, MSNBC had 2.89 million and CNN had 2.52 million, Nielsen said.
reference: CBS 为 310 万、NBC 为 294万、 MSNBC 为 289万、 CNN 为 252 万。

source: Interest remained high after the hearing.
reference: 听证会后人们依然兴趣高涨。

source: Flake was the central figure in Friday's drama.
reference: 弗雷克（Flake）是周五戏剧性的听证会的中心人物。

source: After the moderate Republican's office issued a statement that he would be voting in favor of Kavanaugh, he was caught be CNN and CBS cameras Friday morning being shouted at by protesters as he tried to ride an elevator to a Judiciary Committee hearing.
reference: 这位温和的共和党议员的办公室发表申明，表示其将投票支持卡瓦诺后，CNN 和 CBS 电视台的摄像头捕捉到周五早晨其在试图乘坐通往“司法委员会”的电梯时被抗议者叫嚷。

source: He stood with eyes downcast for several minutes as he was berated, televised live on CNN.
reference: CNN 电视直播拍摄到，他在遭到责骂时呆呆地站着，眼睛低垂了几分钟。

source: "I'm standing right here in front of you," one woman said.
reference: “我就站在你前面，"一位女人说。

source: "Do you think he's telling the truth to the country?
reference: “你认为他对全国人说了实话吗?

source: He was told, "you have power when so many women are powerless.""
reference: 他被告知，“那么多女人无能为力，而你大权在握。””

source: Flake said that his office had issued a statement and said, before the elevator closed, that he would have more to say at the committee hearing.
reference: Flake 表示其办公室已发表申明，并在电梯关闭之前说，他在司法委员会听证会上有更多话要说。

source: The cable and broadcast networks were all covering live hours later, when the Judiciary Committee was to vote to advance Kavanaugh's nomination to the full Senate for a vote.
reference: 有线电视和广播网络进行了数小时直播后，司法委员将要投票表决是否将卡瓦诺的提名向参议院提交表决。

source: But Flake said he would only do so with the understanding that the FBI would look into the allegations against the nominee for the next week, which minority Democrats have been urging.
reference: 但弗雷克表示，他只能这样做，因为他知道，参议院少数派民主党一直在敦促调查对候选人的指控，因此FBI 下周将会调查对候选人的指控。

source: Flake was convinced in part by conversations with his friend, Democratic Sen. Chris Coons.
reference: 弗雷克与其好友民主党参议员库恩斯（Chris Coons ）的几番交谈后，一定程度上坚定了他的决定。

source: After a conversation with Coons and several senators afterwards, Flake made his decision.
reference: 与库恩斯 以及后来与几位参议员的谈话后，弗雷克作出了决定。

source: Flake's choice had power, because it was evident Republicans would not have the votes to approve Kavanaugh without the investigation.
reference: 弗雷克的选择具有影响力，因为共和党不会不调查对卡瓦诺的指控就投票批准任命他，这是显而易见的事情。

source: President Trump has opened an FBI investigation into the allegations against Kavanaugh.
reference: 特朗普总统已批准 FBI介入对卡瓦诺指控的调查。

source: British PM May accuses critics of 'playing politics' over Brexit
reference: 英国首相特雷莎·梅指责反对者在英国脱欧问题上“玩弄政治”。

source: Prime Minister Theresa May accused critics of her plans to leave the European Union of "playing politics" with Britain's future and undermining the national interest in an interview with the Sunday Times newspaper.
reference: 首相特雷莎·梅在接受“星期日泰晤士报”采访时指责其脱欧计划的反对者利用英国的未来“玩弄政治” ，并损害国家利益。

source: Britain's Prime Minister Theresa May arrives for the Conservative Party Conference in Birmingham, Britain, September 29, 2018.
reference: 英国首相特雷莎·梅于 2018 年 9月 29 日抵达英国伯明翰参加“保守党大会”。

source: In another interview next to the one with her on the newspaper's front page, her former foreign minister Boris Johnson pressed his attack of her so-called Chequers plan for Brexit, saying a proposal that Britain and the EU should collect each other's tariffs was "entirely preposterous."
reference: 在紧挨着该新闻报纸头版登载了英国首相特雷莎·梅的访谈一文的另一篇访谈中，其前外交部长鲍里斯·约翰逊进一步抨击其所谓的脱欧契克斯方案，表示英国和欧盟应相互征收关税的提案“完全是无稽之谈”。

source: Wayde Sims shooting: Police arrest suspect Dyteon Simpson in LSU player's death
reference: Wayde Sims 枪击案：警方逮捕了 LSU 球员之死的嫌疑人 Dyteon Simpson

source: Police have arrested a suspect in the fatal shooting death of Wayde Sims, a 20-year-old basketball player at LSU.
reference: 警方逮捕了Wayde Sims 致命枪击致死的嫌疑犯，20岁的Wayde Sims 是 LSU 篮球队球员。

source: Dyteon Simpson, 20, has been arrested and booked into prison on a second-degree murder charge, the Baton Rouge Police Department said.
reference: Baton Rouge 警察局表示，Dyteon Simpson（20岁）因受二级谋杀指控已被逮捕入狱。

source: Officials released video of the confrontation between Sims and Simpson, and police said Sims lost his glasses during the fight.
reference: 官方发布了 Sims 与 Simpson 对峙的视频，警方说 Sims 在打斗中丢了眼镜。

source: Police recovered the glasses from the scene and said they found Simpson's DNA on them, CBS affiliate WAFB reports.
reference: 据 CBS 的子公司 WAFB 报道，警方在现场找到了眼镜，并表示他们在眼镜上发现了 Simpson 的 DNA。

source: After questioning Simpson, police said he admitted to fatally shooting Wayde.
reference: 警方表示，Simpson 经质问后，承认枪杀了 Wayde。

source: His bond has been set at $350,000, the Advocate reports.
reference: 据《倡导者》（Advocate） 报道，其保释金为 35 万美元。

source: The East Baton Rouge Parish Coroner's Office released a preliminary report Friday, saying the cause of death is a gunshot wound to the head into the neck.
reference: “East Baton Rouge 教区法医办公室”周五发布了初步报告，表示 Wayde 的死亡是从头部至颈部的枪伤造成的。

source: The department is crediting the Louisiana State Police fugitive task force, the state police crime lab, Southern University police and area citizens in assisting in the investigation leading to the arrest.
reference: 警察局对于协助调查，助其逮捕嫌疑犯的路易斯安那州警察局逃犯特别工作组、州警察局犯罪实验室、南方大学警方以及周边公民予以了表扬。

source: LSU athletic director Joe Alleva thanked area law enforcement for its "diligence and pursuit of justice."
reference: LSU 的体育运动总监 Joe Alleva 对地区执法部门“恪尽职守、寻求正义”予以了感谢。

source: Sims was 20 years old.
reference: Sims 时年 20 岁。

source: The 6-foot-6 forward grew up in Baton Rouge, where his father, Wayne, also played basketball for LSU.
reference: 这位身高6.6英尺的前锋在巴吞鲁日(Baton Rouge)长大，其父亲Wayne也曾效力于 LSU。

source: He averaged 5.6 points and 2.6 rebounds a game last season.
reference: 上个赛季，他平均每场得 5.6 分，2.6个篮板球。

source: On Friday morning, LSU basketball coach Will Wade said the team is "devastated" and "in shock" by Wayde's death.
reference: 周五早晨，LSU 篮球队教练 Will Wade 表示球队因 Wayde 的死而“伤心欲绝”，而且“极度震惊”。

source: "This is what you worry about at all times," Wade said.
reference: “这就是你总是要担心的事情，” Wade 说。

source: Volcano spews ash on Mexico City
reference: 火山喷发，火山灰笼罩墨西哥城

source: Ash spewing from the Popocatepetl volcano has reached the southern neighborhoods of Mexico's capital.
reference: 波波卡特佩特（Popocatepetl） 火山喷发的火山灰已飘至墨西哥首都南部邻近地区。

source: The National Center for Disaster Prevention warned Mexicans on Saturday to stay away from the volcano after activity picked up in the crater and it registered 183 emissions of gas and ash over 24 hours.
reference: 火山口喷发火山灰后，“国家灾害预防中心”在 24 小时内记录了 183次气体和火山灰喷发，它警告墨西哥人周六要远离该火山。

source: The center was monitoring multiple rumblings and tremors.
reference: 该中心监测到多起轰鸣声和震动。

source: Images on social media showed thin layers of ash coating car windshields in neighborhoods of Mexico City such as Xochimilco.
reference: 社交媒体的图片显示， 等位于墨西哥城周边地区的小汽车挡风玻璃上覆盖着薄薄一层火山灰。

source: Geophysicists have noticed an increase in activity at the volcano that sits 45 miles (72 kilometers) southeast of the capital since a 7.1-magnitude earthquake rocked central Mexico in September 2017.
reference: 自 2017 年 9 月墨西哥中部发生 7.1 级地震以来，地球物理学家已注意到这座位于首都东南 45 英里（72公里）处的火山的活动在增加。

source: The volcano known as "Don Goyo" has been active since 1994.
reference: 这座称之为 "Don Goyo" 的火山，自 1994 年以来就处于活跃状态。

source: Police clash with Catalan separatists ahead of independence vote anniversary
reference: 独立投票周年纪念之前，警察与加泰罗利亚分裂分子发生冲突

source: Six people were arrested in Barcelona on Saturday after pro-independence protesters clashed with riot police, and as thousands joined rival demonstrations to mark the first anniversary of Catalonia's polarizing vote on secession.
reference: 支持独立的抗议者与防暴警察发生冲突后，并随着千人加入反抗示威游行，纪念加泰罗尼亚一边倒支持独立一周年，周六在巴塞罗那有 6 人被逮捕。

source: A group of masked pro-separatists held back by riot police pelted them with eggs and hurled powder paint, creating dark clouds of dust in streets that would usually be thronged with tourists.
reference: 一群受到防暴警察阻拦的蒙面的支持独立的分裂分子向防暴警察投掷鸡蛋，猛投粉末涂料，使得原本通常到处是游客的街道尘土遮天。

source: Scuffles also broke out later in the day with police using their batons to contain the fighting.
reference: 当天晚些时候还发生了混战，警察使用警棍控制 打斗局面。

source: Over several hours pro-independence groups chanting "No forgetting, no forgiveness" faced off with unionist protesters shouting, "Long live Spain."
reference: 数小时内，支持独立的团体高喊“绝不遗忘、绝不原谅”，与大喊“西班牙万岁”的支持统一的抗议者相对峙。

source: Fourteen people received treatment for minor injuries received in the protests, local press reported.
reference: 据本地新闻报道，抗议中有 14 人因轻伤接受了救治。

source: Tensions remain high in the independence-minded region a year after the October 1 referendum deemed illegal by Madrid but celebrated by separatist Catalans.
reference: 一年前的 10 月 1 日全民公投被西班牙政府视为非法，但加泰罗尼亚分裂分子却加以庆祝，如今亲独立地区的紧张局势依然高涨。

source: Voters chose overwhelmingly to become independent, though turnout was low with those against secession largely boycotting the vote.
reference: 选民一边倒地选择独立，尽管投票率低，反对分裂的人大多都抵制了此次投票。

source: According to Catalan authorities almost 1000 people were injured last year after police tried to stop the vote going ahead at polling stations across the region in violent clashes.
reference: 根据加泰罗尼亚当局的统计，去年警方试图阻止整个地区的投票站的投票后，有将近 1000 人在暴力冲突中受伤。

source: Pro-independence groups had camped out overnight on Friday to prevent a demonstration in support of the national police.
reference: 支持独立的团体周五整夜在外安营扎寨，以阻止支持国家警察当局行动的示威游行。

source: The demonstration went ahead but was forced to take a different route.
reference: 示威游行继续进行，但被迫采取不同的游行路线。

source: Narcis Termes, 68, an electrician attending the separatist protest with his wife said he was no longer hopeful about the prospects of Catalonia gaining independence.
reference: 68 岁的Narcis Termes 是一名电工，他与妻子参加了分裂分子抗议，他表示，对于加泰罗尼亚独立前景，他不再抱希望。

source: "Last year we lived through one of our best moments.
reference: “去年我们度过了我们最美好的时刻之一。

source: I watched my parents cry with joy at being able to vote but now we are stuck," he said.
reference: 我看到我父母因听到可以投票喜极而泣的样子，但现在我们却不知所措，”他说。

source: Despite managing a vital if narrow victory in regional elections last December, Catalan pro-independence parties have struggled to retain momentum this year with many of their best known leaders either in self imposed exile or in detention awaiting trial for their role in organizing the referendum and subsequent declaration of independence.
reference: 加泰罗尼亚支持独立的党派尽管在去年十二月的地区选举中取得了至关重要的微弱胜利，但它们今年已疲于保持高昂势头，因为其众多知名的领袖，由于组织了全民公投以及后续的宣布独立，因此不是自我放逐，就是在押，等待受审。

source: Joan Puig, a 42-year-old mechanic recording the protest in support of the police on his phone, said the conflict had been stoked by politicians on both sides.
reference: 42 岁的Joan Puig 是一名机械师，他用手机录制了支持警方的抗议行动。他表示，双方的政治家煽动了此次冲突。

source: "It's getting more and more tense," he said.
reference: “形势越来越紧张”，他说。

source: On Saturday, Oriol Junqueras, one of nine Catalan leaders in pre-trial jail since late last year, announced he would run in European Parliament elections next year.
reference: Oriol Junqueras 是九名自去年年底预审入狱的加泰罗尼亚领袖之一，周六，他宣布其明年将参加“欧洲议会”选举。

source: "Standing as a candidate for the European elections is the best way to denounce the regression in democratic values and repression we have seen from the Spanish government," he said.
reference: “参加欧洲议会选举是谴责民主价值倒退以及西班牙政府镇压的最佳方式，”他说。

source: Erdogan get mixed reception in Cologne
reference: 科隆以不同方式接待埃尔多安

source: There were smiles and blue skies on Saturday (September 29) as the leaders of Turkey and Germany met for breakast in Berlin.
reference: 周六（9月29日）的柏林蓝天白云，到处洋溢着欢歌笑语，土耳其与德国领导人相约早餐会。

source: It's the last day of President Erdogan's controversial visit to Germany - which is aimed at repairing relations beteen the NATO allies.
reference: 这是土耳其总统埃尔多安出访德国的最后一天，这次旨在修复两个北约盟国之间的关系的访问颇具争议。

source: They've fallen out over issues including human rights, press freedom and Turkey's accession to the EU.
reference: 两国在包括人权、新闻自由以及土耳其加入欧盟在内的问题上闹翻。

source: Erdogan then headed for Cologne to open a giant new mosque.
reference: 埃尔多安于是前往科隆，为新落成的大型清真寺揭幕。

source: The city is home to the largest Turkish population outside Turkey.
reference: 科隆是土耳其境外的土耳其人口最多的城市。

source: Police cited security reasons to block a 25,000-strong crowd from gathering in front of the mosque, but plenty of supporters turned out nearby to see their president.
reference: 警方以安全为由阻止25000多人在清真寺前集会，但是大量的支持者在附近欢迎其总统。

source: Hundreds of anti-Erdogan protesters - many of them Kurdish - also made their voices heard, condemning both Erdogan's policies and the German government's decision to welcome him to the country.
reference: 几百个反埃尔多安的抗议者 - 其中有很多库尔德人 - 也发表了他们的意见，对埃尔多安的政策以及德国政府欢迎其访问该国的决定予以了谴责。

source: The dueling protests reflect the divisiveness of a visitor hailed as a hero by some German Turks and reviled as an autocrat by others.
reference: 双方明争暗斗的抗议活动反映出了彼此的分歧所在，一些德籍土耳其人将埃尔多安称作英雄，而被其他人痛斥为独裁者。

source: Deptford road crash: Cyclist dies in collision with car
reference: 德特福德发生交通事故:骑车人与小轿车相撞后身亡

source: A cyclist has died in a collision involving a car in London.
reference: A 伦敦骑车人与小轿车相撞后身亡。

source: The crash happened near the junction of Bestwood Street and Evelyn Street, a busy road in Deptford, in the south-east of the city, at about 10:15 BST.
reference: 此次交通事故发生在 Bestwood 街与Evelyn 街的交汇处附近，这也是伦敦东南部 Deptford 的一条交通繁忙的道路，事故时间大约为10:15 BST。

source: The driver of the car stopped and paramedics attended, but the man died at the scene.
reference: 小轿车司机（在发生事故后）停车，救护人员也到场抢救，但是该名男子还是死于事故现场。

source: The crash comes months after another cyclist died in a hit-and-run on Childers Street, about a mile away from Saturday's crash.
reference: 周六交通相撞事故发生的几个月前，距离此次事故大约一英里处的Childers街发生了另外一起交通事故，骑车人身亡，肇事者逃逸。

source: The Metropolitan Police said officers were working to identify the man and inform his next-of-kin.
reference: “伦敦警察厅”表示，警察正在核实该名男子身份并通知其直系亲属。

source: Road closures and bus diversions are in place and motorists have been advised to avoid the area.
reference: 该道路已经关闭，公车路线改道，已建议驾车司机避开该区域。

source: Hurricane Rosa Threatening Phoenix, Las Vegas, Salt Lake City With Flash Flooding (Drought Areas May Benefit)
reference: 飓风“罗莎” 来袭，恐造成凤凰城、拉斯维加斯和盐湖城暴雨成灾 (干旱地区可能久逢甘露)

source: It's rare for a tropical depression to hit Arizona, but that's exactly what's likely to happen early happen early next week as Hurricane Rosa's remaining energy tracks across the Desert Southwest, delivering flash flooding risks.
reference: 热带低气压袭击亚利桑那州实属少见，但是下周初可能会发生这一幕，因为飓风“罗莎” 余威将横扫美国西南沙漠，会有暴雨成灾的风险。

source: The National Weather Service has already issued flash flood watches for Monday and Tuesday for western Arizona into southern and eastern Nevada, southeastern California and Utah, including the cities of Phoenix, Flagstaff, Las Vegas, and Salt Lake City.
reference: “国家气象局”已经发布：周一和周二包括凤凰城、旗杆市、拉斯维加斯和盐湖城在内的亚利桑那州西部、内华达州南部和东部、加州东南部以及犹他州可能发生山洪。

source: Rosa is expected to take a direct path over Phoenix on Tuesday, approaching late Monday with rain.
reference: 预期“罗莎”周一晚间裹挟雨水降临凤凰城，周二将径直穿过。

source: The National Weather Service in Phoenix noted in a tweet that only "ten tropical cyclones have maintained tropical storm or depression status within 200 miles of Phoenix since 1950!
reference: 凤凰城“国家气象局” 在推特中提到，“自从 1950 年以来，在凤凰城方圆 200 英里范围内，仅有十次热带气旋维持在热带风暴或低气压状态！

source: Katrina (1967) was a hurricane within 40 miles of the AZ border."
reference: 卡特里娜（Katrina） (1967 年) 是亚利桑那州境内方圆 40 英里范围内的一场飓风。“

source: The latest National Hurricane Center models predict 2 to 4 inches of rainfall, with isolated amounts up to 6 inches in the Mogollon Rim of Arizona.
reference: “国家飓风中心” 的最新模型预测会有 2 至 4 英寸的降雨，亚利桑那州的 Mogollon Rim 单独的降雨量最高可达到 6 英寸。

source: Other areas of the Desert Southwest including the central Rockies and the Great Basin are likely to get 1 to 2 inches, with isolated totals up to 4 inches possible.
reference: 包括“落基山脉”中部和“西部大盆地”在内的“西南沙漠”其他地区可能会有 1 至 2 英寸的降雨量，单独降雨总量最高可达 4 英寸。

source: For those out of flash flood risk, Rosa's rain may be a blessing since the region is drought-stricken.
reference: “罗莎”带来的雨水，对于不会造成山洪的地区来说可能是个福音，因为这些地区干旱少雨。

source: Although flooding is a very serious concern, some of this rainfall will likely be beneficial since the Southwest is currently experiencing drought conditions.
reference: 由于西南地区正在遭受干旱，因此，尽管洪水泛滥是十分严重的问题，但此次降雨将可能有所裨益。

source: According to the U.S. Drought Monitor, just over 40 percent of Arizona is experiencing at least extreme drought, the second highest category," weather.com reported.
reference: 根据“美国干旱监测周报“显示，亚利桑那州刚好超过 40% 的地区正在经历最不严重干旱，属于第二高类别，” weather.com 报道说。

source: First, Hurricane Rosa's path leads to landfall across the Baja California peninsula of Mexico.
reference: 飓风“罗莎”所经过路线首先在整个墨西哥下加州半岛登陆。

source: Rosa, still at hurricane strength Sunday morning with maximum winds of 85 miles per hour, is 385 miles south of Punta Eugenia, Mexico and moving north at 12 miles per hour.
reference: “罗莎”周日早间仍处于飓风强度，最大风力可达每小时 85 英里，目前已到达墨西哥 Punta Eugenia 以南 385 英里处，正以每小时 12 英里的速度向北移动。

source: The storm is encountering cooler waters in the Pacific and therefore powering down.
reference: 暴风雨与太平洋低温水域交锋，从而造成电力中断。

source: Thus, it's expected to make landfall in Mexico at tropical storm strength in the afternoon or evening on Monday.
reference: 预期周一下午或夜间以热带风暴的强度在墨西哥登陆。

source: Rainfall across portions of Mexico could be heavy, posing a significant flooding risk.
reference: 墨西哥部分地区可能会有强降雨，带来严重的洪水泛滥风险。

source: "Rainfall totals of 3 to 6 inches are expected from Baja California into northwestern Sonora, with up to 10 inches possible," weather.com reported.
reference: “预期从下加州到 Sonora 西北部地区总降雨量为 3 至 6 英寸，最高可达 10 英寸，“ weather.com 报道说。

source: Rosa will then track north across Mexico as a tropical storm before reaching the Arizona border in the early morning hours Tuesday as a tropical depression, which will then track up through Arizona and into southern Utah by late Tuesday night.
reference: 此后“罗莎”将一路向北作为热带风暴穿越墨西哥，并将于周二早间以热带低气压抵达亚利桑那州边境，然后一路北上穿越亚利桑那州，于周日晚间进入犹他州南部。

source: "The main hazard expected from Rosa or its remnants is very heavy rainfall in Baja California, northwestern Sonora, and the U.S. Desert Southwest," the National Hurricane Center said.
reference: " 预期“罗莎”或其余威带来的主要危害是下加州索诺拉西北部以及美国“西南沙漠”地区会有强降雨," “国家飓风中心”表示。

source: These rains are expected to produce life-threatening flash flooding and debris flows in the deserts, and landslides in mountainous terrain.
reference: 预期这些降雨会在沙漠地区产生危及生命的山洪和泥石流，在山区会造成滑坡。

source: Midsomer Norton attack: Four attempted murder arrests
reference: 米德索莫诺顿（Midsomer Norton） 袭击事件:四次谋杀未遂犯被捕

source: Three teenage boys and a 20-year-old man have been arrested on suspicion of attempted murder after a 16-year-old was found with stab wounds in Somerset.
reference: 萨默塞特郡（Somerset） 一 16 岁少年被捅伤，三名十几岁男孩和一名 20 岁男子涉嫌谋杀未遂被捕。

source: The teenage boy was found injured in the Excelsior Terrace area of Midsomer Norton, at about 04:00 BST on Saturday.
reference: 周六 04:00 BST左右， 在米德索莫诺顿 的Excelsior Terrace 地区发现一名十几岁受伤男孩。

source: He was taken to hospital where he remains in a "stable" condition.
reference: 他被送往了医院，目前病情保持“稳定”。

source: A 17-year-old, two 18-year-olds and a 20-year-old man were arrested overnight in the Radstock area, Avon and Somerset Police said.
reference: “埃文郡（Avon）与萨默塞特郡（Somerset）警察局”表示，已在 Radstock 地区连夜逮捕了一名 17 岁，两名 18 岁男孩以及一名 20 岁男子。

source: Officers have appealed for anyone who may have any mobile phone footage of what happened to come forward.
reference: 警方已呼吁手机拍下了事发视频的各方人士提供线索。

source: Hundreds killed by Indonesian quake, tsunami, with toll seen rising
reference: 几百人死于印尼地震、海啸，死亡人数不断攀升

source: At least 384 people were killed, many swept away as giant waves crashed onto beaches, when a major earthquake and tsunami hit the Indonesian island of Sulawesi, authorities said on Saturday.
reference: 当局周六表示，印尼苏拉威西岛发生大地震和海啸，致至少384人死亡，巨浪冲向沙滩，很多人被海浪冲走，

source: Hundreds of people had gathered for a festival on the beach in the city of Palu on Friday when waves as high as six meters (18 feet) smashed onshore at dusk, sweeping many to their deaths and destroying anything in their path.
reference: 周五，几百人聚集在巴鲁市海滩参加节日聚会，然而黄昏时分高达6米（18英尺）的巨浪砸向岸边，很多人被海浪冲跑致死，道路也被损无余。

source: The tsunami followed a 7.5 magnitude earthquake.
reference: 7.5 级地震引发海啸。

source: "When the tsunami threat arose yesterday, people were still doing their activities on the beach and did not immediately run and they became victims," Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, the spokesman for Indonesia's disaster mitigation agency BNPB said in a briefing in Jakarta.
reference: “昨天就存在海啸威胁，但人们仍在海滩上活动，由于没有及时撤离而成为罹难者，"  印尼减灾机构BNPB 的发言人Sutopo Purwo Nugroho在雅加达的情况通报会上说。

source: "The tsunami didn't come by itself, it dragged cars, logs, houses, it hit everything on land," Nugroho said, adding that the tsunami had traveled across the open sea at speeds of 800 kph (497 mph) before striking the shoreline.
reference: "海啸来者不善，它裹挟着汽车、木头、房屋，冲上陆地后如入无人之境" ，Nugroho 说，他补充道，海啸以 800 kph (497 mph)时速横穿公海后冲击海岸线。

source: Some people climbed trees to escape the tsunami and survived, he said.
reference: 他表示，有些人爬树躲过了海啸，逃过一劫。

source: Around 16,700 people were evacuated to 24 centers in Palu.
reference: 大约 16,700 人被疏散到巴鲁的 24 座避难中心。

source: Aerial photographs released by the disaster agency showed many buildings and shops destroyed, bridges twisted and collapsed and a mosque surrounded by water.
reference: 减灾机构发布的航拍图片显示，许多建筑和商店被损，桥梁弯折变形、坍塌，清真寺周围一片泽国。

source: Aftershocks continued to rock the coastal city on Saturday.
reference: 周六，这座沿海城市继续发生余震。

source: The series of earthquakes were felt in an area with 2.4 million people.
reference: 这个有 240 万人口的地区仍在遭受一系列地震。

source: Indonesia's Agency for the Assessment and Application of Technology (BPPT) said in statement the energy released by Friday's massive quake was around 200 times the power of the atomic bomb dropped on Hiroshima in World War Two.
reference: “印尼技术评估与应用署 (BPPT)在一份声明中说，周五大地震所释放的能量为二战时投向广岛的原子弹威力的 200 倍左右。

source: The geography of the city, which sits at the end of a long, narrow bay, could have magnified the size of the tsunami, it said.
reference: 该声明说，该市位于狭长海湾的末端，从而可能放大了海啸的规模。

source: Nugroho described the damage as "extensive" and said thousands of houses, hospitals, shopping malls and hotels had collapsed.
reference: Nugroho 将此次地震描述为破坏性“巨大”，并表示上千栋房屋、医院、购物中心和酒店坍塌。

source: Bodies of some victims were found trapped under the rubble of collapsed buildings, he said, adding 540 people were injured and 29 were missing.
reference: 他说在坍塌建筑的废墟中发现了被困其中的一些罹难者的尸体，并补充说有540人受伤，29人失踪。

source: Nugroho said the casualties and the damage could be greater along the coastline 300 km (190 miles) north of Palu, an area called Donggala, which is closer to the epicenter of the quake.
reference: Nugroho 说巴鲁以北 300公里（190英里）处称之为Donggala的海岸线沿线地区由于更接近震中，因此其伤亡和损失可能会更大。

source: Communications "were totally crippled with no information" from Donggala, Nugroho said.
reference: Nugroho 说，通讯“已完全中断，没有 Donggala 的任何消息“。

source: There are more than 300,000 people living there," the Red Cross said in a statement, adding that its staff and volunteers were heading to the affected areas.
reference: “红十字会”在一份声明中说，“该地区人口超过 30 万人”，并补充说，其工作人员和志愿者正在赶往受影响地区。

source: "This is already a tragedy, but it could get much worse," it said.
reference: “这已经是场灾难，而且情况可能会更糟糕，”申明中说。

source: The agency on Saturday was widely criticized for not informing that a tsunami had hit Palu, though officials said waves had come within the time the warning was issued.
reference: 周六，该机构因未将巴鲁遭到海啸的消息告知民众而受到广泛的批评，尽管官方表示海啸在发出的警示时间内到达。

source: In amateur footage shared on social media a man on the upper floor of a building can be heard shouting frantic warnings of the approaching tsunami to people on the street below.
reference: 社交媒体上业余爱好者拍摄的视频短片显示，一栋建筑楼上的一名男子对着楼下街上的人嘶声裂肺地发出警示，大喊海啸将至。

source: Within minutes a wall of water crashes onto the shore, carrying away buildings and cars.
reference: 几分钟内，水墙冲到岸上，卷走了建筑物和轿车。

source: Reuters was not able to immediately authenticate the footage.
reference: 路透社未能及时证实该短视频的真实性。

source: The quake and tsunami caused a major power outage that cut communications around Palu making it difficult for authorities to coordinate rescue efforts.
reference: 地震和海啸造成电力大面积中断，切断了巴鲁周边的通讯，使当局难以协调救援工作。

source: The military has started sending in cargo planes with aid from Jakarta and other cities, authorities said, but evacuees still badly need food and other basic necessities.
reference: 当局表示，军方开始派出货机从雅加达和其他城市运送救援物资，但是被疏散人员仍急需食品和其他基本的生活必需品。

source: The city's airport has been reopened only for relief efforts and will remain closed until Oct.
reference: 该市机场已重新启用，但仅供灾害救援使用，并将关闭至十月份。

source: President Joko Widodo was scheduled to visit evacuation centers in Palu on Sunday.
reference: 佐科威多多总统计划周日前往巴鲁的 疏散中心进行视察。

source: Indonesia Tsunami Toll Soars Above 800.
reference: 印尼海啸死亡人数飙升至800 人以上。

source: It Is Very Bad.
reference: 情况十分糟糕。

source: While World Vision's staff from Donggala have made it safely to Palu city, where employees are sheltering in tarpaulin shelters set up in the courtyard of their office, they passed scenes of devastation on the way, Mr. Doseba said.
reference: 尽管Donggala的“世界展望会”工作人员安全抵达巴鲁市（他们的工作人员借宿于在其办公室庭院内搭建的防水帆布住所内），但他们一路经过了灾难现场，Doseba 先生表示。

source: "They told me they saw lots of houses that were destroyed," he said.
reference: “他们告诉我，他们看到了很多房屋受损，” 他说。

source: Even as aid groups began the grim motions of starting the gears of disaster relief, some complained that foreign aid workers with deep expertise were being prevented from traveling to Palu.
reference: 尽管救援组织开始动员启动灾害救援装置，但一些组织抱怨，具有深厚专业技术的外国救援人员前往巴鲁受阻 。

source: According to Indonesian regulations, funding, supplies and staffing from overseas can only start flowing if the site of a calamity is declared a national disaster zone.
reference: 按照印尼法规的规定，只有在灾害地点被宣布为全国灾难区，国外的资金、供给以及人员才能开始流入。

source: That has not happened yet.
reference: 目前这种情况还没有发生。

source: "It's still a province level disaster," said Aulia Arriani, a spokesperson for the Indonesian Red Cross.
reference: “目前仍然属于省级灾害，”“印尼红十字会”发言人Aulia Arriani 说。

source: "Once the government says, "O.K., this is a national disaster," we can open for international assistance but there's no status yet."
reference: “一旦政府表态，“没问题，这是全国性灾难，” 我们就可以为国际援助放行，但现在还没达到这一步。”

source: As the second night fell on Palu after Friday's earthquake and tsunami, friends and family of those still missing were holding out hope that their loved ones would be the miracles that leaven the bleak story lines of natural disasters.
reference: 巴鲁迎来了周五地震和海啸后的第二个夜晚，仍然失踪的人的亲朋好友对他们挚爱的人还抱有希望，希望他们能在自然灾难中创造奇迹。

source: On Saturday, a little boy was plucked from a sewer.
reference: 周六，从下水道中捞出一小男孩。

source: On Sunday, rescuers freed a woman who had been pinned under rubble for two days with the body of her mother next to her.
reference: 周日，救援人员将受困于废墟中两天的一名妇女解救出来，同时还有在她旁边的她母亲的尸首。

source: Gendon Subandono, the coach of the Indonesian national paragliding team, had trained two of the missing paragliders for the Asian Games, which wrapped up earlier this month in Indonesia.
reference: 印尼国家滑翔伞队教练 Gendon Subandono 曾训练过失踪的亚运会滑翔伞队员中的两名队员。亚运会本月初在印尼闭幕。

source: Others of those trapped at the Roa Roa Hotel, Mr. Mandagi included, were his students.
reference: 受困于 Roa Roa 酒店的其他人，包括  Mandagi 先生在内的是他的学生。

source: "As a senior in the paragliding field, I have my own emotional burden," he said.
reference: “作为滑翔伞界的资深人士，我在情绪上要有担当，” 他说。

source: Mr. Gendon recounted how, in the hours after the news of the Roa Roa Hotel collapse circulated among the paragliding community, he had desperately sent WhatsApp messages to the Palu competitors, who were taking part in the beach festival.
reference: Gendon 先生讲述了他在听到 滑翔伞界流传 Roa Roa 酒店坍塌的新闻后的几个小时内是如何迫不及待地给正在巴鲁参加海滩节的参赛者发送 WhatsApp 短信息的。

source: His messages, though, only resulted in one gray check mark, rather than a pair of blue checks.
reference: 然而他发送消息后，只显示一个灰色对勾，而不是双蓝对勾。

source: "I think that means the messages were not delivered," he said.
reference: “我想那就意味着消息没有发送出去，” 他说道。

source: Thieves take $26,750 during ATM refill at Newport on the Levee
reference: 小偷在 Newport on the Levee 餐饮中心乘 ATM 装钞之机偷走 $26,750

source: Thieves on Friday morning stole $26,750 from a Brink's worker refilling an ATM at Newport on the Levee, according to a news release from the Newport Police Department.
reference: 该纽波特（ Newport） 警察局的新闻发布的信息显示，周五早间，小偷在Newport on the Levee 餐饮中心乘 Brink 的工作人员给 ATM装钞之机偷走  $26,750 。

source: The car's driver had been emptying an ATM in the entertainment complex and preparing to deliver more money, Det. Dennis McCarthy wrote in the release.
reference: 轿车司机一直在清空娱乐中心的一台 ATM，并准备塞入更多现金，该警察局的Dennis McCarthy 在新闻发布中说。

source: While he was occupied, another man "ran up from behind the Brink's employee" and stole a bag of money meant for delivery.
reference: 在他忙碌的时候，另一个人“从 Brank 的员工身后跑过”，偷走一包要塞入 ATM 的现金。

source: Witnesses spotted multiple suspects fleeing the scene, according to the release, but police did not specify the number involved in the incident.
reference: 该新闻发布的信息显示，目击者看到多位嫌疑人逃离现场，但是警方还未明确说明涉案嫌疑人的数量。

source: Anyone with information about their identities should contact Newport police at 859-292-3680.
reference: 任何知晓嫌疑人身份信息的人士应拨打纽波特警察局电话 859-292-3680 提供线索。

source: Kanye West: Rapper changes his name to Ye
reference: 坎耶·维斯特（Kanye West）:饶舌歌手更名为 Ye

source: Rapper Kanye West is changing his name - to Ye.
reference: 饶舌歌手坎耶·维斯特更名为 Ye。

source: Announcing the change on Twitter on Saturday, he wrote: "The being formally known as Kanye West."
reference: 周六他在“推特”上宣布了其更名一事，并写道："正式称为坎耶·维斯特。“

source: West, 41, has been nicknamed Ye for some time and used the moniker as the title for his eighth album, which was released in June.
reference: 维斯特,41岁，使用别名Ye已有一段时间，并将其用作他的第八张专辑的名称，该专辑已于六月份发行。

source: The change comes ahead of his appearance on Saturday Night Live, where he is expected to launch his new album Yandhi.
reference: 更名之后，他将现身“周六夜现场”节目，预期届时其将推出新专辑  Yandhi。

source: He replaces singer Ariana Grande on the show who cancelled for "emotional reasons," the show's creator said.
reference: 该节目创作人表示，他取代歌手爱莉安娜·格兰德（ Ariana Grande）参加该节目，因为后者以情感原因取消了参演。

source: As well as being an abbreviation of his current professional name, West has previously said the word has religious significance for him.
reference: 维斯特曾说过，这个字对他来说有宗教意义，而且这个字也是其现在职业名称的缩写。

source: "I believe 'ye' is the most commonly used word in the Bible, and in the Bible it means 'you,'" West said earlier this year, discussing his album title with radio host Big Boy.
reference: "我认为“ye"是圣经中使用的最为普遍的字，它在圣经中是“你”的意思，“维斯特今年年初与广播节目主持人Big Boy 讨论其专辑名称时说。

source: "So I'm you, I'm us, it's us.
reference: “因此我是你，我是我们，它是我们。

source: It went from Kanye, which means the only one, to just Ye - just being a reflection of our good, our bad, our confused, everything.
reference: 它源自坎耶的心声，意味着它是你的唯一，- 反映出了我们的一切，无论好与坏、还是我们的困惑。

source: The album is more of a reflection of who we are."
reference: 该专辑更多表达了我们是谁。“

source: He is one of a number of famous rappers to change their name.
reference: 众多著名饶舌歌手都改了名字，而他是其中之一。

source: Sean Combs has been variously known as Puff Daddy, P. Diddy or Diddy, but this year announced his preference for the names Love and Brother Love.
reference: Sean Combs 有各种名字，Puff Daddy、P. Diddy 或Diddy，但是今年他宣布他对 Love 和 Brother Love 这两个名字偏爱有加。

source: A former West collaborator, JAY-Z, has also made do with or without a hyphen and capitals.
reference: 维斯特以前的一个合作者 JAY-Z 也在名字中加入或不加入连字符和首字母大写。

source: Mexico's AMLO vows not to use military against civilians
reference: 墨西哥总统 AMLO 发誓不使用军事力量对付平民

source: Mexican President-elect Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador has vowed to never use military force against civilians as the country approaches the 50th anniversary of a bloody reprisal against students.
reference: 随着墨西哥血腥报复学生 50 周年的临近，该国当选总统安德烈斯·曼努埃尔·洛佩斯·奥夫拉多尔（ Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador） 发誓绝不使用军事力量对付平民。

source: Lopez Obrador promised Saturday at Tlatelolco Plaza to "never ever use the military to repress the Mexican people."
reference: 洛佩斯·奥夫拉多尔周六在特拉特洛尔科（ Tlatelolco）广场承诺“绝不会再使用军事力量镇压墨西哥人。”

source: Troops fired on a peaceful demonstration at the plaza on Oct. 2, 1968, killing as many as 300 people at a time when leftist student movements were taking root throughout Latin America.
reference: 1968年10月2日，军队对在该广场上和平示威的人群开枪,击毙了300人，是时左翼学生运动在整个拉丁美洲已生根发芽。

source: Lopez Obrador has pledged to support young Mexicans by giving monthly subsidies to those who study and opening more free public universities.
reference: 洛佩斯·奥夫拉多尔承诺每月为学生提供补贴，开设更多免费的公立大学，从而支持年轻的墨西哥人的成长。

source: He has said that unemployment and a lack of educational opportunities draws youth to criminal gangs.
reference: 他表示，失业和缺乏教育机会导致年轻人被犯罪集团所利用。

source: U.S. should double A.I. funding
reference: 美国应加倍投资人工智能

source: As China becomes more active in artificial intelligence, the U.S. should double the amount it spends on research in the field, says investor and AI practitioner Kai-Fu Lee, who has worked for Google, Microsoft and Apple.
reference: 投资家兼AI从业者李开复表示，由于中国日益积极发展人工智能，美国应加倍投资该领域的研究。他曾就职于谷歌、微软和苹果公司。

source: The comments come after various parts of the U.S. government have made AI announcements, even as the U.S. overall lacks a formal AI strategy.
reference: 此番评论之前，美国政府各个部门宣布了 AI 计划，甚至美国总体上还没有制定一个正式的 AI 战略。

source: Meanwhile, China introduced its plan last year: it's aiming to be No.1 in AI innovation by 2030.
reference: 同时，中国在去年推出了计划：目标在 2030年之前成为 AI 创新的领头羊。

source: "Double the AI research budget would be a good start, given that all other countries are so much farther behind U.S., and we're looking for the next breakthrough in AI," said Lee.
reference: "鉴于所有其他国家远远落后于美国，使 AI 研究预算加倍将是个好的开端，我们将寻求 AI 方面的下一个突破，“李开复说。

source: Doubling funding could double the chances that the next big AI achievement will be made in the U.S., Lee told CNBC in an interview this week.
reference: 李开复在本周接受 CNBC 采访时表示，加倍投资可以加倍增加美国在 AI 领域下一个阶段取得重大成就的机会。

source: Lee, whose book "AI Superpowers: China, Silicon Valley and the New World Order" was published this month by Houghton Mifflin Harcourt, is CEO of Sinovation Ventures, which has invested in one of the most prominent AI companies in China, Face++.
reference: 李开复是“创新工场”CEO，该企业投资了Face++，它是中国最为知名的 AI 公司之一。本月霍顿·米夫林·哈考特出版社（Houghton Mifflin Harcourt）出版了李开复的新书《 人工智能超级力量：中国、硅谷及世界新秩序》。

source: In the 1980s at Carnegie Mellon University he worked on an AI system that beat the highest-ranked American Othello player, and later he was an executive at Microsoft Research and president of Google's China branch.
reference: 上世纪 八十年代，他在卡内基梅隆大学开发的 AI 系统打败了美国奥赛罗棋排位最高的棋手，后来他相继担任了“微软研究院”院长以及“谷歌中国”总裁。

source: Lee acknowledged previous U.S. government technology competitions like the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency's Robotics Challenge and asked when the next one would be, in order to help identify the next visionaries.
reference: 李开复感谢美国政府以前举办的“美国国防部先进研究项目局”的“机器人大赛”等技术比赛，并询问何时举办下一届比赛，以助于选拔下一代前瞻者。

source: Researchers in the U.S. often have to work hard in order to win government grants, Lee said.
reference: 李开复表示，美国的研究人员通常需要刻苦努力，才能获得政府资助。

source: "It's not China that is taking away the academic leaders; it's the corporates," Lee said.
reference: “学术带头人不是中国而是公司吸引走的，"李开复说。

source: Facebook, Google and other technology companies have hired luminaries from universities to work on AI in recent years.
reference: 近年来，“脸书”、“谷歌”以及其他技术公司招聘了大学的学术精英从事 AI 研究。

source: Lee said immigration policy changes could also help the U.S. bolster its AI efforts.
reference: 李开复表示，美国移民政策的变化可能也有助于 美国扩大其在 AI 领域的成果。

source: "I think green cards should automatically be offered to PhD's in AI," he said.
reference: "我认为应该自动向 AI 博士提供绿卡，" 他说。

source: China's State Council issued its Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Development Plan in July 2017.
reference: 2017 年 7 月，中国国务院发布了其“下一代人工智能发展计划”。

source: China's National Natural Science Foundation provides funding to people at academic institutions similar to the way that the National Science Foundation and other government organizations dole out money to U.S. researchers, but the quality of academic work is lower in China, Lee said.
reference: 李开复表示，中国“国家自然科学基金委员会”向学术机构人员提供资金，这类似于“美国国家科学基金会”和其他政府组织向美国科研人员发放资金的做法，但是中国的学术工作质量较低。

source: Earlier this year the U.S. Defense Department established a Joint Artificial Intelligence Center, which is meant to involve partners from industry and academia, and the White House announced the formation of Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence.
reference: 今年年初，美国“国防部”建立了“联合人工智能中心”，其旨在使行业和学术合作伙伴参与其中，而且“白宫”宣布组建“人工智能特别委员会”。

source: And this month DARPA announced a $2 billion investment in an initiative called AI Next.
reference: 本月，DARPA 宣布向“下一代人工智能（AI）”计划投资 20 亿美元。

source: As for the NSF, it currently invests more than $100 million per year in AI research.
reference: 目前，NSF 每年向 AI 研究投资超过了 1 亿美元。

source: Meanwhile, U.S. legislation that sought to create a National Security Commission on Artificial Intelligence has not seen action in months.
reference: 同时，美国寻求建立“国家人工智能安全委员会”，但几个月来该方面的立法还未成行。

source: Macedonians vote in referendum on whether to change country's name
reference: 马其顿全民公投决定是否更改国名

source: The people of Macedonia voted in a referendum on Sunday on whether to change its name to "Republic of North Macedonia," a move that would resolve a decades-old dispute with Greece which had blocked its membership bids for the European Union and NATO.
reference: 周日，马其顿人民参加全民公投，决定是否将其国名更改为“北马其顿共和国”，这一举措将会解决其与希腊数十年的争端，希腊曾阻止马其顿成为欧盟和北约成员国。

source: Greece, which has a province called Macedonia, maintains that its northern neighbor's name represents a claim on its territory and has vetoed its entrance into NATO and the EU.
reference: 希腊有一个“马其顿”省，该国坚持认为其北方邻国的国名代表对想要拥有其领土的诉求 ，并且投票反对其加入欧盟和北约。

source: The two governments struck a deal in June based on the proposed new name, but nationalist opponents argue the change would undermine the ethnic identity of Macedonia's Slavic majority population.
reference: 六月，两国政府依据拟议的新国名达成了协议，但是民族主义反对派认为更改国名将有损马其顿人口中占多数的斯拉夫人的民族认同。

source: President Gjorge Ivanov has said he will not be voting in the referendum and a boycott campaign has cast doubts on whether turnout will meet the minimum 50 percent required for the referendum to be valid.
reference: 格奥尔基·伊万诺夫（Gjorge Ivanov） 总统表示，他不会参加全民公投，抵制活动让人怀疑投票率将是否满足对有效全民公投所要求的 50% 的要求。

source: The question on the referendum ballot read: "Are you for NATO and EU membership with acceptance of the agreement with Greece."
reference: 全民公投选票上的问题是："您赞成接受与希腊达成的协议，从而换取成为北约和EU 的成员国吗？“

source: Supporters of the name change, including Prime Minister Zoran Zaev, argue that it is a price worth paying to pursue admission into bodies such as the EU and NATO for Macedonia, one of the countries to emerge from the collapse of Yugoslavia.
reference: 包括佐兰·扎埃夫（Zoran Zaev）总理在内支持更改国名的人认为，这是马其顿加入欧盟和北约等组织值得付出的代价。马其顿是南斯拉夫解体后独立出来的国家之一。

source: "I came today to vote for the future of the country, for young people in Macedonia so they can be live freely under the umbrella of the European Union because it means safer lives for all of us," said Olivera Georgijevska, 79, in Skopje.
reference: “我今天来到这里是为了国家的未来和马其顿的年轻人而投票，这样他们就可以在欧盟的保护伞下自由地生活，因为这意味着我们所有人都可以在更安全的环境下生活，”Skopje 的79岁的Olivera Georgijevska 说。

source: Although not legally binding, enough members of parliament have said they will abide by the vote's outcome to make it decisive.
reference: 尽管不具有法律约束力，但是议会有足够多的成员表示他们将接受投票结果，并使之具有决定性。

source: The name change would requires a two-thirds majority in parliament.
reference: 更改国名需要议会以三分之二绝对多数票通过。

source: The state election commission said there had been no reports of irregularities by 1 p.m.
reference: 国家选举委员会表示，截至下午1点，还未有不法行为的报道。

source: However, turnout stood at only 16 percent, compared to 34 percent in last parliamentary election in 2016 when 66 percent of the registered voters cast their ballot.
reference: 然而相比上一次于 2016 年进行的议会选举的 34% 的投票率（当时66% 的注册选民都参加了投票），此次投票率仅为 16%。

source: "I came out to vote because of my children, our place is in Europe," said Gjose Tanevski, 62, a voter in the capital, Skopje.
reference: "我来这里投票是为了我的孩子们，我们地处欧洲，” 首都Skopje 的一位选民 ，62岁的Gjose Tanevski 说。

source: Macedonia's PM Zoran Zaev, his wife Zorica and his son Dushko cast their ballot for the referendum in Macedonia on changing the country's name that would open the way for it to join NATO and the European Union in Strumica, Macedonia September 30, 2018.
reference: 马其顿总理佐兰·扎埃夫及其妻子 Zorica 和儿子 Dushko参加了马其顿更改国名全民公投，这将为其于 2018 年 9 月 30 日在该国的斯特鲁米察（ strumica）加入北约和欧盟开辟道路。

source: In front of parliament in Skopje, Vladimir Kavardarkov, 54, was preparing a small stage and pulling up chairs in front of tents set up by those who will boycott the referendum.
reference: 54 岁的Vladimir Kavardarkov 正在 Skopje 议会前准备小型舞台并抽出帐篷前的椅子，这个帐篷是将要抵制公投的人搭建的。

source: "We are for NATO and EU, but we want to join with our heads up, not through the service door" Kavadarkov said.
reference: “我们赞同加入北约和欧盟，但是我们想要堂堂正正地而不是通过旁门左道的方式加入” Kavadarkov 说。

source: "We are a poor country, but we do have dignity.
reference: "尽管我们国家很穷，但是我们有自尊。

source: If they don't want to take us as Macedonia, we can turn to others like China and Russia and become part of Euro-Asia integration."
reference: 如果他们不想将我们作为马其顿接纳我们，则我们可以转向中国和俄罗斯等其他国家，并成为欧亚一体化的一部分。“

source: Prime Minister Zaev says NATO membership will bring much needed investment to Macedonia, which has an unemployment rate of more than 20 percent.
reference: 扎埃夫总理 表示，成为北约成员，将会给马其顿带来所需的投资，目前马其顿的失业率超过 20%。

source: "I believe the huge majority will be in favor because more than 80 percent of our citizens are in favor of EU and NATO," Zaev said after casting his ballot.
reference: “我相信绝大数人会赞成更名，因为我们超过 80% 的公民都支持加入欧盟和北约，”扎埃夫 投票后如是说。

source: He said that a "yes" result would be "confirmation of our future."
reference: 他说，“赞成”的结果将“确定我们的未来。“

source: A poll published last Monday by Macedonia's Institute for Policy Research said between 30 and 43 percent of voters would take part in the referendum - below the required turnout.
reference: 上周一“马其顿政策研究所”发布了一项民意调查，其结果显示 30% 至 43% 的选民会参加全民公投- 比有效公投的投票率要低。

source: Another poll, conducted by Macedonia's Telma TV, found 57 percent of respondents planning to vote on Sunday.
reference: 马其顿 Telma 电视台进行的另一项民意调查发现，57% 的调查对象计划周日参加投票。

source: Of those, 70 percent said they would vote yes.
reference: 这其中有 70% 的人表示将投赞成票。

source: For the referendum to be successful turnout needs to be 50 percent plus one vote.
reference: 全民公投要取得成功，投票率需要达到 50% 并另加一票。

source: A failure in the referendum would represent the first serious blow to policy of the pro-Western government since it took over in May last year.
reference: 如果公投失败，将是对亲西方的政府自去年五月掌权以来的政策的首次严重打击。

source: Watch: Manchester City's Sergio Aguero navigates through entire Brighton defense for goal
reference: 观赛:曼城队阿奎罗长驱直入布莱顿队整个后防，射门得分

source: Sergio Aguero and Raheem Sterling dispatched of the Brighton defense in Manchester City's 2-0 win on Saturday at Etihad Stadium in Manchester, England.
reference: 周六在英国曼彻斯特“阿提哈德体育场，曼城队 2:0胜布莱顿队，场上，阿奎罗和斯特林让让对方后防吃紧。

source: Aguero made it look ridiculously easy on his score in the 65th minute.
reference: 阿奎罗在 65 分钟的进球轻松自如。

source: The Argentine striker received a pass at midfield at the start of the sequence.
reference: 阿根廷前锋首先在中场接到传球。

source: He raced between three Brighton defenders, before slashing into the open field.
reference: 他穿梭于布赖顿队后方队员之间，然后快速突破到开阔场地。

source: Aguero then found himself surrounded by four green shirts.
reference: 此时阿奎罗发现自己深陷四名绿色球衣队员包围之中。

source: He pushed around one defender before outrunning several more at the edge of the Brighton box.
reference: 他晃过一名后卫，然后在布赖顿禁区边缘又加速摆脱了几名后卫。

source: He then pushed a pass to his left, finding Sterling.
reference: 然后把球带到其左侧，找到了斯特林。

source: The English forward used his first touch in the box to give the ball back to Aguero, who used his right boot to beat Brighton keeper Mathew Ryan with a shot into the right side of the net.
reference: 这位英国前锋在禁区内一脚回传给阿奎罗，阿奎罗用右脚劲射，突破了布赖顿门将马修·赖恩的十指关，直入球门右侧。

source: "Aguero is struggling with some problems in his feet," City manager Pep Guardiola told reporters.
reference: "阿奎罗正在经受脚伤的困扰，“ 曼城队经理 Pep Guardiola 告诉记者。

source: "We spoke about him playing 55, 60 minutes.
reference: “我们已谈过了他上场踢 55 或 60分钟。

source: That's what happened.
reference: 情况如我们所愿。

source: We were lucky he scored a goal in that moment."
reference: 我们真走运，他就在那个时刻踢进了一球。"

source: But it was Sterling who gave the Sky Blues the initial advantage in the Premier League scuffle.
reference: 但是正是斯特林让曼城队在这场在英超混战中占得先机。

source: That goal came in the 29th minute.
reference: 这粒球是在 29 分钟打进的。

source: Aguero received the ball deep in Brighton territory on that play.
reference: 阿奎罗在布赖顿队腹地接到传球。

source: He sent a beautiful through ball along the left flank to Leroy Sane.
reference: 他送出一个漂亮的直塞球，沿着左翼到了 勒鲁瓦·萨内脚下。

source: Sane took a few touches before leading Sterling toward the far post.
reference: 萨内带球，将斯特林引向远侧门柱。

source: The Sky Blues forward tapped the ball into the net just before sliding out of bounds.
reference: 这位曼城前锋在球就要滑出边界之前将球打入网窝。

source: City battles Hoffenheim in Champions League group play at 12:55 p.m. on Tuesday at Rhein-Neckar-Arena in Sinsheim, Germany.
reference: 周二下午12:55 在德国辛斯海姆Rhein-Neckar体育场，曼城队将在欧洲冠军杯小组赛中迎战霍芬海姆队。

source: Scherzer wants to play spoiler vs. Rockies
reference: Scherzer 意在迎战洛基山队时搅局

source: With the Nationals eliminated from playoff contention, there wasn't much reason to force another start.
reference: 既然“国民队”已从季后赛淘汰出局，也就没有更多原因要重振旗鼓。

source: But the ever-competitive Scherzer hopes to take the mound on Sunday against the Colorado Rockies, but only if there are still playoff implications for the Rockies, who hold a one-game lead over the Los Angeles Dodgers in the NL West.
reference: 而一心求胜的 Scherzer 希望在周日对抗科罗拉多洛基山队的比赛中充当投球手，但条件是季后赛对洛基山队还有影响，该队在 NL West 领先洛杉矶道奇队一场比赛。

source: The Rockies clinched at least a wild-card spot with a 5-2 win over the Nationals on Friday night, but are still looking to lock up their first division title.
reference: 洛基山队周五晚以 5:2 战胜国民队，这样至少取得一张外卡，但是仍然希望保住第一集团头衔。

source: "Even though we're playing for nothing, at least we can be able to toe the rubber knowing that the atmosphere here in Denver with the crowd and the other team would be playing at probably the highest level of any point I would face this year.
reference: “尽管我们为荣誉而战，但至少我们可以感受一下丹佛这里以及观众的气氛，另一只球队可能会发挥出今年我将面对的最高水准。

source: Why wouldn't I want to compete in that?"
reference: 为什么我会不想同场较量一下呢?"

source: The Nationals have yet to announce a starter for Sunday, but are reportedly inclined to let Scherzer pitch in such a situation.
reference: 国民队还没有宣布周日比赛的首发阵容，但据报道，该队会倾向于让 Scherzer 在此情况下投球。

source: Scherzer, who would be making his 34th start, threw a bullpen session on Thursday and would be pitching on his normal rest Sunday.
reference: Scherzer 将会第 34 次首发出场，他在周四进行了一次牛棚试投，周日他将会在正常休息时投球。

source: The Washington right-hander is 18-7 with a 2.53 ERA and 300 strikeouts in 220 2/3 innings this season.
reference: 本赛季，这位华盛顿右手投手在220 2/3 回合中，投出18好球，7坏球 ，自责分率为 2.53 ，以及 300 次出局。

source: Trump rallies in West Virginia
reference: 特朗普在西弗吉尼亚举行的竞选集会

source: The President obliquely referred to the situation surrounding his Supreme Court pick Brett Kavanaugh while talking about the importance of Republican turnout in the midterm elections.
reference: 总统含沙射影地提到了围绕他提名的最高法院大法官候选人卡瓦诺的情况，同时谈到了共和党投票率在中期选举的重要性。

source: "All of what we've done is at stake in November.
reference: “我们的所作所为将对于十一月份至关重要。

source: Five weeks away from one of the most important elections in our lifetimes.
reference: 距离我们一生中最重要的选举之一还有五周时间.

source: This is one of the big, big -- I'm not running but I'm really running that's why I'm all over the place fighting for great candidates," he said.
reference: 这是很大、很大规模的竞选之一 -- 我现在没有参加竞选，但我确实会参加竞选，这就是为什么我到处跑，争取成为理想人选的原因，" 他说。

source: Trump continued, "You see this horrible, horrible radical group of Democrats, you see it happening right now.
reference: 特朗普继续说道，"你们看到了民主党这个可怕的激进团体，你们马上就会看到。

source: And they're determined to take back power by using any means necessary, you see the meanness, the nastiness.
reference: 他们决定使用一切必要手段夺回权力，你们看他们有多卑鄙、有多下流。

source: They don't care who they hurt, who they have to run over in order to get power and control, that's what they want is power and control, we're not going to give it to them."
reference: 他们为了获得权力和控制权会不在乎伤害谁，碾压谁，他们所要的就是权力和控制权，我们不会将它拱手让给他们。”

source: Democrats, he said, are on a mission to "resist and obstruct."
reference: 他说民主党正在“抵抗和阻扰（对卡瓦诺的提名）。"

source: "And you see that over the last four days," he said, calling the Democrats "angry and mean and nasty and untruthful."
reference: "你们都看到了过去四天所发生的情况，“他说，称民主党 “ 恼羞成怒、卑鄙、下流、不说实话 。"

source: He referenced Senate Judiciary Committee ranking Democratic Sen. Dianne Feinstein by name, which received loud boos from the audience.
reference: 他指名道姓地提到 “参议院司法委员会” 资深成员、民主党参议员黛安娜·范斯坦（Dianne Feinstein），这引来观众一片嘘声。

source: "Remember her answer?
reference: “还记得她的回答吗？

source: Did you leak the document?
reference: 你是否泄露了文件？

source: Uh, uh, what.
reference: 唔、唔，说啥

source: No, uh no, I wait one - that was really bad body language - the worst body language I've ever seen."
reference: 不、唔不，我等一个-这确实是很差劲的肢体语言 -是我曾看到过的最差劲的肢体语言。”

source: Still Game star looks set for new career in restaurant industry
reference: Still Game 电视明星欲踏足餐饮业

source: Still Game star Ford Kieran looks set to move into the hospitality industry after it was discovered he's been named as the director of a licensed restaurants company.
reference: Still Game 电视明星Ford Kieran 欲踏足酒店业，此前有人发现他已经是一家经注册的饭店的经理。

source: The 56-year-old plays Jack Jarvis on the popular BBC show, which he writes and co-stars with long-time comedy partner Greg Hemphill.
reference: 这位56岁的明星在BBC一个热门电视剧中饰演  Jack Jarvis。他是这部剧的编剧，并与其长期的喜剧搭档Greg Hemphill 共同出演。

source: The duo have announced that the upcoming ninth series will be the final one in the show's run, and it appears Kiernan is planning for life after Craiglang.
reference: 这对喜剧搭档已宣布即将播出的第九季将是该电视节目的最后一季，看来随着 Craiglang 落幕， Kiernan 将会重新规划人生。

source: According to official record listings, he is the director of Adriftmorn Limited.
reference: 根据官方的工商记录，他是 Adriftmorn Limited 的经理。

source: The actor declined to comment on the story, though a Scottish Sun source hinted that Kiernan was looking to get involved in Glasgow's "thriving restaurant trade."
reference: 他对该消息不置可否，尽管“苏格兰太阳报”的消息暗示 Kiernan 想要踏足格拉斯哥“生意兴隆的餐饮业。"

source: 'The sea is ours': landlocked Bolivia hopes court will reopen path to Pacific
reference: “大海属于我们”: 内陆国家玻利维亚希望法庭重开通往太平洋的通道

source: Sailors patrol a rigging-clad naval headquarters in La Paz.
reference: 水手们在位于La Paz 、覆盖着帆具的海军总部巡逻。

source: Public buildings fly an ocean-blue flag.
reference: 公共建筑飘扬着海蓝色的旗帜。

source: Naval bases from Lake Titicaca to the Amazon are daubed with the motto: "The sea is ours by right.
reference: 从 Titicaca 湖到 Amazon 的海军基的地沿路上涂写着口号："大海理所当然属于我们。

source: To recover it is a duty."
reference: 收回大海，人人有责。“

source: Throughout landlocked Bolivia, the memory of a coastline lost to Chile in a bloody 19th-century resource conflict is still vivid - as is the yearning to sail the Pacific Ocean once more.
reference: 在十九世纪发生的血腥的资源冲突中，玻利维亚的海岸线落入智利之手，这段记忆在整个玻利维亚人心中仍然历历在目 - 因为玻利维亚人渴望再次扬帆太平洋。

source: Those hopes are perhaps at their highest in decades, as Bolivia awaits a ruling by the international court of justice on 1 October after five years of deliberations.
reference: 几十年来，玻利维亚人对这种诉求寄予了很高的希望, 经过国际法庭五年的审议，玻利维亚正在等待国际法庭十月一日作出的裁决。

source: "Bolivia has the momentum, a spirit of unity and serenity, and is of course expecting with a positive view the outcome," said Roberto Calzadilla, a Bolivian diplomat.
reference: "玻利维亚发展势头强劲、人民团结一心，而环境宁静恬淡，它当然期望有个良好的结果，“玻利维亚外交官Roberto Calzadilla 说。

source: Many Bolivians will watch the ICJ ruling on big screens across the country, hopeful that the tribunal in The Hague will find in favour of Bolivia's claim that - after decades of fitful talks - Chile is obliged to negotiate granting Bolivia a sovereign outlet to the sea.
reference: 玻利维亚全国将有很多人会通过大屏幕收看”国际审判法院（ICJ）“的裁决，他们希望海牙国际法庭将作出有利于玻利维亚诉求的判决 - 经过几十年断断续续的谈判 - 智利必须与我们达成协议，授予玻利维亚通往入海口的主权。

source: Evo Morales, Bolivia's charismatic indigenous president - who faces a controversial battle for re-election next year - also has plenty riding on Monday's ruling.
reference: 埃沃·莫拉莱斯（Evo Morales） 总统是位魅力非凡的原住民，他也特别倚重周一的裁决。明年他将竞选连任，但竞选充满争议 。

source: "We are very close to returning to the Pacific Ocean," he vowed in late August.
reference: "我们重返太平洋也就一步之遥了，“ 他在八月末曾信誓旦旦地说。

source: But some analysts believe that the court is unlikely to decide in Bolivia's favour - and that little would change if it did.
reference: 但一些分析人士认为，国际法庭不可能作出有利于玻利维亚的裁决 - 即使作出了有利于玻利维亚的裁决，也不会改变现状。

source: The Netherlands-based UN body has no power to award Chilean territory, and has stipulated that it will not determine the outcome of possible talks.
reference: 这家位于荷兰的联合国组织无权对智利的领土予以裁决，并且已保证不会对可能的谈判的结果予以确定。

source: That the ICJ's ruling comes only six months after the final arguments were heard indicates the case "wasn't complicated," said Paz Zárate, a Chilean expert in international law.
reference: 最终论证公布出来仅仅6个月，ICJ 就作出了裁决，这表明这起案例”并不复杂，“智利的国际法专家 Paz Zárate 说。

source: And far from furthering Bolivia's cause, the past four years may have set it back.
reference: 这不仅没有让玻利维亚的意图得逞，反而可能白白浪费了过去的四年时光。

source: "The issue of access to the sea has been hijacked by the current Bolivian administration," said Zárate.
reference: "入海通道问题被玻利维亚的现任政府所利用，" Zárate 说。

source: Morales's belligerent rhetoric has sapped any residual Chilean goodwill, she suggested.
reference: 她暗示，莫拉莱斯挑衅性的言辞致使该国与智利的最后一点友谊也消失殆尽。

source: Bolivia and Chile will at some point continue to talk, but it will be extremely difficult to hold discussions after this.
reference: 未来，玻利维亚与智利还会继续谈判，但自此以后要进行商讨将是一件极其困难的事情。

source: The two countries have not exchanged ambassadors since 1962.
reference: 自 1962 年以来，两国就从未互换过大使。

source: Former president Eduardo Rodríguez Veltzé, Bolivia's representative at The Hague, rejected the idea that the court's decision-making was unusually speedy.
reference: 有人认为国际法庭过去会十分迅速地作出裁决，对于这种看法，玻利维亚派驻海牙国际法庭的代表、前总统爱德华多·罗德里格斯·贝尔塞（ Eduardo Rodríguez Veltzé） 予以了否定。

source: Monday will bring Bolivia "an extraordinary opportunity to open a new era of relations with Chile" and a chance to "put an end to 139 years of disagreements with mutual benefits," he said.
reference: 周一将是玻利维亚“开启与智利重建两国关系，这是一次千载难逢的机会”，也是“结束两国 139 年来在共同利益问题上的分歧”的时机，“他说。

source: Calzadilla also denied that Morales - still one of Latin America's most popular presidents - was using the maritime issue as a political crutch.
reference: Calzadilla 还否认莫拉莱斯利用海事问题达到政治上的目的。 莫拉莱斯仍然是拉丁美洲最受欢迎的总统之一 。

source: "Bolivia will never give up its right to have access to the Pacific Ocean," he added.
reference: “玻利维亚从不会放弃其进入太平洋的权利，” 他还说。

source: "The ruling is an opportunity to see that we need to overcome the past."
reference: "此次裁决将让我们见证，我们需要解决过去的问题。“

source: North Korea says nuclear disarmament won't come unless it can trust US
reference: 朝鲜表示，核裁军的前提是它可以信任美国

source: North Korean Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho says his nation will never disarm its nuclear weapons first if it can't trust Washington.
reference: 朝鲜外交部长李英浩表示，如果朝鲜无法信任美国，则绝不会进行核裁军。

source: Ri was speaking Saturday at the United Nations General Assembly.
reference: 李英浩周六在联合国大会上发表讲话。

source: He called on the United States to follow through on promises made during a summit in Singapore between the rivals' leaders.
reference: 他呼吁美国遵守两国领导人在新加坡朝美峰会期间作出的承诺。

source: His comments come as US. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo seems to be on the verge of restarting deadlocked nuclear diplomacy more than three months after the Singapore with North Korea's Kim Jong Un.
reference: 他讲这番话时正逢新加坡朝美高峰会结束三个多月之后，美国国务卿蓬佩奥似乎将要重新开启已陷入僵局的核外交。

source: Ri says it's a "pipe dream" that continued sanctions and U.S. objection to a declaration ending the Korean War will ever bring the North to its knees.
reference: 李英浩表示，“妄想”通过继续制裁朝鲜以及美国反对宣布“朝鲜战争”结束使朝鲜屈服。

source: Washington is wary of agreeing to the declaration without Pyongyang first making significant disarmament moves.
reference: 如果朝鲜不首先作出核裁军的重大举措，美国在同意宣布朝鲜战争结束问题上会采取十分谨慎的态度。

source: Both Kim and U.S. President Donald Trump want a second summit.
reference: 金正恩和美国总统特朗普都希望举行第二次峰会。

source: But there is widespread skepticism that Pyongyang is serious about renouncing an arsenal that the country likely sees as the only way to guarantee its safety.
reference: 但是人们普遍怀疑朝鲜会对真格放弃核武器，因为这可能是该国保证其国家安全的唯一方式。

source: Pompeo is planning to visit Pyongyang next month to prepare for a second Kim-Trump summit.
reference: 蓬佩奥计划下个月出访朝鲜，为第二次特金峰会作准备。

source: Paris fashion shows reveal latest line in massive headwear on it's way to a High Street near you
reference: 巴黎时装秀上超大头饰粉墨登场，即将飞入寻常百姓家

source: If you want to upsize your hat collection or completely block out the sun then look no further.
reference: 如果你想再添几件精品帽饰，或彻底抵挡太阳照射，那别再观望了。

source: Designers Valentino and Thom Browne unveiled an array of wacky oversized head gear for their SS19 collection on the runway which dazzled the style set at Paris Fashion Week.
reference: 设计师华伦天奴（Valentino） 和 汤姆·布朗（Thom Browne） 在其SS19 精品发布会上展示了一系列 造型古怪的超大头饰， 使“巴黎时装周”的风格更加炫目多彩。

source: Highly impractical hats have swept Instagram this summer and these designers have sent their eye-popping creations down the catwalk.
reference: 这个夏季，极不实用的帽子的图片充斥着 Instagram，这些设计师创新作品已经在 T形台亮相，令人耳目一新。

source: The stand out piece by Valentino was an over-the-top beige hat adorned with a feather-like wide brim that swamped the models heads.
reference: 华伦天奴的作品脱颖而出，过度夸张的米色帽子，配有宽大的羽状帽檐，论大小，令模特的头相形见绌。

source: Other over-sized accessories included bejeweled watermelons, a wizard hat and even a pineapple - but they are not designed to keep your head warm.
reference: 其他的特大配饰包括 镶有珠宝的西瓜，一顶魔术师帽子，甚至还有菠萝 - 但它们不是用来给你的头部保温的。

source: Thom Browne also revealed a selection of bizarre masks- and just in time for Halloween.
reference: 汤姆·布朗还发布了 离奇的精品面具- 正好赶上万圣节。

source: Many of the colourful masks had sewn up lips and resembled more like Hannibal Lecter than haute couture.
reference: 众多五颜六色的面具缝合了嘴唇，与其说像高级时装，还不如说像是汉尼拔·莱克特。

source: One creation resembled scuba diving gear complete with snorkel and goggles, while another looked like a melted ice cream cone.
reference: 其中一个作品貌似配备了呼吸管和护目镜的潜水装备，而另一个作品看起来像是融化了的蛋筒冰激凌。

source: And if you continue the huge fashion statement- you are in luck.
reference: 如果你继续关注这些特大的奇装异服- 你定会交好运。

source: Style watchers predict that the enormous bonnets could be making their way to high streets near you.
reference: 风格观察人士预测，特大的旧式女帽可能会成为高街时尚品。

source: The out-sized hats come hot on the heels of 'La Bomba', the straw hat with a two-foot wide brim that's been seen on everyone from Rihanna to Emily Ratajkowski.
reference: “La Bomba” 是带有两英尺宽帽檐的草帽，是从蕾哈娜到Emily Ratajkowski 等名人的时尚品，特大帽子会紧跟这股潮流。

source: The cult label behind the highly impractical hat that was splashed across social media sent another big creation down the catwalk - a straw beach bag almost as big as the swimsuit-clad model toting it.
reference: 一个在社交媒体上走红的极不实用的帽子的小众品牌 ，发布了另一特大款作品 - 几乎与泳装模特一样大的草编沙滩包。

source: The burnt orange raffia bag, trimmed with raffia fringing and topped with a white leather handle, was the stand out piece in Jacquemus' La Riviera SS19 collection at Paris Fashion Week.
reference: Jacquemus 的La Riviera SS19 精品参加了 “巴黎时装周”，其中一件单品脱颖而出，这就是边缘点缀拉菲草，顶部配有白色皮提手的焦橙色拉菲草包。

source: Celebrity stylist Luke Armitage told FEMAIL: 'I'm expecting to see large hats and beach bags arrive on the high street for next summer - as the designer has made such a huge impact it would be hard to ignore the demand for the oversized accessories.'
reference: 明星造型师 Luke Armitage 告诉 FEMAIL:“我预计特大号帽子和沙滩包将成为明年夏天的高街时尚品- 因为设计师的影响力极大，所以很难忽略市场对特大号配饰的需求。”

source: John Edward: Languages skills essential for global citizens
reference: John Edward:世界公民必备的语言技巧

source: Scotland's independent schools maintain a track record of academic excellence, and this has continued in 2018 with another set of outstanding exam results, which is only strengthened by individual and collective success in sports, art, music and other community endeavours.
reference: 苏格兰的私立学校秉承卓越的学术表现，仅凭借个人和集体在运动、艺术、音乐和其他社区工作上努力就取得了突出的考试成绩，2018 年再续辉煌。

source: With upwards of 30,000 pupils across Scotland, these schools, represented by The Scottish Council of Independent Schools (SCIS), strive to deliver the best level of service to their pupils and parents.
reference: 苏格兰全国私立学校在校学生超过 3 万人，这些私立学校致力于向其学生和家长提供一流的服务，它们的主管机构是“苏格兰私立学校理事会” (SCIS)。

source: Independent schools aim to prepare their pupils for further and higher education, their chosen career and their place as global citizens.
reference: 私立学校旨在培养学生，为其进一步深造、接受高等教育、就业及未来成为世界公民作准备。

source: As an education sector that can design and implement a bespoke school curriculum, we are seeing modern languages continue as a popular and desired subject of choice within schools.
reference: 作为能够设计和实施学校定制课程的教育部门，我们注意到现代语言不断成为学校学生喜欢选修的课程。

source: Nelson Mandela said: "If you talk to a man in a language he understands, that goes to his head.
reference: 纳尔逊·曼德拉说：“如果你跟别人说话时，说对方听得懂的语言，那么这会让他为之一振。

source: If you talk to him in his own language that goes to his heart."
reference: 如果你跟他说话时，说对方的母语，那么这会让他心有戚戚。“

source: This is a powerful reminder that we can't just rely on English when wanting to build relationships and trust with people from other countries.
reference: 这有力的提醒了我们，想要与其他国家的人建立关系、建立互信不能仅仅依靠英语。

source: From this year's recent exam results, we can see that languages are topping the league tables with the highest pass rates within independent schools.
reference: 从今年的考试成绩看，语言课程居于私立学校排名榜之首，课程通过率最高。

source: A total of 68 per cent of pupils who studied foreign languages achieved a Higher grade A.
reference: 选修外语的学生中，总共有 68%的学生获得了高级 A。

source: The data, collected from SCIS's 74 member schools, showed that 72 per cent of students achieved a Higher grade A in Mandarin, while 72 per cent of those studying German, 69 per cent of those studying French and 63 per cent studying Spanish also achieved an A.
reference: SCIS 收集的 74 所会员学校的数据显示，72% 选修汉语的学生获得了高级A，而72% 选修德语、69% 选修法语、63% 选修西班牙的学生也获得了A 。

source: This demonstrates that independent schools in Scotland are supporting foreign languages as vital skills that children and young people will undoubtedly require in the future.
reference: 这表明苏格兰的私立学校支持将外语作为儿童和青年在未来毋庸置疑需要掌握的关键技能。

source: Languages now, as a subject choice, are being held in the same regard as STEM subjects (science, technology, engineering and mathematics) in independent school curriculums and elsewhere.
reference: 如今，语言作为选修课程，在私立学校课程设置以及其他地方与 STEM 课程（科学、技术、工程和数学）处于同样的地位。

source: A survey by the UK Commission for Employment and Skills in 2014 found that of reasons employers gave for struggling to fill vacancies, 17 per cent were attributed to a languages skills shortage.
reference: “英国就业与技能委员会” 在 2014 年进行的一项调查发现，在雇主难于填补职位空缺的原因中，17% 的雇主将这归因于缺乏语言技能。

source: Therefore more and more, language skills are becoming imperative in order to prepare young people for their future careers.
reference: 因此，语言技能已越来越成为年轻人谋求未来职业所需具备的能力。

source: With more prospective job opportunities requiring languages, these skills are essential in a globalised world.
reference: 由于更多潜在的就业机会需要语言能力，因此这些技能是世界全球化所必需的。

source: Regardless of the career someone chooses, if they've learned a second language, they'll have a real advantage in the future having a life-long skill such as this.
reference: 无论选择什么职业，求职者如果学习了第二门语言，那么在未来就具备了真正的优势，也就具备了如此般的终身技能。

source: Being able to communicate directly with people from foreign countries will automatically put a multilingual person ahead of the competition.
reference: 具备与外国人直接沟通的能力也就自动地使懂得多种语言的人从竞争中脱颖而出。

source: According to a YouGov poll of more than 4,000 UK adults in 2013, 75 per cent were unable to speak a foreign language well enough to hold a conversation and with French being the only language spoken by a double-digit percentage, 15 per cent.
reference: 根据 YouGov 在 2013 年对超过 4000 名英国成年人的民意调查的统计，75% 的人无法流畅地使用一门外语进行对话，只有法语是唯一会说的人数达到两位数百分比，即 15% 。

source: This is why putting the investment into language teaching now is important for today's children.
reference: 这就是当今投资儿童语言教学的重要性的原因所在。

source: Having multiple languages, particularly those of developing economies, will equip children with a better chance of finding meaningful employment.
reference: 掌握多门外语，特别是发展中经济体的语言，将使儿童在未来有更多机会找到满意的工作。

source: Within Scotland, each school will differ in the languages they teach.
reference: 在苏格兰，每所学校教授不同的语言。

source: A number of schools will focus on the more classic modern languages, whereas others will teach languages that are deemed to be most important for the UK when looking ahead to 2020, such as Mandarin or Japanese.
reference: 很多学校侧重于更为现代经典语言，而其他学校展望 2020 年，教授对英国来说会更为重要的语言，例如汉语或日语。

source: Whatever your child's interest, there will always be a number of languages to choose from within independent schools, with teaching staff who are specialists in this area.
reference: 无论你们的孩子兴趣如何，私立学校总有众多语言供他们选择，而且教学人员都是这方面的专家。

source: Scottish independent schools are dedicated to providing a learning environment that will prepare children and arm them with the skills required to succeed, whatever the future holds.
reference: 无论学生的未来如何，苏格兰私立学校都致力于为学生提供学习环境，使他们具备未来成功所需的技能。

source: It can't be denied at this time, in a global business environment, that languages continue to be vitally important to the country's future, so this must be mirrored in education.
reference: 此时此刻，不可否认的是，在全球商业环境中，掌握外语对一国的未来的至关重要性会持续下去，因此，教育必须反映出这一现实情况。

source: Indeed, modern languages should really be considered "international communication skills."
reference: 事实上，确实应该将现代语言作为“国际沟通的技能。”

source: Independent schools will continue to offer this choice, diversity and excellence for Scotland's young people.
reference: 私立学校将继续为苏格兰的青少年提供这一选择，

source: Il faut bien le faire.
reference: 势在必行（Il faut bien le faire）。

source: John Edward is Director of the Scottish Council of Independent Schools
reference: 约翰·爱德华是“苏格兰私立学校委员会”董事

source: LeBron to make Lakers debut Sunday in San Diego
reference: 周日勒布朗在圣地亚哥的湖人队首秀

source: The wait is nearly over for fans looking to see LeBron James make his first start for the Los Angeles Lakers.
reference: 勒布朗·詹姆斯的球迷期待他的湖人队首秀即将到来。

source: Lakers coach Luke Walton has announced that James will play in Sunday's preseason opener against the Denver Nuggets in San Diego.
reference: 湖人队教练卢克·沃顿已宣布詹姆斯将于周日在圣地亚哥迎战丹佛掘金者队的季前赛揭幕战中出场。

source: But just how many minutes he'll play has yet to be determined.
reference: 但到底他将出场多少分钟还有待决定。

source: "It will be more than one and less than 48," said Walton on the Lakers" official website.
reference: "他出场时间不止 1 分钟，但不会超过 48 分钟，" 沃顿在湖人队的官网上说。

source: Lakers reporter Mike Trudell tweeted that James will likely play limited minutes.
reference: 湖人队记者 Mike Trudell 发推特说，詹姆斯可能出场的时间有限。

source: Following practice earlier this week, James was asked about his plans for the Lakers" six-game preseason schedule.
reference: 在本周初练习过后，詹姆斯被问及了他的关于湖人队的六场季前赛时间安排计划。

source: "I don't need preseason games at this stage of my career to get ready," he said.
reference: “在我职业生涯的现阶段，我不需要需为季前赛做准备”。

source: Trump's West Virginia Rally Time, YouTube Channel
reference: YouTube频道，特朗普西弗吉尼亚州集会

source: President Donald Trump begins a flurry of campaign rallies tonight in Wheeling, West Virginia.
reference: 唐纳德特朗普总统在西弗吉尼亚威灵组织了多场竞选集会。

source: It's Trump's first of five scheduled rallies in the next week, including stops in friendly places including Tennessee and Mississippi.
reference: 这是特朗普计划于下周组织的五个计划集会中的首个集会，其间特朗普将在田纳西州和密西西比州等“友好”地区停留。
