source: With the confirmation vote on hold for his pick to fill the Supreme Court vacancy, Trump is aiming to build support for upcoming mid-term elections since Republicans are at risk of losing control of Congress when votes are cast on Nov.
reference: 考虑到共和党在11月份的投票中可能会失去对国会的管控，特朗普特别暂停了投票确认，提名了填补最高法院职位空缺的候选人，以期为即将到来的中期选举赢得支持。

source: What time is Trump's West Virginia rally tonight and how do you watch online?
reference: 那么特朗普的西弗吉尼亚组织集会今晚何时开始？如何在线收看？

source: Trump's Wheeling, West Virginia rally is scheduled for 7 p.m. ET tonight, Saturday, September 29, 2018.
reference: 特朗普的西弗吉尼亚威灵集会计划于今晚7点开始。具体时间为美国东部时间2018年9月29日星期六晚间。

source: You can watch Trump's West Virginia rally online below via live stream on YouTube.
reference: 您可以通过YouTube现场直播观看特朗普西弗吉尼亚在线集会

source: Trump is likely to address this week's hearings for Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh, which became tense over sexual misconduct allegations with an anticipated Senate confirmation vote on hold for up to a week while the FBI investigates.
reference: 特朗普可能宣布本周因性骚扰而遭受指控的最高法院提名人布雷特·卡瓦诺的听证会以及预计在FBI调查期间暂停参议院投票确认的事宜。

source: But the primary aim of this flurry of rallies is helping Republicans facing touch November elections gain some momentum.
reference: 此次集会的主要目的是针对即将到来的九月份选举为共和党鼓舞士气。

source: Thus, President Trump's campaign said these five rallies in the next week are aimed at "energizing volunteers and supporters as Republicans try to protect and expand the majorities they hold in the Senate and House of Representatives," according to Reuters.
reference: 据路透社报道，特朗普总统的竞选团队透露计划于下周组织五次集会的目的是“鼓励共和党自愿者和支持者捍卫并扩大共和党人在众议院和参议院的席位”。

source: "Control of Congress is so critical for his agenda that the president will travel to as many states as possible as we head into the busy campaign season," a Trump campaign spokesman who declined to be named told Reuters.
reference: 据一位不愿透露姓名的特朗普竞选发言人透露“对总统而言对国会的管控非常重要，因此我们在忙于竞选的同时，总统还需要前往尽可能多的州”。

source: Scheduled for Wesbanco Arena in Wheeling, tonight's rally could bring supporters from "Ohio and Pennsylvania and draw coverage from the Pittsburgh media," according to the West Virginia Metro News.
reference: 根据西弗吉尼亚地铁新闻报报道，计划于今晚在威灵Wesbanco Arena组织的集会可能汇集来自“俄亥俄州和宾夕法尼亚州以及匹兹堡媒体”支持者。

source: Saturday will be the second time in the past month that Trump has visited West Virginia, the state he won by more than 40 percentage points in 2016.
reference: 自上个月到访西弗吉尼亚之后，星期六特朗普第二次前往西弗吉尼亚 - 2016年他在该州赢得了40%以上的选票。

source: Trump is trying to help West Virginia Republican Senate candidate Patrick Morrisey, who is trailing in the polls.
reference: 特朗普希望通过此举帮助西弗吉尼亚州共和党参议院候选人帕特里克·莫里西摆脱民意调查落后的局面。

source: "It's not a good sign for Morrisey that the president has to come to try to give him a boost in the polls," said Simon Haeder, a political scientist at West Virginia University, according to Reuters.
reference: 根据路透社西弗吉尼亚大学政治学者西蒙Haeder表示，“总统不得以帮助莫里西提高其支持率并不是一个好的信号。” 。

source: Ryder Cup 2018: Team USA show stomach for fight to keep hopes alive heading into Sunday singles
reference: 2018年莱德杯公开赛：美国队员对周日单人赛抱有希望

source: After three one-sided sessions, Saturday afternoon's foursomes might just have been what this Ryder Cup needed.
reference: 在周六上午比赛双方以三比一拉开莱德杯公开赛帷幕之后，周六下午莱德杯正式迎来比赛高潮。

source: The swinging pendulum of momentum is a completely invented sporting concept but one that players truly believe in, and never more so than at competitions like these.
reference: 比赛局势虽然是一个虚构的运动概念，但球员们却深信不疑，并且在这样的比赛中更是如此。

source: So where would they say the momentum is now?
reference: 那么他们所说的比赛局势体现在哪儿呢？

source: "They had a six-point lead and now it's four, so we are carrying that as a little bit of momentum I guess," said Jordan Spieth as he strolled off for the day.
reference: 乔丹·斯皮思在当天的比赛中边走边说，“此前他们领先六分，而现在差距缩小为四分，因此我猜测比赛局势发生了一点变化”。

source: Europe have the advantage, of course, four points ahead with twelve more in play.
reference: 当然了欧洲队在比赛中领先四分，还有十二分。

source: The Americans, as Spieth says, feel they have a little wind in their sails though and they have plenty to be encouraged by, not least the form of Spieth and Justin Thomas who played together all day and each boast three points from four.
reference: 美国队员斯皮斯觉得局势对他们更有利并且他们信心十足，而从斯皮斯和贾斯汀·托马斯一整天的比赛表现来看确实如此，他们每个人都从四分中得到了三分。

source: Spieth has been lethal from tee to green and is leading by example.
reference: 从球座到绿茵斯皮斯展现了非凡的实力，也为团队做出了表率。

source: Those guttural screams of celebration got louder as his round went on, sinking a crucial putt to take match four all-square when he and Thomas had been two down after two.
reference: 在斯皮斯和托马斯落后两分的情况下，比赛庆祝的尖叫声越来越响亮，斯皮斯一记至关重要的推杆使其赢得了第四场比赛。

source: His putt that won them the match on 15 was met with a similar scream, the sort that tells you he believes that the American team is not out of this.
reference: 这一记推杆使斯皮斯获得了15洞，最终锁定胜局，同时赢得了在场观众阵阵喝彩，由此他相信美国并未出局。

source: "You've really just got to dig deep and worry about your own match," Spieth said.
reference: 斯皮斯说“你真正要做的是全身心投入比赛”。

source: It is all each of these players has left now.
reference: 现在所有的球员都离开了。

source: 18 holes to make a mark.
reference: 最终得分为18洞。

source: The only players with more points than Spieth and Thomas over the past two days are Francesco Molinari and Tommy Fleetwood, the indisputable story of the Ryder Cup.
reference: 在过去的两天中唯一一组分数高于斯皮思和托马斯的是弗兰西斯科-莫利纳利和汤米，这是莱德杯无可争议的事实。

source: Europe's odd but adorable couple are four from four and can do no wrong.
reference: 这一组古怪又可爱的欧洲球员稳扎稳打，取得了赢四洞剩四洞的战绩。

source: "Moliwood" were the only pair not to shoot a bogey on Saturday afternoon, but they also avoided bogeys on Saturday morning, Friday afternoon and the back nine on Friday morning.
reference: “Moliwood”是唯一一组在周六下午未发出一柏忌的球员，另外他们在周六上午、星期五下午和星期五上午的后九洞也未发出一柏忌。

source: That run, and the way their energy seems to flow both to and from this boisterous crowd cements that they are the players to beat on Sunday, and there would be no more popular player to seal a potential European victory as the sun sets over Le Golf National than Fleetwood or Molinari.
reference: 他们跑动的方式以及展现的活力在喧闹的人群中似乎并不突出，但他们就是周日赢得比赛的球员，很难想象太阳落山之际，正是他们帮助欧洲国家高尔夫俱乐部锁定胜局，他们的受欢迎程度超过了比弗利特伍德或莫利纳里

source: Preferably both simultaneously on different holes.
reference: 不同的洞却表现如一。

source: Talk of European glory remains premature, though.
reference: 不过现在谈论欧洲队的荣耀还为时过早。

source: Bubba Watson and Webb Simpson made short work of Sergio Garcia, the morning's fourballs hero, when he was paired with Alex Noren.
reference: 巴巴·沃森和韦伯·辛普森迅速解决了此前与亚历克斯·诺伦搭档的四球比洞赛英雄赛尔吉奥·加西亚。

source: A bogey and two doubles on the front nine dug the Spaniard and the Swede into a hole they never got close to climbing out of.
reference: 前九个洞以一柏忌和两个双柏忌使西拔牙和瑞士球员如陷入泥潭一般不能自拔。

source: On Sunday, though, there is nobody to help you out of your hole.
reference: 周日的比赛没有人会帮助你脱离困境。

source: The fourballs and foursomes are so fascinating to watch up close because of the interactions between pairings, the advice they give, the advice they don't and the way that a strategy can change in an instant.
reference: 四球比洞赛和四人二球赛由于两队球员互动频繁，关于比赛的建议和策略瞬息万变，近距离观看非常精彩。

source: Europe have played better as a team thus far and take a significant lead into the final day but this foursomes session also showed that Team USA has the stomach for the fight that some, especially Stateside, had been doubting.
reference: 本届欧洲队是迄今为止表现最佳的球队，这支球队在比赛最后一天拔得头筹，而与此同时美国队在四人二球赛中也展现了顽强的比赛精神，但部分观众特别是美国国内观众却对此表示怀疑。

source: Livingston 1 - 0 Rangers: Menga goal downs Gerrard's men
reference: 利文斯顿1-0流浪者：蒙加击败杰拉德带领的流浪者队

source: Rangers suffered another bout of away-day blues as Dolly Menga's strike consigned Steven Gerrard's disjointed side to a 1-0 defeat at Livingston.
reference: 流浪者队再次患上了“休息日忧郁症”，杰拉德带领的流浪者队在多利·蒙加进球后使陷入混乱并最终以1-0负于利文斯顿。

source: The Ibrox side were looking to record their first win on the road since February's 4-1 triumph at St Johnstone, but Gary Holt's team inflicted just Gerrard's second defeat in 18 games as manager to leave his side eight points adrift of runaway Ladbrokes Premiership leaders Hearts.
reference: 自二月在圣约翰斯顿取得4-1战绩之后，流浪者便希望在埃布罗克斯客场取得他们的首场胜利，但加里霍尔特率领的球队使作为主教练的杰拉德在18场比赛中遭遇第二次失利，最终杰拉德率领的流浪者队在积分榜上落后英超联赛领头羊立博8分

source: Menga struck seven minutes before half-time and a Rangers line-up short on inspiration never looked like levelling.
reference: 蒙加在半场结束前7分钟射门，而流浪者队表现平庸，未能组织有效防守最终失利。

source: While Rangers now drop down to sixth spot, Livingston climb to third and only behind Hibernian on goal difference.
reference: 目前流浪者积分排行下降至第六位，利文斯顿攀升至第三位并且仅在净胜球方面落后于希伯尼安。

source: And there could be further trouble in store for Rangers after linesman Calum Spence had to be treated for a head wound after an object was apparently thrown from the away end.
reference: 在这场比赛中边裁卡勒姆·斯宾塞由于被远处异物击中而必须接受治疗，可以想象流浪者今后将面临更为棘手的问题。

source: Gerrard made eight changes to the side which swept past Ayr into the Betfred Cup semi-finals.
reference: 杰拉德此前进行8次换人，横扫艾尔最终进入贝特弗雷德杯半决赛。

source: Holt, on the other hand, went with the same Livi 11 which took a point off Hearts last week and he would have been delighted with the way his well-drilled outfit suffocated their opponents at every turn.
reference: 另一方面，霍尔特上周以同样的 11人组合凭借关键一球淘汰了哈茨，他带领的球队训练有素令对手疲于应战，这令霍尔特十分满意。

source: Rangers may have dominated possession but Livingston did more with the ball they had.
reference: 流浪者队对球场的控制占据了主动，但利文斯顿却更胜一筹。

source: They should have scored just two minutes in when Menga's first-time lay-off sent Scott Pittman through on Allan McGregor's goal but the midfielder tugged his big chance wide.
reference: 流浪者队本应在蒙加首次被替换后两分钟内得分，结果麦格雷戈凭借斯科特·皮特曼的助攻破门得分，流浪者队中场球员就此错失良机。

source: A deep Keaghan Jacobs free-kick then found skipper Craig Halkett but his defensive partner Alan Lithgow could only stab wide at the back post.
reference: 雅克布斯将任意球传给队长克雷格·哈克特，但随后防守队员艾伦·利思戈拦截，雷格·哈克特将球射偏击在了后门柱。

source: Rangers did grab control but there looked to be more hope than belief about their play in the final third.
reference: 随后流浪者队开始积极球场局面并且在比赛后半段信心满满。

source: Alfredo Morelos certainly felt he should have had a penalty on the quarter-hour mark as he and Steven Lawless collided but referee Steven Thomson waved away the Colombian's appeals.
reference: 阿尔弗雷多·莫雷洛斯与史蒂芬·劳利斯发生碰撞，莫雷洛斯认为他理应获得点球机会，但裁判史蒂文·汤姆森驳回了这位哥伦比亚人的申述。

source: Rangers managed just two first-half shots on target but former Ibrox goalkeeper Liam Kelly was barely troubled by Lassana Coulibaly's header and a tame Ovie Ejaria strike.
reference: 在上半场流浪者队组织了两次射门，而前埃布罗克斯门将利亚姆·凯利几乎没有受到拉萨纳库利巴利头球和奥维·埃亚里亚射门所困扰。

source: While Livi's 34th-minute opener may have been against the run of play, no one can deny they deserved it for their graft alone.
reference: 当Livi第34分钟首次射门可能与比赛节奏不慎相符，不可否认他们的平庸表现难辞其咎。

source: Again Rangers failed to deal with a deep Jacobs set-piece.
reference: 流浪者队仍没有把握好雅各布斯的定位球机会。

source: Scott Arfield did not react as Declan Gallagher slotted the ball to Scott Robinson, who kept his cool to pick out Menga for a simple finish.
reference: 德克兰·加拉格尔将球传给斯科特·罗宾逊后，斯科特·阿尔菲尔德并未及时做出反应，球被蒙加收回，流浪者队的进攻草草了事。

source: Gerrard acted at the break as he swapped Coulibaly for Ryan Kent and the switch almost provided an immediate impact as the winger slotted in Morelos but the impressive Kelly raced from his line to block.
reference: 杰拉德在中场休息时安排瑞安·肯特替换库里巴利，而随着边锋莫雷洛斯几番切入，球场局面发生了急剧变化，凯利从他所在的防线跑向拦网。

source: But Livingston continued to suck the visitors into playing exactly the type of game they enjoy, with Lithgow and Halkett sweeping up long ball after long ball.
reference: 但利文斯顿又一次让观众大失所望，利思戈和哈克特接到长传后连续扫射均未见成效。

source: Holt's side could have stretched their lead in the final stages but McGregor stood up well to deny Jacobs before Lithgow headed wide from the corner.
reference: 霍尔特一边本可以在最后阶段扩大他们领先的优势，但利思戈发出角球后麦格雷戈的出现挡住了雅各布斯的射门。

source: Rangers substitute Glenn Middleton had another late claim for a penalty as he tangled with Jacobs but again Thomson looked away.
reference: 随后流浪者队替补队员格伦·米德尔顿与雅各布斯发生争吵并要求给予其处罚，但汤姆森并未理会。

source: Almanac: The inventor of the Geiger Counter
reference: 年鉴：盖革计数器发明人

source: And now a page from our "Sunday Morning" Almanac: September 30, 1882, 136 years ago today, and COUNTING ... the day the future physicist Johannes Wilhelm "Hans" Geiger was born in Germany.
reference: 现在翻开我们“星期天上午”年鉴中的一页：距今136年，1882年9月30日这一天 ... 这一天物理学家约翰内斯·威廉“汉斯”盖革在德国诞生。

source: Geiger developed a method for detecting and measuring radioactivity, an invention that eventually led to the device known as the Geiger Counter.
reference: 盖革发明了一种检测和测量放射性的方法，并最终发明了盖革计数器。

source: A mainstay of science ever since, the Geiger Counter became a pop culture mainstay as well, as in the 1950 movie "Bells of Coronado," starring those seemingly unlikely cowpoke scientists Roy Rogers and Dale Evans:
reference: 自此盖革计数器成为科学领域的支柱，而盖革堪比1950电影“科罗拉多之钟”中那些看起来不像牛仔的科学家罗伊·罗杰斯和黛儿·伊万斯：

source: Man: "What in the world is that?"
reference: 人们不禁要问：“盖革计数器到底是什么东西？”

source: Rogers: "It's a Geiger Counter, used to locate radioactive minerals, such as uranium.
reference: 罗杰：“盖革计数器用于定位铀等放射性矿物质。

source: When you put these earphones on, you can actually hear the effects of the atoms given off by the radioactivity in the minerals."
reference: 当你佩戴耳机时，您便能够清楚地听到来自矿物质放射性物质放射出原子的声音”

source: Evans: "Say, it sure is popping now!"
reference: 埃文斯：“那肯定是一种爆音！”

source: "Hans" Geiger died in 1945, just a few days short of his 63rd birthday.
reference: “汉斯”盖革于1945年距离他63生日的前几天逝世。

source: But the invention that bears his name lives on.
reference: 但其发明确令他永垂史册。

source: New cancer vaccine can teach the immune system to 'see' rogue cells
reference: 新癌症疫苗可指导免疫系统“辨别”恶意细胞

source: New cancer vaccine can teach the immune system to 'see' rogue cells and kill them
reference: 新癌症疫苗可指导免疫系统“辨别”恶意细胞并将其杀死

source: Vaccine teaches immune system to recognise rogue cells as part of treatment
reference: 该疫苗可指导免疫系统将恶意细胞标识为待处理对象

source: Method involves extracting immune cells from a patient, altering them in lab
reference: 其方法是先从患者体内提取免疫细胞，再在实验室内对免疫细胞进行改造

source: They can then 'see' a protein common to many cancers and then reinjected
reference: 改造后的免疫细胞可以“辨别”许多癌症常见的蛋白质，改造完成后重新注入患者体内

source: A trial vaccine is showing promising results in patients with a range of cancers.
reference: 试验疫苗在癌症患者体内发挥了良好效果，证明其对许多癌症均有疗效。

source: One woman treated with the vaccine, which teaches the immune system to recognise rogue cells, saw her ovarian cancer disappear for more than 18 months.
reference: 某女性患者在注射此疫苗后，其免疫系统在此疫苗的作用下可识别恶意细胞，在历经18个月的治疗后她的卵巢癌消失了。

source: The method involves extracting immune cells from a patient, altering them in the laboratory so they can "see" a protein common to many cancers called HER2, and then reinjecting the cells.
reference: 治疗方法是先从患者体内提取免疫细胞，然后在实验室内对免疫细胞进行改造，改造后的免疫细胞能够辨别许多癌症常见的蛋白质HER2，随后将改造后的免疫细胞重新注入患者体内。

source: Professor Jay Berzofsky, of the US National Cancer Institute in Bethesda, Maryland, said: "Our results suggest that we have a very promising vaccine."
reference: 马里兰州贝塞斯达的美国国家癌症研究所研究员博卓夫斯基表示：“我们的试验结果显示，我们的疫苗有望取得良好治疗效果”

source: HER2 "drives the growth of several types of cancer," including breast, ovarian, lung and colorectal cancers, Prof Berzofsky explained.

source: It Didn't Go Well

source: Kanye West was booed in the studio during a Saturday Night Live after a rambling performance in which he praised U.S. President Donald Trump and said he would run for office in 2020.
reference: 在《周六夜现场》中坎耶·韦斯特在演播室里完成散漫的表演之后赞扬美国总统唐纳德特朗普并声称将参与2020年竞选，随后遭到观众一片嘘声。

source: After performing his third song of the night, called Ghost Town in which he was wearing a Make America Great cap, he went on a rant against the Democrats and reiterated his support for Trump.
reference: 当夜他在演唱第三首歌曲Ghost Town时佩戴一顶“让美国再次伟大”的帽子，随后他声讨民主党，并反复强调其支持特朗普。

source: "So many times I talk to a white person and they say: "How could you like Trump, he's racist?"
reference: “我和白人有过很多次交谈，他们问我：“特朗普是个种族主义者，你怎么会喜欢他呢？”

source: Well, if I was concerned about racism I would've moved out of America a long time ago," he said.
reference: 如果我担心种族主义问题，那么我早就离开美国了。”他说。

source: SNL started the show with a skit starring Matt Damon in which the Hollywood star made fun of Brett Kavanaugh's testimony before the Senate Judicial Committee on sexual assault claims made by Christine Blasey Ford.
reference: 《周六夜现场》以马特·达蒙主演的小品开场，在该小品中好莱坞明星调侃克里斯汀·布莱西·福特对参议院司法委员会进行性侵指控之前布雷特·卡瓦诺所做的证词。

source: Although it was not broadcast, the footage of West's rant was uploaded to social media by comedian Chris Rock.
reference: 虽然这段内容未公布与众，但喜剧演员克里斯·洛克将韦斯特咆哮的视频上传到了社交媒体上。

source: It is unclear if Rock was trying to mock West with the posting.
reference: 目前还无法明确洛克是否故意通过此帖来嘲笑韦斯特。

source: Also, West had complained to the audience that he had got a hard time backstage about his head wear.
reference: 另外，他还向观众抱怨他在后台对他的头饰表达了不满。

source: "They bullied me backstage.
reference: “他们在后台欺负我，

source: They said, 'don't go out there with that hat on.'
reference: 他们说“别戴着那顶帽子出去”，

source: They bullied me!
reference: 显然他们在欺负我！

source: And then they say I'm in a sunken place," he said, according to the Washington Examiner.
reference: 随后他们又说我别无选择”他说，以上是来源于华盛顿检查员的反馈。

source: West went on: "You wanna see the sunken place?" saying that he would "put my superman cape on, because this means you can't tell me what to do. You want the world to move forward?
reference: 韦斯特再次发言：“你想看看问题究竟在哪儿吗？”，“他穿着超人斗篷，这意味着你不需要告诉我该做什么。你想要世界向前发展？

source: Try love."
reference: 那么尝试去爱。”

source: His comments drew boos at least twice from the audience and SNL cast members appeared to be embarrassed, Variety reported, with one person there telling the publication: "The entire studio fell dead silent."
reference: 他的言论引来观众两次嘘声，而SNL演员也面露尴尬，《综艺》报道其中一人告诉发行人：“整个演播室一片寂静。”

source: West had been brought in as a late replacement for singer Ariana Grande, whose former boyfriend, the rapper Mac Miller had died a few days ago.
reference: 随后韦斯特被歌手爱莉安娜·格兰德换下，爱莉安娜·格兰的前男友、说唱歌手麦克·米勒于几天前去世。

source: West puzzled many with a performance of the song I Love it, dressed as a Perrier Bottle.
reference: 韦斯特在表演过程中打扮成巴黎水瓶的模样，这令许多人感到困惑。

source: West got backing from head of conservative group TPUSA, Candace Turner who tweeted: "To one of the most courageous spirits: THANK YOU FOR STANDING UP TO THE MOB."
reference: 此前韦斯特获得过保守团体TPUSA领袖坎迪斯·特纳的支持，坎迪斯·特纳曾发推特：“献给一个最勇敢的人：感谢你面对暴徒挺身而出。”

source: But talk show host Karen Hunter tweeted that West was simply "being who he is and that's absolutely wonderful."
reference: 但脱口秀主持人凯伦·亨特在推特上说，韦斯特只是“做他自己，这非常棒”。

source: "But I chose NOT to reward someone (by purchasing his music or clothing or supporting his "art") who I believe is embracing and spewing ideology that is harmful to my community.
reference: “我不会奖励某个人（通过购买他的音乐、衣服或支持他的“艺术”），我认为这是在支持并向我的团体传播有害的思想。

source: He is free.
reference: 他是自由的，

source: So are we," she added.
reference: 同样我们也是”她补充道。

source: Before the show, the rapper announced on Twitter that he had changed his name, saying that he was now "the being formally known as Kanye West."
reference: 在演出之前这名说唱歌手在推特上宣布，他改了名字，说他现在正式的名字叫坎耶·韦斯特。

source: He is not the first artist to change their name and follows in the footsteps of Diddy, also known as Puff Daddy, Puffy and P Diddy.
reference: 他并不是第一位改名的艺人，Diddy也曾使用Puff Daddy、Puffy和P Diddy等名字。

source: Fellow rapper, Snoop Dogg has had the name Snoop Lion and of course the late music legend Prince, changed his name to a symbol and then the artist previously known as Prince.
reference: 说唱歌手史努比·道格曾用名史奴比狮，已故音乐传奇王子更将其名字更改为符号，而这位艺人以前被称为王子。

source: Attempted murder charge over Belfast restaurant stabbing
reference: 贝尔法斯特面临餐厅内持刀杀人未遂指控

source: A 45-year-old man has been charged with attempted murder after a man was stabbed in a restaurant in east Belfast on Friday.
reference: 周五一名男子在东贝尔法斯特一家餐厅被刺伤，45岁的贝尔法斯特面临蓄意谋杀指控。

source: The incident happened in Ballyhackamore, police said.
reference: 警察透露，事故发生在Ballyhackamore。

source: The defendant is expected to appear before Belfast Magistrates' Court on Monday.
reference: 被告人应在周一贝尔法斯特地方法院开庭之前现身。

source: The charges will be reviewed by the Public Prosecution Service.
reference: 公诉机关将对这起指控进行审查。

source: Johnny English Strikes Again review - underpowered Rowan Atkinson spy spoof
reference: 憨豆特工3评论 - 罗温·艾金森扮演的特工笑点不足

source: It's traditional now to look for Brexit significances in any new film with a British slant and that does seem applicable to this revival of the Johnny English action-comedy spoof franchise - which started back in 2003 with Johnny English and spluttered back to life in 2011 with Johnny English Reborn.
reference: 如今从新电影中寻找英国脱欧的意义已经成为一种传统，而从这部强尼·英格力动作喜剧恶搞系列的回归也能看到这一传统的影子 - 强尼·英格力在2003年首次出现在荧幕，2011年再次回归。

source: Will tongue-in-cheek self-satire on the subject of how obviously rubbish we are be the nation's new export opportunity?
reference: 想一想会不会有一种声音半开玩笑地自我讽刺道，“我们居然成为了这个国家新的出口产品，难道真的没有能够拿得出手的产品了吗？

source: At any rate, the pop-eyed, rubber-faced incompetent Johnny English has had his licence to cock things up renewed for the second time - that name of his signalling more than anything else that he is a broad comic creation designed for non-English-speaking cinemagoing territories.
reference: 无论如何，那个瞪着眼睛、板着脸、不称职的强尼·英格力又一次获得了把事情搞砸的许可 - 强尼·英格力已经成为非英语电影爱好者漫画作品中经常出现的名字，很显然这个名字暗含深意。

source: He is of course the daft secret agent who despite his bizarre pretensions to smoothie glamour has got a little bit of Clouseau, a dash of Mr Bean and a dollop of that chap contributing a single note to the Chariots of Fire theme tune at the London 2012 Olympics opening ceremony.
reference: 这个人肯定是个愚蠢的特工，尽管他举止优雅的背后透露出奇怪做作，但还是可以从他的身上找到一点克鲁索、一点憨豆先生以及2012年伦敦奥运会开幕式为《火战车》主题曲贡献了一个音符的多乐普的影子。

source: He's also originally based on the traveller and international man of mystery Atkinson once played in the now forgotten Barclaycard TV ads, leaving chaos in his wake.
reference: 强尼最初也是以旅行者、国际人物、神秘的艾金森为原型，曾经的他在已被遗忘的巴克莱卡电视广告中出演过 - 那个清醒时身后留下一片混乱的人物。

source: There are one or two nice moments in this latest JE outing.
reference: 在强尼离开时有一个或两个美好的瞬间让我印象深刻。

source: I loved Johnny English approaching a helicopter while dressed in a medieval suit of armour and the rotor blades briefly clanging against his helmet.
reference: 我喜欢强尼·英格力接近一架直升机时身穿中世纪盔甲，旋翼叶片在头盔上叮当作响的场景。

source: Atkinson's gift for physical comedy is on display, but the humour feels pretty underpowered and weirdly superfluous, especially as the "serious" film brands like 007 and Mission Impossible themselves now confidently offer comedy as an ingredient.
reference: 在荧幕中艾金森拥有身体式喜剧天赋，但这种幽默现在令人感觉笑点不足而且奇怪、多余，特别是类似007和碟中谍这样“严肃”的电影情节也理所当然地加入了喜剧元素。

source: The humour feels as if it is pitched at kids rather than adults, and for me Johnny English's wacky misadventures aren't as inventive and focused as Atkinson's silent-movie gags in the persona of Bean.
reference: 这种幽默形式给人的感觉好像只适合孩子而不适合成年人，从我个人的角度我觉得强尼·英格力古怪的冒险经历并不像艾金森在无声电影《憨豆先生》中扮演的角色那样有新意并且重点突出。

source: The perennially topical premise now is that Great Britain is in serious trouble.
reference: 故事的背景是英国陷入了严重的困境。

source: A cyber-hacker has infiltrated Britain's super-secret web network of spies, revealing the identities of all Britain's agents in the field, to the dismay of the agent on duty - a regrettably small role for Kevin Eldon.
reference: 有网络黑客侵入了英国超级机密特工网络，所有英国特工的身份均悉数曝光，这令代理人 - 凯文·埃尔登饰演的小角色很是惊慌。

source: It's the last straw for a prime minister who is a pompous and embattled figure, already suffering a complete meltdown of political unpopularity: Emma Thompson does her very best with this quasi-Teresa-May character but there's nothing much in the script to work with.
reference: 剧中自大并且四面树敌的首相在政治上已经举步维艰，抓住内奸成了她最后一根救命稻草：埃玛·汤普森很好地演绎了这位类似特雷莎·梅的首相，但剧本中并没有太多涉及这位首相的剧情。

source: Her intelligence advisers inform her that as every single active spy has been compromised, she will have to bring someone out of retirement.
reference: 她的情报顾问告诉她，由于所有在职的特工都暴露了，因此她不得不委派退休的退工来执行任务。

source: And that means bumbling Johnny English himself, now employed as a schoolmaster in some posh establishment, but giving off-the-record lessons in how to be an undercover operative: some nice gags here, as English offers a School of Rock-type academy of spying.
reference: 此时，笨手笨脚的强尼·英格力现在是一家皇家学校的教师，但私底下他会秘密教授一些秘密特工的课程：英格力在严肃的学校内教授特工课时有一些有趣的情节。

source: English is whisked back to Whitehall for an emergency briefing and reunited with his former long-suffering sidekick Bough, played again by Ben Miller.
reference: 英格力飞奔回白厅听取紧急情况简报，并与此前同他长期受苦的伙伴、由本·米勒饰演的鲍夫重聚。

source: Bough is now a married man, hitched to a submarine commander, a jolly-hockey-sticks role in which Vicki Pepperdine is a bit wasted.
reference: 鲍夫现在是一位已婚男人，此前结识了一名热情的潜艇指挥官，薇琪·佩珀代因饰演指挥官这多少有些屈才。

source: So the Batman and Robin of getting things terribly wrong on Her Majesty's Secret Service are back in action, encountering Olga Kurylenko's beautiful femme fatale Ophelia Bulletova.
reference: 蝙蝠侠和罗宾组合在女王陛下的特勤局中犯了严重错误之后又重新开始了行动，随后遇见了欧嘉·柯瑞兰寇饰演的美女欧菲莉亚Bulletova。

source: Meanwhile, the prime minister is falling dangerously under the spell of the charismatic tech billionaire who claims he can solve Britain's computer woes: the sinister Jason Volta, played by Jake Lacy.
reference: 与此同时，由杰克·莱西饰演的表面魅力十足、暗地里阴险狠毒的科技业亿万富翁杰森·沃尔塔声称他能解决英国的电脑问题，而首相在他的魅力攻势下陷入了危险境地。

source: English and Bough begin their odyssey of farcical high-jinks: disguised as waiters, they set fire to a flash French restaurant; they create mayhem smuggling themselves aboard Volta's luxury yacht; and English triggers pure anarchy as he attempts to use a Virtual Reality headset to familiarise himself with the interior of Volta's house.
reference: 英格力与鲍夫开始了他们滑稽的冒险之旅：他们化装成服务员，放火烧毁了一家华丽的法国餐馆；他们登上沃尔特豪华游艇制造混乱；英格力尝试使用一个虚拟现实耳机熟悉沃尔特房间内部布局引起了一片混乱。

source: All the stops are certainly pulled out for that last sequence, but as amiable and boisterous as it is, there's quite a bit of kids' TV about the whole thing.
reference: 在最后一个片段中所有的一切戛然而止，但它是如此的亲切、热闹，整件事很像是儿童电视节目才有的情节。

source: Pretty moderate stuff.
reference: 剧情非常温和。

source: And as with the other Johnny English films I couldn't help thinking: can't the British film industry give Rowan Atkinson a role that really does justice to his talent?
reference: 该剧与其他约翰尼·英格利斯的电影比较类似，我禁不住想了想：难道英国电影业真的不能给罗温·艾金森一个真正能体现他才华的角色吗？

source: Lindsey Graham, John Kennedy tell "60 Minutes" whether the FBI's investigation of Kavanaugh could change their minds
reference: 林赛·格雷厄姆和约翰·肯尼迪在《60分钟》表示联邦调查局对卡瓦诺的调查是否会改变他们的想法

source: The FBI investigation into accusations against Judge Brett Kavanaugh has delayed a final vote on his nomination to the Supreme Court by at least a week, and raises the question of whether the bureau's findings could sway any Republican senators into pulling their support.
reference: 联邦调查局对布雷特·卡瓦诺法官的指控调查已导致他的最高法院提名最终投票日期推迟了至少一周，这便出现了一个问题，即联邦调查局的调查结果是否会动摇共和党参议员对布雷特·卡瓦诺的支持。

source: In an interview airing Sunday, "60 Minutes" correspondent Scott Pelley asked Republicans Sens. John Kennedy and Lindsey Graham whether the FBI could unearth anything that would lead them to change their minds.
reference: 在周日访谈中，《60分钟》记者斯科特·佩利向共和党参议院约翰·肯尼迪和林赛·格雷厄姆提问，FBI能否挖出可能导致他们改变主意的材料呢。

source: Kennedy appeared more open than his colleague from South Carolina.
reference: 肯尼迪看起来比他的南卡罗莱纳州的同事更善言谈。

source: "I mean, of course," said Kennedy.
reference: 肯尼迪说，“当然了，我的意思是”。

source: "I said going into the hearing, I said, I've talked to Judge Kavanaugh.
reference: “我说过参见听证会并且我与卡瓦诺法官交谈过。

source: I called him after this happened, that allegation came out, said, 'Did you do it?'
reference: 在这件事发生后，我给他打过电话并问他‘你做过这件事吗？’

source: He was resolute, determined, unequivocal."
reference: 他十分坚决地予以否认。”

source: Graham's vote, however, appears set in stone.
reference: 对格雷厄姆的投票似乎不会再变化。

source: "My mind's made up about Brett Kavanaugh and it would take a dynamite accusation," he said.
reference: “布雷特·卡瓦诺虽然遭遇了爆炸性的指控，我已下了决心”他说。

source: "Dr. Ford, I don't know what happened, but I know this: Brett denied it vigorously," Graham added, referring to Christine Blasey Ford.
reference: “福特博士，我不知道发生了什么，但我知道：布雷特坚决否认”。随后格雷厄姆补充道，福特指的是克里斯汀·布莱西·福特。

source: "And everybody she names couldn't verify it.
reference: “她提供的所有人都无法证实这一点。

source: It's 36 years old.
reference: 她已经36岁了。

source: I don't see anything new changing."
reference: 我没有看到任何新的变化。”

source: Elizabeth Warren Will Take "Hard Look" At Running For President in 2020, Massachusetts Senator Says
reference: 马萨诸塞州参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦表示将“认真考虑”参加2020年的总统竞选

source: Massachusetts Senator Elizabeth Warren said on Saturday she would take a "hard look" at running for president following the midterm elections.
reference: 马萨诸塞州参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦在周六表示，她将“认真考虑”在中期选举中竞选总统。

source: During a town hall in Holyoke, Massachusetts, Warren confirmed she'd consider running.
reference: 在马萨诸塞州霍约克镇的市政厅里，沃伦确认将考虑竞选。

source: "It's time for women to go to Washington and fix our broken government and that includes a woman at the top," she said, according to The Hill.
reference: 根据国会山报透露，沃伦曾表示“是时候让女性包括高层女性，去华盛顿修复我们支离破碎的政府了”。

source: "After November 6, I will take a hard look at running for president."
reference: “11月6日之后我将认真考虑竞选总统。”

source: Warren weighed in on President Donald Trump during the town hall, saying he was "taking this county in the wrong direction.
reference: 沃伦在市政厅表达了对唐纳德·特朗普总统的看法，她表示唐纳德·特朗普总统“将这个国家引向了错误的方向”。

source: "I am worried down to my bones about what Donald Trump is doing to our democracy," she said.
reference: “对于唐纳德·特朗普对我们民主党所做的一切，我深感担忧，”她说。

source: Warren has been outspoken in her criticism of Trump and his Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh.
reference: 沃伦始终直言不讳地批评特朗普以及他提名的最高法院候选人布雷特·卡瓦诺。

source: In a tweet on Friday, Warren said "of course we need an FBI investigation before voting."
reference: 周五沃伦发表推特称“在投票之前我们当然需要联邦调查局介入调查”。

source: A poll released on Thursday, however, showed a majority of Warren's own constituents do not think she should run in 2020.
reference: 根据周四公布的一项民意调查显示，沃伦的大部分选民认为她不应该参与2020年的竞选。

source: Fifty-eight percent of "likely" Massachusetts voters said the senator should not run, according to the Suffolk University Political Research Center/Boston Globe poll.
reference: 根据萨福克大学政治研究中心/波士顿环球民意调查显示，58%“认为可能竞选”的马萨诸塞州的选民表示，参议员不应该参加竞选。

source: Thirty-two percent supported such a run.
reference: 32%支持参议员竞选。

source: The poll showed more support for a run by former Governor Deval Patrick, with 38 percent supporting a potential run and 48 percent against it.
reference: 而民意调查显示，更多的人支持前州长德瓦尔·帕特里克参加竞选 - 有38%的人支持竞选，48%的人反对竞选。

source: Other high profile Democratic names discussed in regard to a potential 2020 run include former Vice President Joe Biden and Vermont Senator Bernie Sanders.
reference: 关于2020年潜在竞选者，此前已讨论过其他备受瞩目的民主党竞选者，包括前副总统乔·拜登和佛蒙特州参议员伯尼·桑德斯。

source: Biden said he would decide officially by January, the Associated Press reported.
reference: 美联社报道称，拜登表示他将在明年1月正式做出决定。

source: 18 states, D.C. support challenge to new asylum policy
reference: 华盛顿哥伦比亚特区和18个州支持挑战新庇护政策

source: Eighteen states and the District of Columbia are supporting a legal challenge to a new U.S. policy that denies asylum to victims fleeing gang or domestic violence.
reference: 哥伦比亚特区和18个州支持对美国新政策中关于拒绝向逃离帮派或家庭暴力的受害者提供庇护提出法律挑战。

source: Representatives from the 18 states and the district filed a friend-of-the-court brief Friday in Washington to support an asylum-seeker challenging the policy, NBC News reported.
reference: 据美国国家广播公司(NBC)报道，来自18个州和地区的代表周五在华盛顿提交了一份“法庭之友”案情摘要，以支持一名寻求庇护者挑战新庇护政策。

source: The full name of the plaintiff in the Grace v. Sessions suit that the American Civil Liberties Union filed in August against the federal policy has not been revealed.
reference: 原告姓名为格蕾丝v。塞申斯提起诉讼称美国公民自由联盟于今年8月提交的反对联邦政策申请的消息未被披露。

source: She said her partner "and his violent gang member sons," abused her but U.S. officials denied her request for asylum July 20.
reference: 她说她的伴侣“和他的黑帮成员儿子”虐待她，但美国官员在7月20日拒绝了她的庇护请求。

source: She was detained in Texas.
reference: 随后她被扣留在德克萨斯州。

source: The states' attorneys supporting Grace described El Salvador, Honduras and Guatemala, which produce a large number of applicants for U.S. asylum, as nations facing pervasive problems with gangs and domestic violence.
reference: 根据支持格雷斯的州律师陈述，萨尔瓦多、洪都拉斯和危地马拉有大量因面临帮派和家庭暴力问题而申请美国庇护的人。

source: The new U.S. asylum policy reversed a 2014 decision by the Board of Immigrant Appeals that allowed undocumented immigrants fleeing domestic violence to apply for asylum.
reference: 美国新庇护政策推翻了移民上诉委员会于2014年做出的关于允许逃避家庭暴力的非法移民申请庇护的决定。

source: District of Columbia Attorney General Karl Racine said in a statement Friday that the new policy "ignores decades of state, federal, and international law."
reference: 哥伦比亚特区司法部长卡尔·拉辛于周五在一份声明中说道，此项新政策“无视几十年的州法律、联邦法律和国际法律”。

source: "Federal law requires that all asylum claims be adjudicated on the particular facts and circumstances of the claim, and such a bar violates that principle," the friend-of-the court brief said.
reference: 法庭之友摘要中这样写道，“联邦法律规定，所有庇护申请必须根据申请的具体事实和情况作出裁定，显然新政策违反了这一原则”。

source: Attorneys further argued in the brief that the policy denying immigrants entry hurts the U.S. economy, saying they are more likely to become entrepreneurs and "supply necessary labor."
reference: 格蕾丝律师在摘要中进一步陈述，拒绝移民入境的政策将损害美国经济，这些移民很有可能成为企业家或者能够“提供必要的劳动力”。

source: Attorney General Jeff Sessions ordered immigration judges to no longer grant asylum to victims fleeing domestic abuse and gang violence in June.
reference: 司法部长杰夫·塞申斯要求移民法官不再向6月份躲避家庭暴力和帮派暴力的受害者提供庇护。

source: "Asylum is available for those who leave their home country because of persecution or fear on account of race, religion, nationality, or membership in a particular social group or political opinion," Sessions said in his June 11 announcement of the policy.
reference: 塞申斯在其6月11日宣布这项政策时说，“在特定的社会或政治群体中，因种族、宗教、国籍或成员身份而遭受迫害或受到威胁离开本国的人都可以得到庇护”。

source: Asylum was never meant to alleviate all problems -- even all serious problems -- that people face every day all over the world.
reference: 庇护从来不能缓和所有问题 - 甚至包括严重的问题，也包括全世界所有人每天要面对的问题。

source: Desperate rescue efforts in Palu as death toll doubles in race to find survivors
reference: 寻找幸存者的救援工作因帕鲁死亡人数增加一倍而陷入绝望

source: For survivors, the situation was increasingly dire.
reference: 情况对于幸存者来说变得越来越糟。

source: "It feels very tense," said 35-year-old mother Risa Kusuma, comforting her feverish baby boy at an evacuation centre in the gutted city of Palu.
reference: 在一片废墟的帕鲁市，一位35岁名叫Risa Kusuma的妈妈正在疏散中心安慰发烧的男婴，她说“感觉很紧张”，

source: "Every minute an ambulance brings in bodies.
reference: “每分钟都有救护车送来尸体。

source: Clean water is scarce."
reference: 清洁的水极为紧缺。”

source: Residents were seen returning to their destroyed homes, picking through waterlogged belongings, trying to salvage anything they could find.
reference: 居民们返回了他们被摧毁的家园，他们在浸水的物品中不断搜索着，试图打捞他们能找到的任何东西。

source: Hundreds of people were injured and hospitals, damaged by the magnitude 7.5 quake, were overwhelmed.
reference: 这场7.5级地震中导致数百人受伤，医院被损毁和淹没。

source: Some of the injured, including Dwi Haris, who suffered a broken back and shoulder, rested outside Palu's Army Hospital, where patients were being treated outdoors due to continuing strong aftershocks.
reference: 一些伤者，包括德维·哈里斯在内，因背部和肩膀受伤在帕鲁陆军医院外休息，而由于持续不断的强烈余震，这些伤者只能在户外接受治疗。

source: Tears filled his eyes as he recounted feeling the violent earthquake shake the fifth-floor hotel room he shared with his wife and daughter.
reference: 当德维·哈里斯说起与妻子和女儿同住的酒店房间受强烈地震影响而震动时，德维·哈里斯眼中充满了泪水，。

source: "There was no time to save ourselves.
reference: “我们没有时间自救。

source: I was squeezed into the ruins of the wall, I think," Haris told Associated Press, adding that his family was in town for a wedding.
reference: 我想我当时是被挤进了墙的废墟中，”哈里斯告诉美联社，他补充说他的家人当时正在城里举行婚礼。

source: "I heard my wife cry for help, but then silence.
reference: “我听到我的妻子在呼救，随后便安静了”。

source: I don't know what happened to her and my child.
reference: 我不知道她和我的孩子情况如何。

source: I hope they are safe."
reference: 我希望他们一切平安。”

source: Republicans Alienating Women Voters Ahead of Midterms With Kavanaugh Debacle, Analysts Warn
reference: 分析人士警告称，共和党在中期选举之前疏远女性选民将导致卡瓦诺惨败

source: As many top Republicans stand-by and defend Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh in the face of several allegations of sexual assault, analyst have warned they will see a backlash, particularly from women, during the upcoming midterm elections.
reference: 在最高法院大法官候选人布雷特·卡瓦诺面临若干项性侵犯指控时，许多共和党高层置若罔闻甚至为其辩护，分析人士警告称，他们将在即将到来的中期选举中面临来自女性等群体强烈反弹。

source: The emotions surrounding this have been extremely high, and most Republicans are on record already showing they wanted to go forward with a vote.
reference: 围绕此事选民的情绪一直非常高涨，大多数共和党人已经表示他们想要尽快展开投票。

source: Those things can't be walked back," Grant Reeher, a professor of political science at Syracuse University's Maxwell School told The Hill for an article published Saturday.
reference: 雪域大学麦克斯韦学院政治学教授格兰特·里赫针对周六发表的某文章向国会山报表示希尔，“有些事情不能重蹈覆辙”。

source: Reeher said he doubts Senator Jeff Flake's (R-Arizona) last-minute push for an FBI investigation will be enough to placate angry voters.
reference: 里赫称，他怀疑参议员杰夫·弗雷克（亚利桑那州共和党人）在最后时刻推动联邦调查局调查能否平息选民们的愤怒。

source: "Women are not going to forget what happened yesterday - they are not going to forget it tomorrow and not in November," Karine Jean-Pierre, a senior adviser and national spokeswoman for the progressive group MoveOn said on Friday, according to the Washington, D.C. newspaper.
reference: 据华盛顿特区报纸报道进步组织MoveOn高级顾问兼国家发言人卡莉纳·吉恩·皮埃尔周五表示，“女性选民不会忘记昨天发生的事 - 这件事她们明天不会忘记，11月份也不会忘记”。

source: On Friday morning, protestors chanted "November is coming!" as they demonstrated in the hallway of the Senate as the Republicans controlling the Judiciary Committee chose to move forward with Kavanaugh's nomination despite the testimony of Dr. Christine Blasey Ford, Mic reported.
reference: 据Mic报道周五上午，抗议者在参议院走廊上示威并高呼“11月来了！”。此前克里斯汀·布拉西·福特博士已经提交了相关证据，但控制司法委员会的共和党人仍坚持提名卡瓦诺。

source: "Democratic enthusiasm and motivation is going to be off the chart," Stu Rothenberg, a nonpartisan political analyst, told the news site.
reference: 无党派政治分析人士斯图·罗森伯格在新闻网站表示，“民主党人的热情和动力高得异乎寻常”。

source: "People are saying it's already been high; that's true.
reference: “实际上人们认为其过高；这也是事实”。

source: But it could be higher, particularly among swing women voters in the suburbs and younger voters, 18- to 29-year-olds, who while they don't like the president, often don't vote."
reference: 但这种情绪可能会越发高涨，尤其是生活在郊外立场摇摆不定的女性选民以及18至29岁的年轻选民，她们虽然不喜欢总统但她们也不会经常参与投票。”

source: Even before Ford's public testimony detailing her allegations of sexual assault against the Supreme Court nominee, analysts suggested a backlash could follow if Republicans pushed forward with the confirmation.
reference: 即使在福特公开证据详细说明她对最高法院的性侵犯指控之前，分析人士也表示，若共和党人推进提名确认，可能引发强烈反弹。

source: "This has become a muddled mess for the GOP," said Michael Steele, former chairman of the Republican National Committee, early last week, according to NBC News.
reference: 据NBC新闻报道，共和党全国委员会前主席迈克尔·斯蒂尔上周早些时候表示，“局面对于共和党来说已经非常混乱”。

source: "It's just not about the committee vote or the final vote or whether Kavanaugh is put on the bench, it's also about the way Republicans have handled this and how they have treated her," Guy Cecil, director of Priorities USA, a group that helps to elect Democrats, pointed out to the news channel.
reference: 协助选举民主党人的“美国优先”组织负责人盖伊·塞西尔在新闻频道中指出，“这不单纯是委员会投票或最终投票，也不是卡瓦诺是否被选为大法官的投票，它体现的是共和党人处理此事的方式以及共和党人如何对待福特”。

source: However, Americans appear to be somewhat split over who to believe in the wake of Ford's and Kavanaugh's testimonies, with slightly more siding with the latter.
reference: 然而，美国人似乎在该相信福特的证词还是卡瓦诺的证词这个问题上存在一些分歧，实际情况略微更有利于后者。

source: A new poll from YouGov shows that 41 percent of respondents definitely or probably believed Ford's testimony, while 35 percent said they definitely or probably believed Kavanaugh.
reference: 但根据YouGov的一项最新调查显示，41%的受访者表示相信或可能相信福特的证词，而35%的受访者表示相信或可能相信卡瓦诺。

source: Additionally, 38 percent said they thought Kavanaugh has probably or definitely lied during his testimony, while just 30 percent said the same about Ford.
reference: 另外，在卡瓦诺提供证词期间，有38%的人表示他们认为卡瓦诺很可能或肯定在说谎，而只有30%的人认为福特很可能或肯定在说谎。

source: After the push from Flake, the FBI is currently investigating the allegations brought forward by Ford as well as at least one other accuser, Deborah Ramirez, The Guardian reported.
reference: 据《卫报》报道，在弗莱克的推动下，联邦调查局目前正在调查福特以及至少另一名原告黛博拉·拉米雷斯提出的指控。

source: Ford testified before the Senate Judiciary Committee under oath last week that Kavanaugh drunkenly assaulted her at the age of 17.
reference: 上周在参议院司法委员会宣誓就职之前，福特证实在她17岁时卡瓦诺醉酒状态下袭击了她。

source: Ramirez alleges that the Supreme Court nominee exposed his genitals to her while they attended a party during their time studying at Yale in the 1980s.
reference: 拉米雷斯则声称，他们于20世纪80年代在耶鲁学习期间参加一个派对时，最高法院提名人向她暴露了他的生殖器。

source: The Inventor of the World Wide Web Plans to Start a New Internet to Take on Google and Facebook
reference: 万维网的发明者计划建立新的互联网以取代谷歌和Facebook

source: Tim Berners-Lee, the inventor of the World Wide Web, is launching a startup that seeks to rival Facebook, Amazon and Google.
reference: 目前万维网发明者蒂姆·伯纳斯·李成立了一家创业公司，试图与脸书、亚马逊和谷歌展开竞争。

source: The technology legend's latest project, Inrupt, is a company that builds off of Berners-Lee's open source platform Solid.
reference: 这位科技传奇人物的最新项目 - Inrupt，是伯纳斯·李专为推动开放源代码平台Solid发展而成立的公司。

source: Solid allows users to choose where their data is stored and what people are allowed to have access to what information.
reference: Solid允许用户选择数据存储的位置，以及决定哪些人可以访问哪些信息。

source: In an exclusive interview with Fast Company, Berners-Lee joked that the intent behind Inrupt is "world domination."
reference: 在与“快速公司”的独家采访中，伯纳斯·李开玩地笑说，Inrupt成立的背后意在“统治世界”。

source: "We have to do it now," he said of the startup.
reference: 在采访开始时他说“我必须现在去做”。

source: "It's a historical moment."
reference: “这是历史性的时刻”。

source: The app uses Solid's technology to allow people to create their own "personal online data store" or a POD.
reference: 此款应用采用了Solid技术，用户可创建属于自己的“个人在线数据存储库”或POD。

source: It can contain contact lists, to-do lists, calendar, music library and other personal and professional tools.
reference: 它可以存储通讯录、待办事项、日历、音乐库以及其他个人及专业工具。

source: It's like Google Drive, Microsoft Outlook, Slack and Spotify are all available on one browser and all at the same time.
reference: 它类似于Google Drive、Microsoft Outlook、Slack和 Spotify，这些工具可以同时在一个浏览器中使用。

source: What's unique about the personal online data store is that it is completely up to the user who can access what kind of information.
reference: 个人在线数据存储的独特之处在于，用户完全有权力决定哪些人可以访问哪些信息。

source: The company calls it "personal empowerment through data."
reference: 该公司认为它的作用是“通过数据赋予个人权力”。

source: The idea for Inrupt, according to the company's CEO John Bruce, is for the company to bring resources, process and appropriate skills to help make Solid available to everyone.
reference: 该公司的首席执行官约翰·布鲁斯表示，Inrupt的意义在于为公司带来资源、流程以及合适的技能，确保每个人都能够使用Solid。

source: The company currently consists of Berners-Lee, Bruce, a security platform bought by IBM, some on-staff developers contracted to work on the project, and a community of volunteer coders.
reference: 该公司目前由伯纳斯·李、布鲁斯、IBM收购的安全平台、一些签约参与该项目的在职开发人员，以及一个由志愿程序员组成的团体所组成。

source: Starting this week, technology developers around the world could create their own decentralized apps using the tools available on the Inrupt website.
reference: 从本周开始，世界各地的技术开发人员都可以利用Inrupt网站上可用的工具创建属于自己的分散式应用程序。

source: Berners-Lee said that he and his team are not talking to "Facebook and Google about whether or not to introduce a complete change where all their business models are completely upended overnight.
reference: 伯纳斯·李表示，他和他的团队并没有与“脸书和谷歌”讨论是否要掀起一次变革，在一夜之间彻底颠覆所有的商业模式。

source: "We are not asking their permission."
reference: “我们没有征得他们的同意。”

source: In a post on Medium published on Saturday, Berners-Lee wrote that Inrupt's "mission is to provide commercial energy and an ecosystem to help protect the integrity and quality of the new web built on Solid."
reference: 伯纳斯·李于周六在Medium发表的一篇文章中写道，Inrupt的任务是提供“商业活力”和生态系统以帮助保证基于Solid的新网络的完整性和质量。”

source: In 1994, Berners-Lee transformed the Internet when he established the World Wide Web Consortium at Massachusetts Institute of Technology.
reference: 1994年伯纳斯·李在麻省理工学院建立了万维网联盟，从此改变了互联网。

source: In recent months, Berners-Lee has been an influential voice in the net neutrality debate.
reference: 在最近的几个月中，伯纳斯·李一直是网络中立性辩论中颇具影响力的人物。

source: Even while launching Inrupt, Berners-Lee will remain the Founder and Director of World Wide Web Consortium, the Web Foundation and the Open Data Institute.
reference: 即便创建Inrupt，伯纳斯·李也仍然是万维网联盟、网络基金会和开放数据研究所的创始人兼董事。

source: "I'm incredibly optimistic for this next era of the web," Berners-Lee added.
reference: 另外，伯纳斯·李补充道，“我对下一个网络时代持非常乐观的态度”。

source: Bernard Vann: WW1 Victoria Cross cleric celebrated
reference: 纪念伯纳德·范恩：在第一次世界大战中获得维多利亚十字勋章的牧师

source: The only Church of England cleric to win a Victoria Cross during World War One as a combatant has been celebrated in his hometown 100 years on.
reference: 他是唯一一位身为英格兰教会牧师在一战中获得维多利亚十字勋章的战士，100年来他的家乡始终没有忘记这位英雄。

source: Lt Col The Reverend Bernard Vann won the award on 29 September 1918 in the attack at Bellenglise and Lehaucourt.
reference: 1918年9月29日伯纳德·范恩中校在进攻贝灵格利斯和勒豪科特的战役中获得此殊荣。

source: However, he was killed by a sniper four days later and never knew he had won the highest British military honour.
reference: 但四天后他被一名狙击手击毙，而他从来不知道自己赢得了英国最高军事荣誉。

source: A commemorative stone was unveiled by his two grandsons at a parade in Rushden, Northamptonshire, on Saturday.
reference: 周六在北安普敦郡拉什登举行的游行上，他的两个孙子为其纪念石揭幕。

source: One of his grandsons, Michael Vann, said it was "brilliantly symbolic" the stone would be revealed exactly 100 years on from his grandfather's award-winning feat.
reference: 伯纳德·范恩其中一位孙子迈克·范恩表示，在距离他祖父获奖100年的今天为这款纪念石揭幕“极具象征意义”。

source: According to the London Gazette, on 29 September 1918 Lt Col Vann led his battalion across the Canal de Saint-Quentin "through a very thick fog and under heavy fire from field and machine guns."
reference: 根据伦敦公报的报道，1918年9月29日，范恩中校率领他的部队“冒着战场大火和机枪的扫射下穿过浓雾”跨过圣康坦运河。

source: He later rushed up to the firing line and with the "greatest gallantry" led the line forward before rushing a field-gun single-handed and knocked out three of the detachment.
reference: 后来他冲向火线凭借“非凡的勇气”带领队伍前进，随后三名队员被击晕，他单独一人推着野战炮行进。

source: Lt Col Vann was killed by a German sniper on 4 October 1918 - just over a month before the war ended.
reference: 1918年10月4日范恩中校被德国狙击手击毙，此时距离战争结束只有一个多月。

source: Michael Vann, 72, said his grandfather's actions were "something that I know that I could never live up to but something which is humbling."
reference: 对于祖父的壮举，72岁的迈克·范恩表示“我知道我永远无法做到，这令我感到很是羞愧”。

source: He and his brother Dr James Vann also laid a wreath after the parade, which was led by the Brentwood Imperial Youth Band.
reference: 游行结束后，他和他的兄弟詹姆斯·范恩博士在布伦特伍德皇家青年乐队引领下也献上了花圈。

source: Michael Vann said he was "feeling very honoured to play a part in the parade" and added "the valour of a genuine hero is being demonstrated by the support that is going to be given by a lot of people."
reference: 迈克·范恩表示，“他很荣幸能参加此次游行”，他还补充道，“一位真正的英雄会有很多人证明他的英勇壮举”。

source: MMA fans stayed up all night to watch Bellator 206, they got Peppa Pig instead
reference: MMA粉丝们等候《Bellator 206》一整晚结果等来的却是《小猪佩奇》

source: Imagine this, you have stayed up all night to watch the a packed Bellator 206 only to be denied watching the main event.
reference: 想象一下，你为了看《Bellator 206》整晚没睡结果却被拒绝观看主赛事。

source: The bill from San Jose contained 13 fights, including six on the main card and was being shown live through the night in the UK on Channel 5.
reference: 这份由圣何塞发布的节目单包含13场比赛，其中主卡上有六场，英国第5频道在整个夜间进行现场直播。

source: At 6am, just as Gegard Mousasi and Rory MacDonald were preparing to face each other, viewers in the UK were left stunned when the coverage changed to Peppa Pig.
reference: 上午6点正是吉加德·莫萨西和罗里·麦克唐纳准备碰面准备比赛的时候，英国的观众在看到播放内容改为《小猪佩奇》时都惊呆了。

source: Some were unimpressed after they had stayed awake until the early hours especially for the fight.
reference: 有些观众一夜未睡并没有在意，直到凌晨时分比赛开始时他们才感觉不好。

source: One fan on Twitter described the switch to the children's cartoon as "some sort of sick joke."
reference: 某粉丝在推特上吐槽，切换到儿童卡通片“这样的玩笑开得有点过火”。

source: "It's government regulation that at 6 a.m. that content was not suitable so they had to switch to children's programming, " said Dave Schwartz, Bellator senior vice president of marketing and communication, when asked about the transmission.
reference: Bellator营销与传播高级副总裁戴夫·施瓦兹被问及为什么切换节目时，他回答说“上午6点是政府管制时间，《Bellator 206》内容不适合在这个时间播放，因此他们不得不切换到儿童节目”，

source: ""Peppa the pig," yes."
reference: “小猪佩奇？”“ 是的。”

source: Bellator company president Scott Coker said that they are going to work on their scheduling to include UK viewers in the future.
reference: Bellator公司总裁斯科特·科克表示，他们正打算将英国观众纳入播放计划。

source: "I think that when I think about the replay, I think that we can probably work it out," Coker said.
reference: “我想重播也许能解决这个问题”科克说，

source: "But it's six in the morning on a Sunday there and we won't be able to work this out until Sunday our time, Monday their time.
reference: “当时是周日早上六点，于我们而言周日之前我们没有办法解决这个问题，只能等到他们周一才能处理。

source: But we are working on it.
reference: 关于这个问题我们正在努力解决。

source: Believe me, when it switched over there were a lot of texts going back and forth and they all were not friendly.
reference: 相信我，当节目切换时，会显示很多不友好的文字。

source: We were trying to fix it, we thought it was a technical glitch.
reference: 我们试图修复它，我们认为这是一个技术故障。

source: But it wasn't, it was a governmental issue.
reference: 但其实这不是技术故障而是政府的问题。

source: I can promise you the next time it's not going to happen.
reference: 我可以承诺，这样的情况不会再次发生。

source: We'll keep it down to five fights instead of six - like we normally do - and we tried to overdeliver for the fans and we just went over.
reference: 我们会将比赛从六场减至五场 - 就像平常一样 - 我们努力为粉丝提供更多精彩内容，正如我们刚才说过的，

source: It's an unfortunate situation."
reference: 对于出现这样的情况我深感遗憾。”

source: Out-of-form Mickelson benched on Ryder Cup Saturday
reference: 周六状态不佳的米克尔森在莱德杯上坐上了冷板凳

source: American Phil Mickelson will set a record on Sunday when he plays his 47th Ryder Cup match, but he will have to turn his form around to avoid it being an unhappy milestone.
reference: 美国人菲尔·米克尔森将在周日创造一项纪录 - 这是他第47次参加莱德杯比赛，但他必须调整他的比赛状态，否则此次比赛将成为他不愉快的记忆。

source: Mickelson, playing in the biennial event for a record 12th time, was benched by captain Jim Furyk for Saturday's fourballs and foursomes.
reference: 这是米克尔森第12次参加这项两年一度的比赛，在周六的四人四球比赛中米克尔森由队长吉姆·弗里克替补出场。

source: Instead of being at the center of the action, as he so often has been for the United States, the five-times major winner split his day between being a cheerleader and working on his game on the range in the hope of rectifying what ails him.
reference: 虽然他经常为美国队征战但他并不是队伍的核心，这位五次大满贯得主的一天被分成了两部分，一部分是充当啦啦队长，另一部分则是在球场上训练，球队希望借此解决困扰他的问题。

source: Never the straightest of drivers even at the peak of his career, the 48-year-old is not an ideal fit for the tight Le Golf National course, where the long rough routinely punishes errant shots.
reference: 米克尔森即使在职业生涯的巅峰时期也从来不是一位可靠的领导者，如今48岁的他不再适合在气氛紧张的国家高尔夫球场打球，在那里他经常习惯性地将球射偏。

source: And if the course on its own is not daunting enough, Mickelson, in the ninth match on Sunday, faces accurate British Open champion Francesco Molinari, who has teamed up with rookie Tommy Fleetwood to win all four of their matches this week.
reference: 如果练习本身不能令他保持谨慎的话，那么周日迎战英国公开赛冠军弗朗切斯科·莫利纳里的第九场比赛将是他一展身手的绝好机会。本周他与新秀汤米·弗利特伍德联手取得了四战全胜的良好战绩。

source: If the Americans, four points down starting the 12 singles matches, get off to a hot start, Mickelson's match could prove absolutely crucial.
reference: 如果美国队在开始的12场单人比赛中落后4分，那么米克尔森在比赛中的表现将至关重要。

source: Furyk expressed confidence in his man, not that he could say much else.
reference: 弗里克表示对他的队员有信心，但这并不意味着他还能说些别的。

source: "He fully understood the role that he had today, gave me a pat on the back and put his arm around me and said he would be ready tomorrow," Furyk said.
reference: “他完全理解他今天所扮演的角色，他拍了拍我的背并用胳膊搂住我，他说他明天就可以准备好了，”弗里克说。

source: "He's got a lot of confidence in himself.
reference: “显然他自信满满。

source: He's a Hall of Famer and he's added so much to these teams in the past, and this week.
reference: 他是名人堂成员，在过去和这一周内他为这些球队做出了很多贡献。

source: I probably didn't envision him playing two matches.
reference: 我没能想到他会打两场比赛。

source: I envisioned more, but that's the way it worked out and that's the way we thought we had to go.
reference: 我想了很多，但事情就是这样解决了，我们认为我们必须这样做。

source: He wants to be out there, just like everyone else."
reference: 他希望像其他人一样走出去。”

source: Mickelson will pass Nick Faldo's record for the most Ryder Cup matches played on Sunday.
reference: 周日米克尔森将打破尼克·法尔多创下的、莱德杯比赛场次最多的记录。

source: It could mark the end of a Ryder Cup career that has never quite matched the heights of his individual record.
reference: 这可能标志着他的莱德杯职业生涯从未达到他个人记录的高度。

source: Mickelson has 18 wins, 20 losses and seven halves, though Furyk said his presence brought some intangibles to the team.
reference: 米克尔森18胜20负7平，尽管如此弗里克仍表示他的出现给球队带来了一些无形资产。

source: "He's funny, he's sarcastic, witty, likes to poke fun at people, and he's a great guy to have in the team room," he explained.
reference: “他风趣、爱挖苦人、诙谐，喜欢开玩笑，他是一个很好的团队成员”他解释道。

source: "I think the younger players had fun having a go at him, as well, this week, which was fun to see.
reference: “我想年轻的球员们很享受和他一起比赛，当然这周的比赛看起来很有趣。

source: He provides a lot more than just play."
reference: 他出现的意义不完全在于比赛本身。”

source: Europe captain Thomas Bjorn knows big lead can soon disappear
reference: 欧洲队长托马斯·比约恩判断巨大的优势可能很快便会消失

source: Thomas Bjorn, the European captain, knows from experience that a sizeable lead heading into the last-day singles in the Ryder Cup can easily turn into an uncomfortable ride.
reference: 欧洲队长托马斯·比约恩根据经验判断，在莱德杯最后一天的单打比赛中此前的的领先优势很容易变为一次不愉快的记忆。

source: The Dane made his debut in the 1997 match at Valderrama, where a side captained by Seve Ballesteros held a five-point advantage over the Americans but only just got over the finishing line with their noses in front by the narrowest of margins, winning 14½-13½.
reference: 这位丹麦球员在1997年瓦尔德拉马的比赛中首次亮相，当时由塞夫·巴列斯特罗斯队长率领的球队比美国队领先5分，但他们最终只以微弱的优势14½-13½赢得了比赛。

source: "You keep reminding yourself that we had a big lead at Valderrama; we had a big lead at Brookline, where we lost, and at Valderrama, where we won, but only just," said Bjorn, pictured, after watching the Class of 2018 win 5-3 both on Friday and yesterday to lead 10-6 at Le Golf National.
reference: 比约恩于周五和昨天在国家高尔夫球场观看了两场2018年度比赛，两场比赛结果均为5-3并最终以10-6领先。之后他对队员说，“你们必须不断地提醒自己我们在瓦尔德拉马大比分领先，却以微弱优势取胜；我们在布鲁克林大比分领先，但结果我们却输掉了比赛”。

source: So history will show me and everybody on that team that this is not over.
reference: 因此历史已经向我和每一位队员证明了比赛还没有结束。

source: You go full bore tomorrow.
reference: 你们明天会很无聊。

source: Get out there and do all the right things.
reference: 但你们可以走出去做正确的事情。

source: This is not over till you've got the points on the board.
reference: 只有当计分板上显示最终分数比赛才算结束。

source: We have a goal, and that is to try to win this trophy, and that's where the focus stays.
reference: 我们的目标是努力赢得奖杯，这就是我们关注的事情。

source: I've said all along, I focus on the 12 players that are in our side, but we are so well aware of what's standing across on the other side - the greatest players in the world."
reference: 我一直在说，我们球队中的12名球员都是我关注的对象，但我也很清楚对面站的是谁 - 全球最伟大的球员。”

source: Delighted how his players have performed on a tough golf course, Bjorn added: "I would never get ahead of myself in this.
reference: 对于他的球员们在高尔夫球场上的表现，比约恩表示很高兴，他补充道：“这场比赛我绝不会操之过急。

source: Tomorrow's a different beast.
reference: 明天是另一番景象。

source: Tomorrow is the individual performances that come forward, and that is a different thing to do.
reference: 明天是个人之间的比拼，显然那是另一回事。

source: It's great to be out there with a partner when things are going good, but when you're out there individually, then you're tested to the full of your capacity as a golfer.
reference: 当一切进展顺利时，与同伴一起在球场上是一件很棒的事情。而当你独自在球场上时，你作为一名高尔夫球手则需要接受全方位的检验。

source: That's the message that you need to get across to players, is get the best out of yourself tomorrow.
reference: 你需要传达给球员的信息是明天你能做到最好。

source: Now, you leave your partner behind and he has to go and get the best out of himself, as well."
reference: 现在你的同伴落后于你，他需要做的是做最好的自己。”

source: In contrast to Bjorn, opposite number Jim Furyk will be looking for his players to perform better individually than they did as partners, the exceptions being Jordan Spieth and Justin Thomas, who picked up three points out of four.
reference: 与比约恩有所不同，吉姆·弗里克希望他的球员在个人比赛中的表现要比合作比赛表现更好，乔丹·斯皮思和贾斯汀·托马斯则是个例外，他们二人获得了四分中的三分。

source: Furyk himself has been on both ends of those big last-day turnarounds, having been part of the winning team at Brookline before ending up a loser as Europe pulled off the "Miracle at Medinah."
reference: 弗里克自己也在比赛的最后一天经历了大逆转，这是布鲁克林获胜球队经历的一部分，而在撤离欧洲“梅地那奇迹”之后这支球队最终落败。

source: "I remember every damn word of it," he said in reply to being asked how Ben Crenshaw, the captain in 1999, had rallied his players heading into the last day.
reference: 当他被问及1999年本·克兰肖队长是如何在比赛的最后一天团结他的队员时他回答“我现在记得当时的每一个细节”。

source: "We have 12 important matches tomorrow, but you'd like to get off to that fast start like you saw at Brookline, like you saw at Medinah.
reference: “我们第二天有12场重要比赛，但是你希望像在布鲁克林和梅地那看到的那样快速起步。

source: When that momentum gets going one way, it puts a lot of pressure on those middle matches.
reference: 当动量单向运动时，它会在中间部分造成很大的压力。

source: We set up our line-up accordingly and put the guys out in the fashion that we felt like, you know, we're trying to make some magic tomorrow."
reference: 我们安排了相应的阵容，让球员以自己喜欢的方式出场，你知道我们明天要努力创造奇迹。”

source: Thomas has been handed the task of trying to lead the fightback and faces Rory McIlroy in the top match, with Paul Casey, Justin Rose, Jon Rahm, Tommy Fleetwood and Ian Poulter the other Europeans in the top half of the order.
reference: 托马斯接到了带领球队努力反击的任务，他将在这场顶级比赛中直面罗里·麦克罗伊，以及保罗·凯西、贾斯汀·罗斯、乔恩·拉姆、汤米·弗利特伍德和伊恩·保尔特等其他榜单上顶部的欧洲球员。

source: "I went with this group of guys in this order because I think it covers all the way through," said Bjorn of his singles selections.
reference: 在单人比赛选人方面比约恩说，“我按照名单顺序配置队员，因为我认为这样覆盖更全面”。

source: Brexit: UK 'would forever regret' losing carmakers
reference: 英国脱欧：英国将因为失去汽车制造商而懊悔不已

source: The UK "would regret it forever" if it lost its status as a world leader in car manufacturing after Brexit, Business Secretary Greg Clark has said.
reference: 商务部长格雷格·克拉克表示，如果英国在脱欧之后失去全球汽车制造业领导者的地位，英国将“懊悔不已”。

source: He added it was "concerning" that Toyota UK had told the BBC that if Britain left the EU without a deal it would temporarily halt production at its factory in Burnaston, near Derby.
reference: 另外，他补充说丰田英国公司曾向英国广播公司表示，如果英国在未达成协议的情况下离开欧盟，丰田英国公司有可能暂停德比附近伯纳斯顿工厂的生产。

source: "We need a deal," Mr Clark said.
reference: “我们需要达成协议”，克拉克先生说。

source: The Japanese carmaker said the impact of border delays in the event of a no-deal Brexit could cost jobs.
reference: 这家日本汽车制造商表示，英国在未达成协议的情况下脱欧可能会导致工作岗位减少，从而对跨境生产造成影响。

source: The Burnaston plant - which makes Toyota's Auris and Avensis - produced nearly 150,000 cars last year of which 90% were exported to the rest of the European Union.
reference: 伯纳斯顿工厂主要制造丰田Auris和Avensis汽车，去年汽车产量近15万辆，其中90%出口到欧盟其他国家。

source: "My view is that if Britain crashes out of the EU at the end of March we will see production stops in our factory," said Marvin Cooke, Toyota's managing director at Burnaston.
reference: 伯纳斯顿丰田总经理马文·库克称，“我的观点是，如果英国在三月末退出欧盟，我们的工厂将停止生产”。

source: Other UK car manufacturers have raised fears about leaving the EU without agreement on how cross-border trade will function, including Honda, BMW and Jaguar Land Rover.
reference: 包括本田、宝马和捷豹路虎在内的其他英国汽车制造商也表示担忧 - 如果英国在未达成协议的情况下脱欧，今后如何维持正常的跨境贸易。

source: BMW, for example, says it will close its Mini plant in Oxford for a month following Brexit.
reference: 其中宝马公司表示，英国脱欧之后的一个月将关闭其在牛津市的迷你工厂。

source: The main concerns relate to what carmakers say are supply chain risks in the event of a no-deal Brexit.
reference: 英国汽车制造商主要担心英国在无法达成协议的情况下脱欧，其供应链可能会遭受冲击。

source: Toyota's production line is run on a "just-in-time" basis, with parts arriving every 37 minutes from suppliers in both the UK and the EU for cars made to order.
reference: 丰田生产线基于“无库存制”实施生产，英国和欧盟供应商每37分钟便会为汽车生产提供零部件。

source: If the UK leaves the EU without a deal on 29 March, there could be disruption at the border which the industry says could lead to delays and shortages of parts.
reference: 业内人士称，如果英国在3月29日未达成协议脱离欧盟，跨境生产将出现混乱 ，由此可能导致交货延期和零部件短缺的问题。

source: It would be impossible for Toyota to hold more than a day's worth of inventory at its Derbyshire plant, the company said, and so production would be stopped.
reference: 丰田公司表示，丰田在德比郡的工厂持有的库存量不能超过一天，因此不久会停止生产。

source: Mr Clark said Theresa May's Chequers plan for future relations with the EU is "precisely calibrated to avoid those checks at the border."
reference: 克拉克先生称，由特雷莎·梅制定的关于与欧盟未来的关系的契克斯计划经过准确校正，可避免跨境生产受到影响。

source: "We need to have a deal. We want to have the best deal that will allow as I say not just the success at present to be enjoyed but for us to grasp this opportunity," he told BBC Radio 4's Today programme.
reference: 他在BBC广播4频道的《今日》节目中说，“我们需要达成协议。就像我说的，我们希望达成最佳协议 - 既保证我们能够享受目前的成功，也能够让我们抓住机遇”。

source: "The evidence from not just Toyota but other manufacturers is that we need to absolutely be able to continue what has been a highly successful set of supply chains."
reference: “除丰田外，其他制造商也对供应链可能遭受的风险担忧，我们需要绝对保证供应链不受影响。”

source: Toyota was unable to say how long production would be stopped, but in the longer term, warned that added costs would reduce the plant's competitiveness and eventually cost jobs.
reference: 丰田暂时无法透露停产时间，但他警告称，从长期来看生产成本增加将导致工厂的竞争力下降，并最终导致就业岗位减少。

source: Peter Tsouvallaris, who has worked at Burnaston for 24 years and is the Unite union convenor at the plant, said his members are increasingly concerned: "In my experience once these jobs go they never come back.
reference: 在丰田伯纳斯顿工厂工作24年的联合工会代表彼得Tsouvallaris透露，他的成员越来越担心：“根据我的经验，一旦这些工作取消了便再也不会恢复了”。

source: A government spokesperson said: "We have put forward a precise and credible plan for our future relationship with the EU."
reference: 某政府发言人表示：“我们已经提出了一份关于与欧盟未来的关系的、准确可信的计划。

source: Trump meeting with Rosenstein may be delayed again, says White House
reference: 白宫表示，特朗普与罗森斯坦的会晤可能再次延期

source: Donald Trump's high-stakes meeting with deputy attorney general Rod Rosenstein could be "pushed back another week" as the fight over supreme court nominee Brett Kavanaugh continues, the White House said on Sunday.
reference: 周日白宫表示，关于最高法院大法官候选人布雷特·卡瓦诺的争论仍在继续，受此影响唐纳德·特朗普与司法部副部长罗德·罗森斯坦之间的高级会晤可能会“推迟一周”。

source: Rosenstein oversees the work of special counsel Robert Mueller, who is investigating Russian election interference, links between Trump aides and Russia and potential obstruction of justice by the president.
reference: 罗森斯坦主要负责监督特别检察官穆勒的工作，穆勒目前正在调查俄罗斯干预选举、特朗普助手与俄罗斯之间的关系、以及总统可能妨碍司法公正等问题。

source: Whether or not Trump will fire the deputy attorney general, and thereby endanger Mueller's independence, has fuelled Washington gossip for months.
reference: 数月以来关于特朗普是否会将司法部副部长解职而由此是否会影响穆勒独立性的问题，一直是华盛顿地区讨论的热点。

source: Earlier this month, the New York Times reported that Rosenstein discussed wearing a wire to record conversations with Trump and the possibility of removing the president via the 25th amendment.
reference: 本月初《纽约时报》报道称，罗森斯坦讨论过使用窃听器记录与特朗普的对话以及通过第25修正案罢免总统的可能性。

source: Rosenstein denied the report.
reference: 但随后罗森斯坦否认了这一报道。

source: But last Monday he went to the White House, amid reports he was about to resign.
reference: 不过上周一，他顶着各种关于他即将离任的报道，去了白宫。

source: Instead, a meeting with Trump, who was then at the United Nations in New York, was announced for Thursday.
reference: 相反，白宫为他安排了周四与特朗普会面，那时特朗普还在纽约联合国总部。

source: Trump said he would "prefer not" to fire Rosenstein but then the meeting was delayed to avoid a clash with the Senate judiciary committee hearing in which Kavanaugh and one of the women who have accused him of sexual misconduct, Dr Christine Blasey Ford, both testified.
reference: 特朗普表示他“不愿”解雇罗森斯坦，但随后这次会面被推迟，以避免与前来听审的参议院司法委员会发生冲突，其中卡瓦诺和一名指控他性行为不端的女性-克里斯汀·布莱西·福特博士，都对其做了指证。

source: On Friday, Trump ordered a one-week FBI investigation of claims against Kavanaugh, further delaying a full Senate vote.
reference: 周五，特朗普下令联邦调查局对卡瓦诺的指控进行为期一周的调查，进一步推迟了参议院的全面投票。

source: Trump's press secretary, Sarah Sanders, appeared on Fox News Sunday.
reference: 特朗普的新闻秘书萨拉桑德斯上了福克斯周日新闻。

source: Asked about the Rosenstein meeting, she said: "A date for that hasn't been set, it could be this week, I could see that pushing back another week given all of the other things that are going on with the supreme court.
reference: 当被问及特朗普与罗森斯坦的会面时，她说:“会面的具体日期还没有确定，可能是在这个星期内。考虑到最高法院有其他事情要处理，我觉得时间可能会往后推一个星期。

source: But we'll see and I always like to keep the press updated."
reference: 但这次会面终会来临的，并且我会及时通知大家。”

source: Some reporters would contest that assertion: Sanders has not held a White House press briefing since 10 September.
reference: 有些记者质疑这种说法:桑德斯自9月10日以来，就没有在白宫举行过记者会了。

source: Host Chris Wallace asked why.
reference: 主持人克里斯·华莱士问他为什么

source: Sanders said the scarcity of briefings was not due to a distaste for TV reporters "grandstanding," although she said: "I won't disagree with the fact that they grandstand."
reference: 桑德斯答道，不举办记者会不是因为厌恶电视台记者的“哗众取宠”，尽管她表示：“我不否认他们报道的那些新闻”

source: She then suggested direct contact between Trump and the press will increase.
reference: 随后她表示，特朗普将会增加和新闻媒体之间的面对面接触。

source: "The president does more Q&A sessions than any president has prior to him," she said, adding without citing evidence: "We've looked at those numbers."
reference: 她表示：“这一届美国总统举行的问答会议比之前任何一届都多。”没有补充任何引证，她又说道：“因为我们已经研究过数据了。”

source: Briefings will still happen, Sanders said, but "if the press has the chance to ask the president of the United States questions directly, that's infinitely better than talking to me.
reference: 桑德斯说：“记者会还是要召开的，但是，如果媒体朋友有机会直接向总统先生提问题，那比和我交谈要好得多。

source: We try to do that a lot and you've seen us do that a lot over the last few weeks and that's going to take the place of a press briefing when you can talk to the president of the United States."
reference: 我们这样做了很多次尝试，在过去的几周里，你已经看到我们做了很多这样的事情，当你可以和美国的总统直接对话时，这将取代新闻发布会。”

source: Trump regularly takes questions when leaving the White House or participating in open sessions or press conferences with visiting dignitaries.
reference: 特朗普在即将离开白宫外出国事访问，或与来访的政要参加公开会议和记者会时，会定期回答问题。

source: Solo press conferences are rare.
reference: 但很少会有单独的发布会。

source: In New York this week the president perhaps demonstrated why, making a freewheeling and at times bizarre appearance before gathered reporters.
reference: 本周在纽约，总统先生在记者会上随心所欲地露面，并时不时做出奇怪地表情，或许就证明了这一点。

source: Christion Abercrombie Undergoes Emergency Surgery After Suffering Head Injury
reference: 克里斯蒂安·阿伯克龙比头部受伤后接受紧急手术

source: Tennessee State Tigers linebacker Christion Abercrombie underwent emergency surgery after suffering a head injury in Saturday's 31-27 defeat to the Vanderbilt Commodores, the Tennessean's Mike Organ reported.
reference: 田纳西州立虎队后卫克里斯蒂安·阿伯克龙比，在上周六以31：27的成绩，输给了范德比尔特大学。克里斯蒂安·阿伯克龙比在比赛中头部受伤，接受了紧急手术。

source: Tennessee State head coach Rod Reed told reporters the injury happened shortly before halftime.
reference: 田纳西州立大学主教练罗德·里德告诉记者，快要中场休息的时候，克里斯蒂安·阿伯克龙比受了伤。

source: "He came to the sideline and just kind of collapsed there," Reed said.
reference: 里德说:“他来到场边，然后就瘫倒在那里。”

source: Trainers and medical personnel gave Abercrombie oxygen on the sideline before placing him on a stretcher and taking him back for further evaluation.
reference: 训练员和医务人员在场边那里给阿伯克龙比输氧，然后把他放在担架上，带他回去做进一步的身体检查。

source: An official from Tennessee State told Chris Harris of WSMV in Nashville, Tennessee, that Abercrombie was out of surgery at Vanderbilt Medical Center.
reference: 田纳西州一名官员告诉田纳西州纳什维尔一家新闻电视台的记者克里斯·哈里斯，阿伯克龙比在范德比尔特医疗中心做完了手术。

source: Harris added that there are "no details on type/extent of injury yet" and Tennessee State is trying to figure out when the injury occurred.
reference: 哈里斯补充表示：“我们目前还不清楚阿伯克龙比的受伤类型和程度”。田纳西州那边正在试图确认阿伯克龙比受伤的具体时间。

source: Abercrombie, a redshirt sophomore, is in his first season with Tennessee State after transferring from Illinois.
reference: 阿伯克龙比是红衫队大二的学生，这是他从伊利诺伊州转到田纳西州参加的第一个赛季。

source: He had five total tackles Saturday before exiting the game, which brought his season total to 18 tackles.
reference: 在周六的这次比赛中，他总共获得5次抢断，这使得他本赛季的抢断总数一共达到了18次。

source: Foreign buyers will be charged higher stamp duty when they buy a property in the UK
reference: 外国买家在英国买房时将被征收更高的印花税

source: Foreign buyers will be charged higher stamp duty when they buy a property in the UK with the extra cash used to help the homeless under new Tory plans
reference: 英国保守党派的新政策规定，如果外国买家用他们手头闲置的钱在英国购置房产时，将被征收更高的印花税，这些税收将用来资助本国那些无家可回的流浪汉

source: The move will neutralise the success of Corbyn's drive to attract young voters
reference: 此举或将影响科尔宾成功获得年轻选民的投票支持

source: The stamp duty rise will be levied on those who are not paying tax in the UK
reference: 在英国拒税的这一部分人将被征收更高的印花税

source: The Treasury expects it raise up to £120 million a year- to help the homeless
reference: 英国财政部预计，这个政策每年将征税高达1.2亿英镑，用于帮助那些无家可归的人

source: Foreign buyers are set to be charged a higher stamp duty rate when they buy property in the UK - with the extra cash used to help the homeless, Theresa May will announce today.
reference: 英国首相特雷莎·梅今日将宣布，外国买家在英国购买房产时，将被征收更高的印花税——这笔额外的税收将用于帮助无家可归者。

source: The move will be seen as an attempt to neutralise the success of Jeremy Corbyn's drive to attract young voters with pledges to provide more affordable housing and target high earners.
reference: 此举或将影响科尔宾成功获得年轻选民的投票支持，因为科尔宾承诺将为年轻人提供更多负担得起的住房，并把收税目标瞄准高收入者群体。

source: The stamp duty rise will be levied on individuals and firms not paying tax in the UK, with the extra money boosting the Government's drive to combat rough sleeping.
reference: 英国将对那些拒税的个人和公司征收更高的印花税，这些额外的税收将促使政府应对本国人民生活质量低下的问题。

source: The surcharge - which is in addition to the present stamp duty, including the higher levels introduced two years ago on second homes and buy-to-lets - could be as much as three per cent.
reference: 在两年前对第二套住房和“购房用以出租”征收的更高税率的印花税基础上，另外征收这一附加税，而且可能高达3%。

source: The Treasury expects the move to raise up to £120 million a year.
reference: 英国财政部预计，此举每年将实现征税多达1.2亿英镑。

source: An estimated 13 per cent of new-build London properties are bought by non-UK residents, driving up prices and making it harder for first-time buyers to get a foot on the housing ladder.
reference: 据估计，13％的伦敦新建房是由非英国国籍居民购买了，这拉高了房价，使本国首次购房者更买不起住房

source: Many wealthy areas of the country - particularly in the capital - have become "ghost towns" because of the high number of foreign buyers who spend most of their time out of the country.
reference: 这个国家的许多富裕地区——尤其是首都——已成为“鬼城”，因为许多在国外买房的人大部分时间待在了国外。

source: The new policy comes just weeks after Boris Johnson called for a stamp duty cut to help more young people own their first home.
reference: 就在几周前，鲍里斯·约翰逊呼吁停止施行印花税，以帮助更多年轻人拥有自己的第一套住房。

source: He accused big construction firms of keeping property prices high by snapping up land but not using it, and urged Mrs May to abandon quotas on affordable homes to fix Britain's "housing disgrace."
reference: 他指责大型的房地产公司拍下土地却不修建住房，从而使房地产价格居高不下，并劝首相特雷莎·梅放弃经济适用房的配额，以弥补英国的“住房耻辱”。

source: Mr Corbyn has announced an eye-catching series of proposed housing reforms, including rent controls and an end to "no-fault" evictions.
reference: 科尔宾宣布了一系列引人注目的住房改革提议，包括租金控制和结束“无过错”的拆迁政策。

source: He also wants to give councils greater powers to build new homes.
reference: 他还希望赋予地方议会更大的权力来建造新房。

source: Mrs May said: "Last year I said I would dedicate my premiership to restoring the British dream - that life should be better for each new generation.
reference: 首相特雷莎·梅表示：“去年，我说过我将在我的首相任期内致力于重塑我们的英国梦——让每一代人的生活都能过得更美好。

source: And that means fixing our broken housing market.
reference: 要实现这个梦想，这意味着必须修复我们崩溃的房地产市场。

source: Britain will always be open to people who want to live, work and build a life here.
reference: 英国的大门将永远向那些，打算在这里居住、工作和创造美好生活的人们敞开。

source: However, it cannot be right that it is as easy for individuals who don't live in the UK, as well as foreign-based companies, to buy homes as hard-working British residents.
reference: 然而，对于那些不是英国国籍的个人和没在英国注册的外国公司，如果他们在英国购买住房和当地辛勤工作的居民一样容易，这明显是不公平的。

source: For too many people the dream of home ownership has become all too distant, and the indignity of rough sleeping remains all too real."
reference: 对于很多人来说，拥有一套住房的梦想已经变得太遥不可及，人民的生活质量低下仍然是社会真实的写照。”

source: Jack Ross: 'My ultimate ambition is to manage Scotland'
reference: 杰克·罗斯表示：“我的终极志向是管理苏格兰”

source: Sunderland boss Jack Ross says his "ultimate ambition" is to become the Scotland manager at some stage.
reference: 桑德兰队的主老板杰克·罗斯表示他的“终极目标”是在未来可以成为苏格兰主帅。

source: The Scot, 42, is relishing the challenge of reviving the North-East club, who currently sit third place in League One, three points off the top.
reference: 杰克·罗斯，这位42岁的苏格兰人，正在不断努力复兴东北俱乐部，该俱乐部目前在英格兰足球甲级联赛中排名第三，距离第一名仅差三分。

source: He moved to the Stadium of Light this summer after guiding St Mirren back to the Scottish Premiership last season.
reference: 在上赛季带领圣米伦回到苏格兰联赛后，他在今年夏天转会到了光明球场。

source: "I wanted to play for my country as a player.
reference: 罗斯告诉BBC苏格兰体育之声：“我想作为一名球员为我的国家效力。

source: I got a B cap and that was it," Ross told BBC Scotland's Sportsound.
reference: 我只拿过亚军，就再也没有突破了。”

source: "But I grew up watching Scotland at Hampden a lot with my dad as a kid, and it is always something that has drawn me back.
reference: “但我小时候和爸爸在汉普顿一起看了很多苏格兰比赛，比赛的很多东西总是把我带回到从前那段时光。

source: That opportunity would only come, though, if I am successful in club management."
reference: 不过，只有当我在俱乐部管理方面取得成功时，我才有这个机会。”

source: Ross's predecessors as Sunderland manager include Dick Advocaat, David Moyes, Sam Allardyce, Martin O'Neill, Roy Keane, Gus Poyet and Paulo Di Canio.
reference: 桑德兰球队之前的主帅有迪克·艾德沃卡特、大卫·莫耶斯、山姆·阿勒代斯、马丁·奥尼尔、罗伊·基恩、格斯·波耶特和保罗·迪卡尼奥。

source: The former Alloa Athletic boss says he felt no trepidation in following such established names at such a big club, having previously rejected overtures from Barnsley and Ipswich Town.
reference: 罗斯是阿洛拉体育的前任老板，他表示，即使在如此厉害的俱乐部里，与知名球员打交道，他也并不感到紧张和压力，此前他已经拒绝了巴恩斯利和伊普斯维奇两个城市的邀请。

source: "Success for me at the moment will be gauged by 'can I return this club to the Premier League?'
reference: 他表示：“目前，‘我能否让这家俱乐部重返英超?’将衡量我的成败。

source: Because of the structure and facilities at this club, it undoubtedly belongs in the Premier League," he said.
reference: 得益于俱乐部优秀的成员结构和设施，毫无疑问英超才是它该去的地方。”

source: "It is not an easy task to get it there, but I would probably only view myself as being successful here if I can get the club back there."
reference: “要把我们俱乐部带回英超并不容易，但也许只有当我顺利地完成这个任务的时候，我才会觉得自己是成功的。”

source: Ross is only three years into his management career, after a period as assistant boss at Dumbarton and a 15-month spell on Hearts' coaching staff.
reference: 罗斯先在敦巴顿做过一段时间的助理教练，然后在哈茨的教练组工作了15个月，之后才开始他的球队管理生涯，到现在仅有三年光景。

source: He then helped Alloa recover from relegation to the third tier, and transformed St Mirren from the brink of relegation to Championship title winners the following season.
reference: 然后他带领阿洛拉队重返第三级，并在接下来的赛季带领圣米伦队从淘汰的边缘，杀出重围，拿下冠军。

source: And Ross says he feels more comfortable now than he ever did during his playing career at Clyde, Hartlepool, Falkirk, St Mirren and Hamilton Academical.
reference: 罗斯表示，他现在感觉自己的状态比在克莱德、哈特尔普尔、福尔柯克、圣米伦和汉密尔顿学院时的运动生涯还要更舒服。

source: "It was probably a real crossroads," he recalled, of taking charge of Alloa.
reference: 他回忆阿洛拉那段往事的时候表示：“这可能是我面临人生一个真正的十字路口，”

source: "I genuinely did believe management was the right fit for me, more so than playing.
reference: “我真的感觉我更适合做管理层，而不是去踢球。”

source: It sounds bizarre because I did okay, made a reasonable living out of it, and enjoyed some reasonable highs.
reference: 我乐此不疲，尽管这听起来很奇怪，我就这样过着理想的生活，享受着其中的快乐。

source: But playing can be tough.
reference: 然而踢球对我来说还挺难的。

source: There are a lot of things you have to get through on a weekly basis.
reference: 每周都有很多事情要去做。

source: I still go through that in terms of the stresses and pressure of the job but management just feels right.
reference: 尽管我仍会在管理岗上遇到工作的压力，但我感觉还好。

source: I always wanted to manage and now I am doing it, it feels the most comfortable I have been in my own skin throughout my entire adult life."
reference: 我一直都希望做管理工作，现在终于实现了。这是自我成年以来，感到最自在的时刻。”

source: You can listen to the full interview on Sportsound on Sunday, 30 September, on Radio Scotland between 12:00 and 13:00 BST
reference: 您可以在九月三十日，星期日的12:00至13:00（英国夏令时）这个时间段，通过苏格兰广播电台收听体育之声本次全面采访

source: Perfect time for a pint is 5.30pm on a Saturday, survey finds
reference: 调查发现，小饮一杯的最佳时间是周六下午5：30

source: The summer heatwave has boosted takings for Britain's struggling pubs but heaped more pressure on restaurant chains.
reference: 夏季的炎热促进了英国酒吧生意好转，但却给连锁餐厅带来了更大的压力。

source: Pub and bar groups saw sales rise 2.7 per cent in July - but takings in restaurants were down 4.8 per cent, figures revealed.
reference: 数据显示，7月份酒吧的营业额增长2.7%，但餐馆收入却下降4.8%。

source: Peter Martin, of business consultancy CGA, which compiled the figures, said: "Continued sunshine and England's longer than expected participation in the World Cup meant July followed a similar pattern to the previous month of June, when pubs were up 2.8 per cent, except that restaurants were hit even harder.
reference: 公布这些数据的加拿大注册会计师协会的彼得·马丁表示:“太阳光照和英格兰人民欢庆世界杯的持续时间比预期的更长，这意味着七月的经济情况与之前六月相似，酒吧营业额增长2.8％，但餐厅受到的冲击更为严重。

source: The fall of 1.8 per cent in restaurant trading in June just got worse in July.
reference: 六月份餐厅营业额下降了1.8%，七月份的业绩更是雪上加霜。

source: Drink-led pubs and bars performed by far the strongest with like-for-likes up more than restaurants were down.
reference: 到目前为止，以卖酒为主营业务的酒吧增长最为强劲，同比销量增长高于餐厅营业下滑。

source: Food-led pubs also suffered in the sun, although not as dramatically as the restaurant operators.
reference: 以卖食品为主营业务的酒吧也遭受了损失，但没有餐厅经营者那么严重。

source: It seems people just wanted to go out for a drink.
reference: 从这个数据可以看出，人们只是想出去喝酒。

source: Across managed pubs and bars drink sales were up 6.6 per cent for the month, with food down three per cent."
reference: 本月，受调查酒吧的酒水销量增长6.6%，食品销量下降3%。”

source: Paul Newman, of leisure and hospitality analysts RSM said: "These results continue the trend we've seen since the end of April.
reference: 鹿特丹管理学院休闲和酒店专业分析家保罗·纽曼表示:“这些结果延续了自四月底以来的发展趋势。

source: Weather and the impact of major social or sporting events remain the biggest factors when it comes to sales in the out-of-home market.
reference: 气候气温的影响，和重大社交或体育赛事活动的影响，仍然很大程度上作用于室外商店销售额。

source: It comes as no surprise that restaurant groups continue to struggle, albeit a sales drop of 4.8 per cent year-on-year will be particularly painful on top of ongoing cost pressures.
reference: 毫无疑问，做餐饮的店铺日子不好过，除了持续的成本压力，销售额年同比下降4.8%让经营者痛不欲生。

source: The long hot summer could not have come at a worse time for food-led operators and time will tell whether the more moderate temperatures we've experienced in August will provide some much-needed respite."
reference: 这个漫长的炎热夏天对以食品为主导的经营者来说十分糟糕，等到八月份气温降下来，这些经营者的情况能否好转，我们一起拭目以待。”

source: Total sales growth across pub and restaurants, including new openings, was 2.7 per cent in July, reflecting the slow down in brand roll-outs.
reference: 今年七月，酒吧和餐馆(包括新开张的)加起来的总销售额增长2.7%，反映出品牌部署的进度慢慢放缓。

source: The Coffer Peach Tracker industry sales monitor for the UK pub, bar and restaurant sector collects and analyses performance data from 47 operating groups, with a combined turnover of over £9 billion, and is the established industry benchmark.
reference: 英国酒馆，酒吧和餐馆部门的行业销售监察机构Coffer Peach Tracker作为行业基准，收集并分析了47个经营部门的业绩数据，总营业额超过90亿英镑。

source: Eilidh Doyle will be "voice for athletes" on Scottish Athletics board
reference: 埃利德·多伊尔将进入苏格兰田径理事会，“为运动员发声代言”

source: Eilidh Doyle has been elected to the board of Scottish Athletics as a non-executive director at the governing body's annual general meeting.
reference: 埃利德·多伊尔在苏格兰田径理事会的年度大会上，当选为理事会非执行董事。

source: Doyle is Scotland's most decorated track and field athlete and chairman Ian Beattie described the move as a great opportunity for those guiding the sport to benefit from her wide-ranging experience at international level over the past decade.
reference: 协会主席伊恩·贝蒂表示，多伊尔是苏格兰历史上获得荣誉最多的田径运动员。这是一个很好的机会，那些指导这项运动的人可以从多伊尔过去十年在国际赛场上积累的经验中学到很多。
