source: "Eilidh has massive respect across the Scottish, UK and world athletics community and we are sure athletics in Scotland would benefit hugely by bringing her on to the board," Beattie said.
reference: 贝蒂表示:“埃利德在苏格兰、英国乃至世界田径界都享有很高的声誉，我们相信，让她加入理事会将使苏格兰田径界从中受益。”

source: Doyle said: "I am keen to act as a voice for athletes and I am hoping I can really contribute and help guide the sport in Scotland."
reference: 多伊尔表示：“我渴望为运动员发声代言，我希望我真正能指导苏格兰的体育运动，并对此做出贡献。”

source: The American, who won the 200 metres and 400 metres at the 1996 Games in Atlanta among his total of four Olympic golds and is now a regular BBC pundit, was left unable to walk after suffering a transient ischemic attack.
reference: 埃利德·多伊尔，这位美国人在1996年亚特兰大奥运会上获得了200米和400米两枚金牌，而他总共获得过四枚金牌。他曾经经历过短暂性脑缺血，一度无法行走，现在是英国广播公司(BBC)的定期评论员。

source: He wrote on Twitter: "A month ago today I suffered a stroke.
reference: 他在推特上写道：“一个月前，我得了中风。

source: I could not walk.
reference: 不能行走。

source: Doctors said only time will tell if I will recover or to what degree.
reference: 医生们告诉我，我是否能恢复以及恢复到什么程度，需要等上一段时间后才可能知道。

source: Its been grueling work but made a full recovery, re-learned how to walk and today doing agility drills!
reference: 那段时间真的很艰苦的，需要重新学习如何行走，不过最后全面恢复了，目前还在做腿的敏捷性恢复练习!

source: Thanks for the messages of encouragement!"
reference: 感谢你们的鼓励！”

source: Breast pump advert comparing mothers to cows divides opinion online
reference: 一则将妈妈们比作奶牛的吸乳器广告在网上引起了不同的观点和讨论

source: A breast pump company has divided opinion online with an advert that compares nursing mothers to cows being milked.
reference: 一家吸乳器公司在网上发布了一则广告，将正在喂乳的妈妈们比作正在挤奶的奶牛。

source: To mark the launch of what is said to be the "world's first silent wearable breast bump," consumer tech company Elvie released a tongue-in-cheek music video-inspired advert to showcase the freedom the new pump gives to expressing mothers.
reference: 为了纪念这款宣称是“世界上第一个无声的可穿戴吸乳器”的发布，消费者科技公司埃尔维，发布了一个以音乐视频为基调的诙谐广告，来展示了新款吸乳器让妈妈们喂母乳时更自由。

source: Four real mothers dance in a hay-filled barn of cows to a track that includes lyrics like: "Yes, I milk myself, but you don't see no tail" and "In case you hadn't noticed these are not udders, they're my boobs."
reference: 四位妈妈在堆满干草的牛棚里伴随着歌曲跳舞，歌词如下:“是的，我是无线吸乳器，我自己挤奶奶。你看不到乳房，因为吸乳器挡住的地方就是乳房。”

source: The chorus continues: "Pump it out, pump it out, I'm feeding them babies, pump it out, pump it out, I'm milking my ladies."
reference: 歌词还有:“挤奶呀，挤奶呀，我把奶奶挤出来喂宝宝，挤奶呀，挤奶呀，我在帮妈妈们挤奶奶。”

source: However, the advert, which has been published on the firm's Facebook page, has caused controversy online.
reference: 然而，这则发布在该公司Facebook页面上的广告在网上引发了争议。

source: With 77,000 views and hundreds of comments, the video has received mixed reactions from viewers, with many saying it makes light of the "horrors" of the dairy industry.
reference: 该视频浏览量高达7.7万次，评论多达数百条，观众的反应褒贬不一，许多人表示，这是乳制品行业的“噩梦”。

source: "Very poor decision using cows to advertise this product.
reference: 有人评论道：“用奶牛来打广告是非常不明智的。

source: Like us they need to get pregnant and give birth in order to produce milk, except their babies are stolen from them within days of giving birth," one wrote.
reference: 和人类妈妈一样，它们也需要怀孕和分娩来产奶，只不过它们的孩子在分娩后几天就被带走了。”

source: The Elvie breast pump fits discreetly inside a nursing bra (Elvie/Mother)
reference: 埃尔维吸乳器得小心翼翼地装在哺乳胸罩里(埃尔维/母亲)

source: Another commented: "Understandably traumatic for both mother and baby.
reference: 又有人评论：“广告给妈妈们和孩子带来得创伤虽然可以理解。

source: But yeah why not use them to advertise a breast pump for mothers who get to keep their babies?"
reference: 但是，为什么非要通过这种方式为那些母乳喂养的妈妈们安利吸乳器呢?”

source: Someone else added: "Such an out of touch advert."
reference: 有人补充道：“这样一支不切实际的广告。”

source: Others defended the advert, with one woman admitting that she found the song "hilarious."
reference: 其他人则为这则广告进行了辩护，一位女士承认她觉得这首歌“很搞笑”。

source: "I think this is a genus idea.
reference: 有人评论：“我觉得这是一个很棒的创意。

source: I would've had one if I was still breastfeeding.
reference: 如果我还在母乳喂养宝宝的话，我可能早就买了。

source: Pumping made me feel exactly like a cow.
reference: 吸奶这种方式让我觉得自己真的就像一头奶牛。

source: The advert is a little mad but I took it for what it was.
reference: 这个广告有点疯狂，但我还是会买。

source: This is a genius product," one wrote.
reference: 所以我认为这是个很棒的产品。”

source: Another commented: "This is a fun advert aimed at mums who pump (often in their workplaces or toilets) and feel like "cows."
reference: 另外有评论称:“这是一个有趣的广告，目标群体是那些自己挤奶的妈妈们(通常在工作的地方或卫生间)，感觉像极了“奶牛”。

source: This is not an advert praising or judging the dairy industry."
reference: 这个广告并不是在对乳制品行业进行赞扬或批判”

source: At the end of the video the group of women reveal they've all been dancing with the discreet pumps tucked in their bras.
reference: 在广告视频的最后，这群妈妈们透露，她们跳舞的时候，吸乳器就小心翼翼地装在哺乳胸罩里。

source: The concept behind the campaign is based on the insight that many women who breast-pump say they feel like cows.
reference: 对这支广告的争议的背后，揭露了许多母乳喂养的妈妈们感觉她们感觉自己就像奶牛。

source: The Elvie Pump however, is completely silent, has no wires or tubes and fits discreetly inside a nursing bra, giving women the freedom to move, hold their babies, and even go out while pumping.
reference: 然而，埃尔维这款吸奶器完全是静音的，也没有电线或管子，小心翼翼地安装在哺乳胸罩里后，让女性可以自由走动，可以抱着孩子，甚至可以在吸奶的过程中出门。

source: Ana Balarin, partner and ECD at Mother commented: "The Elvie Pump is such a revolutionary product that it deserved a bold and provocative launch.
reference: Mother的合伙人兼执行创意总监-安娜·巴拉林评论道:“埃尔维吸奶器是一款革命性的产品，值得被大量推广。

source: By drawing a parallel between expressing women and dairy cows we wanted to put breast pumping and all its challenges in the spotlight, while demonstrating in an entertaining and relatable way the incredible sense of freedom that the new pump will bring.
reference: 通过妈妈们和奶牛之间的对比，我们想把吸乳器和它面临的所有挑战暴露在大众面前，同时以一种有趣的和联想的方式向世人展示，新款吸乳器将带给妈妈们不可思议的自由感。

source: This is not the first time the Elvie pump has made the headlines.
reference: 这已经不是埃尔维吸奶器第一次登上新闻头条了。

source: During London Fashion Week, a mother of two appeared on the catwalk for designer Marta Jakubowski while using the product.
reference: 在伦敦时装周期间，设计师玛塔·雅库波斯基指导一位拥有两个孩子的模特，就使用了这款产品进行走秀。

source: Hundreds of Migrant Children Quietly Moved to a Tent Camp on the Texas Border
reference: 数百名移民儿童被悄悄转移至德克萨斯州边境的帐篷营地

source: The number of detained migrant children has spiked even though monthly border crossings have remained relatively unchanged, in part because harsh rhetoric and policies introduced by the Trump administration have made it harder to place children with sponsors.
reference: 尽管每月边境的过境人数相对没有变化，但被拘留的移民儿童人数仍在飙升，部分原因是特朗普政府采取的严格的移民政策，使这些儿童更难找到美国这边的认领人。

source: Traditionally, most sponsors have been undocumented immigrants themselves, and have feared jeopardizing their own ability to remain in the country by stepping forward to claim a child.
reference: 之前大多数认领人自己就是非法移民到美国的，他们担心站出来认领一个孩子会让自己不能再留在美国。

source: The risk increased in June, when federal authorities announced that potential sponsors and other adult members of their households would have to submit fingerprints, and that the data would be shared with immigration authorities.
reference: 今年6月，联邦政府宣布，潜在的认领者和他们家庭的其他成年成员必须录入指纹信息，并且这些信息数据将与移民局实现联网共享。于是认领儿童后，自己不能留在美国的风险就增加了。

source: Last week, Matthew Albence, a senior official with Immigration and Customs Enforcement, testified before Congress that the agency had arrested dozens of people who applied to sponsor unaccompanied minors.
reference: 上周，移民与海关执法局高级官员马修·阿尔宾塞在国会证实，该机构已经逮捕了数十名申请认领那些举目无亲的儿童的人。

source: The agency later confirmed that 70 percent of those arrested did not have prior criminal records.
reference: 该机构后来证实，70%的被捕者没有犯罪前科。

source: "Close to 80 percent of the individuals that are either sponsors or household members of sponsors are here in the country illegally, and a large chunk of those are criminal aliens.
reference: 阿尔本斯表示：“近80%的认领者或他们的家庭成员都是非法移民过来的，其中很大一部分还是国外的犯罪份子。

source: So we are continuing to pursue those individuals," Mr. Albence said.
reference: 所以，我们还会继续逮捕这些人。”

source: Seeking to process the children more quickly, officials introduced new rules that will require some of them to appear in court within a month of being detained, rather than after 60 days, which was the previous standard, according to shelter workers.
reference: 收容所工作人员表示，为了更快地处理这些儿童，官员们做出新的决定，要求其中一些人在被拘留后一个月内出庭受审，而不是之前的两个月。

source: Many will appear via video conference call, rather than in person, to plead their case for legal status to an immigration judge.
reference: 一些儿童将通过视频电话会议向移民法官申请获得合法身份，而不是面对面。

source: Those who are deemed ineligible for relief will be swiftly deported.
reference: 那些被认定没有资格移民美国的人，将被迅速驱逐出境。

source: The longer that children remain in custody, the more likely they are to become anxious or depressed, which can lead to violent outbursts or escape attempts, according to shelter workers and reports that have emerged from the system in recent months.
reference: 从收容所工作人员那里反馈的信息，以及近几个月来从该系统中得出的报告都显示，儿童被拘留的时间越长，他们变得焦虑或抑郁的可能性就越大，这可能导致爆发暴力行为或逃跑。

source: Advocates said those concerns are heightened at a larger facility like Tornillo, where signs that a child is struggling are more likely to be overlooked, because of its size.
reference: 一些主张这种观点的人生表示，像托尼洛这样的大型收留所情况更严重，因为它的规模太大，孩子们焦虑或抑郁的迹象更有可能被忽视。

source: They added that moving children to the tent city without providing enough time to prepare them emotionally or to say goodbye to friends could compound trauma that many are already struggling with.
reference: 他们补充道，没有给足孩子们时间，去做好心理准备以及和朋友们道别，就直接把他们转移到帐篷营地，这可能会加重许多人内心痛苦的创伤。

source: Syria tells US, French and Turkish 'occupying forces' to withdraw immediately
reference: 叙利亚让美国，法国和土耳其立即撤离其在叙利亚的“占领军”

source: Addressing the UN General Assembly, Foreign Minister Walid al-Moualem also called on Syrian refugees to come home, even though the country's war is now in its eighth year.
reference: 叙利亚外交部长瓦利德·穆阿利姆在联合国大会上发表讲话，呼吁叙利亚难民回国，尽管叙利亚战争已经进入第八个年头。

source: Moualem, who also serves as deputy prime minister, said the foreign forces were on Syrian soil illegally, under the pretext of fighting terrorism, and "will be dealt with accordingly."
reference: 穆阿利姆同时是叙利亚的副总理。他表示，外国军队以打击恐怖主义为由，非法进入叙利亚境内，这一行为“将得到相应的处理”。

source: "They must withdraw immediately and without any conditions," he told the assembly.
reference: 他在大会上表示：“这些外国军队必须立即撤出叙利亚，不附带任何条件。”

source: Moualem insisted that the "war on terror is almost over" in Syria, where more than 360,000 people have died since 2011, with millions more uprooted from their homes.
reference: 穆阿利姆表示，叙利亚的“反恐战争差不多已经结束”。这次战争始于2011年，至今已造成36万多人死亡，数百万人被迫背井离乡。

source: He said Damascus would continue "fighting this sacred battle until we purge all Syrian territories" of both terror groups and "any illegal foreign presence."
reference: 他表示，大马士革“将继续把这场神圣的战斗进行到底，直到我们净化了叙利亚领土”，这包括消灭所有的恐怖组织和“任何非法外国势力”。

source: The United States has some 2,000 troops in Syria, mainly training and advising both Kurdish forces and Syrian Arabs opposed to President Bashar al-Assad.
reference: 美国在叙利亚有大约2000名军人，主要为反对巴沙尔·阿萨德总统的库尔德部队和叙利亚的阿拉伯人提供军事训练和军事建议。

source: France has more than 1,000 troops on the ground in the war-wracked country.
reference: 法国在这个饱受战争蹂躏的国家，有地面驻军1000多人。

source: On the issue of refugees, Moualem said the conditions were fine for them to return, and he blamed "some western countries" for "spreading irrational fears" that prompted refugees to stay away.
reference: 穆阿利姆在难民问题上表示，叙利亚会开很优惠的条件吸引难民回国，并指责“一些西方国家胡乱散布恐惧”，以致难民不敢回国。

source: "We have called upon the international community and humanitarian organizations to facilitate these returns," he said.
reference: 他表示:“叙利亚呼吁国际社会和人道主义组织为叙利亚难民回国提供便利和援助。”

source: "They are politicizing what should be a purely humanitarian issue."
reference: “这些国家正在把本应是一个纯粹的人道主义问题政治化。”

source: The United States and the European Union have warned that there will be no reconstruction aid for Syria until there is a political agreement between Assad and the opposition to end the war.
reference: 美国和欧盟则表示，不会向叙利亚提供重建援助，除非阿萨德和反对派达成结束战争的政治协议。

source: UN diplomats say a recent agreement between Russia and Turkey to set up a buffer zone in the last major rebel stronghold of Idlib has created an opportunity to press ahead with political talks.
reference: 联合国外交官表示，俄罗斯和土耳其最近达成协议，即在最后这个主要反叛据点-伊德利卜，建立一个缓冲地带，这为推进两国相互之间的政治谈判创造了机会。

source: The Russian-Turkish deal averted a large-scale assault by Russian-backed Syrian forces on the province, where three million people live.
reference: 俄罗斯和土耳其达成的这个协议，避免了受俄罗斯指挥的叙利亚军队，对这个有300万人居住的地带发动大规模袭击。

source: Moualem however stressed that the agreement had "clear deadlines" and expressed hope that military action will target jihadists including fighters from the Al-Qaeda-linked Nusra Front, who "will be eradicated."
reference: 然而穆阿利姆强调，该协议有“明确的最后期限”，并表示希望组织军事行动，“去消灭”包括与基地组织有关联的努斯拉阵线的圣战分子。

source: UN envoy Staffan de Mistura is hoping to soon convene the first meetings of a new committee comprised of government and opposition members to draft a post-war constitution for Syria and pave the way to elections.
reference: 联合国特使斯塔凡·德米斯图拉希望，由政府和反对派成员共同组成的委员会的第一次会议能够尽快召开，为叙利亚起草战后宪法，并为选举铺平道路。

source: Moualem laid out conditions for the Syrian government's participation in the committee, saying the panel's work should be restricted "to reviewing the articles of the current constitution," and warned against interference.
reference: 穆阿利姆表示，如果要叙利亚政府同意加入该委员会，有个条件，即该委员会的工作应该限于“审查现行宪法的条款”，不能干预叙利亚其他内部事务。

source: Why Trump Will Win a Second Term
reference: 特朗普凭什么将赢得第二次总统连任

source: By that logic, Mr. Trump would win re-election in 2020 unless, as many liberal viewers are probably hoping, impeachment and scandal end his presidency prematurely.
reference: 按照目前这种情况发展下去，特朗普或将在2020年赢得连任，除非就像许多自由派观众正希望的那样，控告和丑闻提前结束他的总统任期。

source: In what would no doubt be "The most dramatic finale of a presidency ever!"
reference: 毫无疑问，这将是“此届总统任期最具戏剧性的结局!”

source: As of now, there are no signs of viewer fatigue.
reference: 到目前为止，观众对这个话题仍乐此不疲。

source: Since 2014, prime-time ratings have more than doubled to 1.05 million at CNN and nearly tripled to 1.6 million at MSNBC.
reference: 自2014年以来，CNN的黄金时段收视率翻了一番之多，达到105万，MSNBC的收视率更是翻了近两倍，达到160万。

source: Fox News has an average of 2.4 million prime-time viewers, up from 1.7 million four years ago, according to Nielsen, and MSNBC's "The Rachel Maddow Show" has topped cable ratings with as many as 3.5 million viewers on major news nights.
reference: 根据尼尔森公布的数据显示，福克斯新闻黄金时段的平均观众人数为240万，高于四年前的170万。MSNBC的《雷切尔·马多秀》在黄金新闻之夜的收视率最高，达到350万观众。

source: "This is a fire that people are being drawn to because it's not something we understand," said Neal Baer, show runner of the ABC drama "Designated Survivor," about a cabinet secretary who becomes president after an attack destroys the Capitol.
reference: 美国广播公司电视剧《指定幸存者》的制片人尼尔贝尔表示：“这是吸引人们关注的一次灾难，因为我们不理解，在袭击摧毁国会大厦后，内阁秘书居然成为总统。”

source: Nell Scovell, a veteran comedy writer and author of "Just the Funny Parts: And a Few Hard Truths About Sneaking Into the Hollywood Boys" Club," has another theory.
reference: 著有《有趣的部分》的内尔·斯科维尔是一位资深喜剧作家，。而关于潜入好莱坞男孩“俱乐部”的一些残酷事实，则有另一种说法。

source: She remembers a cab ride in Boston before the 2016 election.
reference: 她记得2016年大选前有一次在波士顿打出租车。

source: The driver told her he would be voting for Mr. Trump.
reference: 司机告诉她，他将把票投给特朗普。

source: Why? she asked.
reference: 她询问司机原因。

source: "He said, "Because he makes me laugh,"" Ms. Scovell told me.
reference: 斯科维尔告诉我，司机对她说：“因为特朗普让我发笑”。

source: There is entertainment value in the chaos.
reference: 混乱中，也有娱乐性。

source: Of course, unlike anything else on TV, the story lines coming out of Washington could determine the future of Roe v. Wade, whether immigrant families can reunite and the health of the global economy.
reference: 当然，不像电视上的其他节目，华盛顿传出的事情处理结果，可能会决定罗伊诉韦德案的走向，进一步影响移民家庭能否团聚，全球经济能否健康发展。

source: Tuning out is a luxury only the most privileged viewers can afford.
reference: 只有那些有权有势的观众才能配享受这些华盛顿的笑料。

source: And yet, it goes beyond being an informed citizen when you find yourself on hour six of watching a panel of experts debate Bob Woodward's use of "deep background" sourcing for his book "Fear," Paul Manafort's $15,000 ostrich-leather bomber jacket ("a garment thick with hubris," The Washington Post said) and the implications of Stormy Daniels's lurid descriptions of Mr. Trump's, um, anatomy.
reference: 然而，你会觉得自己什么都不知道，当你在六小时这个节目观看专家小组讨论鲍勃·伍德沃德使用“深度背景资料”解读他的书《恐惧》，保罗·马纳福特的15,000美元鸵鸟皮革飞行员夹克（华盛顿邮报说的是“ 一件裹着狂妄的衣服），以及斯托米·丹尼尔斯对特朗普，耸人听闻的剖析和解读。

source: I, for one, will never look at Super Mario the same way again.
reference: 就我个人而言，我再也不会以同样幼稚的方式去看《超级马里奥》了。

source: "Part of what he's doing that makes it feel like a reality show is that he is feeding you something every night," said Brent Montgomery, chief executive of Wheelhouse Entertainment and the creator of "Pawn Stars," about the Trump show's rotating cast and daily plot twists (picking a fight with the N.F.L., praising Kim Jong-un).
reference: 有关特朗普的报道就像曲折和反转的剧情（指与NFL辩论，赞美金正恩），Wheelhouse娱乐公司的首席执行官兼真人秀《典当之星》的创始人布伦特蒙哥马利对此表示：“他所作的事情的一部分让人觉得它是一个真人秀节目，他每晚都在给你脑子里输送一些东西。”

source: You can't afford to miss one episode or you're left behind.
reference: 你不能错过任何一集，否则你就会跟不上节奏。

source: When I reached Mr. Fleiss this week, it was a sunny 80 degrees outside his home on the north shore of Kauai, but he was holed up inside watching MSNBC while recording CNN.
reference: 当我本周联系到弗莱斯时，他的家在考艾岛北岸，外面气温高达80华氏度，阳光明媚。

source: He couldn't peel himself away, not with Brett Kavanaugh set to face the Senate Judiciary Committee and the future of the Supreme Court hanging in the balance.
reference: 布雷特·卡瓦诺即将面对参议院司法委员会和最高法院的审判，他无法脱身，而且前途未卜。

source: "I remember when we were doing all those crazy shows back in the day and people said, "This is the beginning of the end of Western civilization,"" Mr. Fleiss told me.
reference: 弗莱斯告诉我：“我记得当时我们在做那些疯狂的节目，有人表示，‘这是西方文明终结的开始，’”。

source: "I thought it was sort of a joke, but it turns out they were right."
reference: “我以为这是个玩笑，但事实证明他们是对的。”

source: Amy Chozick, a writer at large for The Times covering business, politics and media, is the author of the memoir "Chasing Hillary."
reference: 艾米·乔齐克是《纽约时报》负责商业、政治和媒体报道方面的自由撰稿人，也是回忆录《追逐希拉里》的作者。

source: Outside money floods into tightest midterm election House races
reference: 在竞争最激烈的中期选举之际，外部资金大量涌入

source: It's not surprising that Pennsylvania's 17th is seeing a flood of cash, thanks to a realignment of a congressional districts that landed two incumbents in a race for the same seat.
reference: 由于国会选区的重新划分，两名现任议员在同一个席位的竞争中同时胜出，宾夕法尼亚州第17选区的资金如洪水般涌入也就不足为奇了。

source: This recently redrawn suburban Pittsburg district pits Democrat Rep. Conor Lamb - who won his seat in another district in a special election last spring.
reference: 这个最近重新划分选区的匹兹堡郊区，让民主党众议员兰姆落选。兰姆在去年春天的一次特别选举的时候，在另一个选区当选。

source: Lamb is running against another incumbent, Republican Keith Rothfus, who currently represents the old Pennsylvania 12th district, which overlaps heavily with the new 17th.
reference: 兰姆的竞选对手是另一位在职的共和党人罗斯福斯。罗斯福斯目前代表旧宾夕法尼亚州的第12选区，这与新的17号选区有很大一部分重叠。

source: The maps were redrawn after the Pennsylvania Supreme Court ruled in January that the old districts were unconstitutionally gerrymandered in Republicans' favor.
reference: 今年1月，宾夕法尼亚州最高法院裁定，旧选区因不符合宪法，于是重新划分到有利于共和党的选区。

source: The race in the new 17th has touched off a campaign finance slugfest between the major party finance arms, the Democratic Campaign Congressional Committee (DCCC) and the National Republican Campaign Committee (NRCC).
reference: 在新的17号选区选举中，民主党主要的财政部门——民主党国会竞选委员会(DCCC)和共和党全国竞选委员会(NRCC)之间展开了一场竞选资金争夺战。

source: Lamb became a familiar name in Pennsylvania after a narrow win in a widely watched in March special election for Pennsylvania's 18th Congressional District.
reference: 兰姆在今年3月宾夕法尼亚州第18选区的特别选举中以微弱优势当选，赢得了广泛关注。

source: That seat had been held by a Republican for over a decade, and President Donald Trump won the district by 20 points.
reference: 该席位由一名共和党人保持了十多年，唐纳德·特朗普总统以20个百分点的优势赢得了该地区支持。

source: Political pundits have given Democrats a slight edge.
reference: 政治权威专家给了民主党些许优势。

source: Study History
reference: 研究历史

source: The next shoe to drop could be the special counsel Robert Mueller's report on Mr. Trump's possible obstruction of justice, of which there now is very substantial evidence in the public record.
reference: 下一个值得注意的是特别检察官罗伯特·穆勒(Robert Mueller)关于特朗普可能妨碍司法公正的报告，目前公开记录中有非常确凿的证据。

source: Mr. Mueller is reportedly also turning his investigation to whether Mr. Trump's campaign colluded with Russia in its attack on our elections.
reference: 据报道，穆勒还在调查特朗普的竞选团队是否与俄罗斯合谋攻击我们的选举。

source: Should Congress change hands, Mr. Trump will find himself facing accountability in that body, just as he prepares to go again before the voters, and perhaps eventually a jury of his peers.
reference: 如果国会易手，特朗普将发现自己在这个机构中面临问责，而此时他正准备再次面对选民参与总统选举，或许最终还会面对一个由他的同僚组成的陪审团。

source: That is a lot of ifs, and I do not mean to suggest that Mr. Trump's fall is inevitable - nor that of his equivalents in Europe.
reference: 这有很多假设，我的意思不是说特朗普的下台是不可避免的——也不是说他在欧洲的对手的下台是不可避免的。

source: There are choices to be made by all of us on both sides of the Atlantic that will affect how prolonged the struggle may be.
reference: 大西洋两岸的所有人都必须作出选择，这将影响到这场斗争可能会持续多久。

source: In 1938, German officers were ready to stage a coup d"état against Hitler, if only the West had resisted him and backed the Czechoslovaks at Munich.
reference: 1938年，德国军官准备发动一场反对希特勒的政变，要是西方国家在慕尼黑反对希特勒，支持捷克斯洛伐克人就好了。

source: We failed, and missed an opportunity to avoid the years of carnage that ensued.
reference: 我们失败了，而且错过了避免随后数年大屠杀的机会。

source: The course of history pivots around such inflection points, and democracy's inexorable march is accelerated or delayed.
reference: 历史的进程就是围绕着这样的拐点展开的，而民主不可阻挡的步伐要么加快，要么被推迟。

source: Americans face several of these inflection points now.
reference: 美国人现在就面临着几个这样的转折点。

source: What will we do if Mr. Trump fires Deputy Attorney General Rod Rosenstein, the man who controls the fate of Mr. Mueller's investigation?
reference: 如果特朗普解雇掌握穆勒调查命运的司法部副部长罗德·罗森斯坦(Rod Rosenstein)，我们会怎么做?

source: Rosenstein has been in hot water ever since this paper reported that, last year, he suggested secretly recording the president and speculated about his being unfit for office.
reference: 自从去年本报报道罗森斯坦建议秘密记录总统，并猜测他不适合担任公职以来，他一直处于水深火热之中。

source: Mr. Rosenstein says The Times's account is inaccurate.
reference: 罗森斯坦说，《纽约时报》的报道不准确。

source: "How will we respond if the newly requested F.B.I. investigation of Brett Kavanaugh is not full or fair - or if he is confirmed to the Supreme Court despite credible accusations of sexual assault and dishonest testimony?
reference: “如果美国联邦调查局对布雷特·卡瓦诺(Brett Kavanaugh)新提出的调查不全面、不公平，或者尽管他被指控性侵犯、证词不诚实，但他已被最高法院提名，我们将如何回应？”

source: And above all, will we vote in the midterms for a Congress that will hold Mr. Trump accountable?
reference: 最重要的是，我们是否会在中期选举中投票选出一个让特朗普尽责的国会?

source: If we fail those tests, democracy will be in for a long winter.
reference: 如果我们没能通过这些考验，民主将面临严峻的形势。

source: But I believe we will not fail, because of the lesson I learned in Prague.
reference: 但我相信我们不会失败，因为我汲取了布拉格的教训。

source: My mother was a Czechoslovak Jew who was deported to Auschwitz by the same Nazi regime that once occupied my ambassadorial home.
reference: 我母亲是捷克斯洛伐克的犹太人，曾被占领我大使官邸的纳粹政权驱逐到奥斯维辛。

source: She survived, immigrated to America and, 60 years later, sent me off to light Sabbath candles on that table bearing the swastika.
reference: 她活了下来，移民到了美国，60年后，她让我去点燃那张桌子上的安息日蜡烛，上面有纳粹党十字记号。

source: With that as my heritage, how can I not be an optimist about our future?"
reference: 有了这份遗产，我怎么能不对我们的未来不乐观呢?

source: Norman Eisen, a senior fellow at the Brookings Institution, is the chairman of Citizens for Responsibility and Ethics in Washington and the author of "The Last Palace: Europe's Turbulent Century in Five Lives and One Legendary House."
reference: 布鲁金斯学会(Brookings Institution)高级研究员诺曼·艾森(Norman Eisen)是华盛顿公民责任与道德协会(Citizens for Responsibility and Ethics)主席，著作有《最后的宫殿：通过五个人物的一生与一栋传奇的住宅看欧洲的一个动荡世纪》

source: Women are losing sleep over this retirement savings fear
reference: 女性正为这种退休金储蓄担忧而失眠

source: Despite the fact that survey participants had a clear idea of how they wanted to be cared for, few people were talking to their family members about it.
reference: 尽管调查团队清楚地明白他们的需求，但很少有人和他们的家人谈论这件事。

source: About half of the individuals in the Nationwide study said they were speaking with their spouses about the cost of long-term care.
reference: 在这项全国性的研究中，约有一半的人表示，他们正在与配偶讨论长期护理的成本。

source: Only 10 percent said they spoke with their kids about it.
reference: 只有10%的人说他们和孩子谈过这件事。

source: "People want a family member to care for them, but they aren't taking the steps to have the conversation," said Holly Snyder, vice president of Nationwide's life insurance business.
reference: 美国全国人寿保险公司的副总裁霍莉·斯奈德（Holly Snyder）说:“人们希望有一个家庭成员来照顾他们，但他们没有与家人进行沟通交流。

source: Here's where to begin.
reference: 你应该这样开始。

source: Talk to your spouse and the kids: You can't prepare your family to provide care if you don't make your wishes known well ahead of time.
reference: 与你的配偶和孩子交谈:如果你不提前把你的想法说出来，你的家人就无法照顾你。

source: Work with your advisor and your family to discuss where and how to receive care, as those choices can be a significant factor in determining the cost.
reference: 与你的导师和家人一起讨论在哪里以及如何养老，因为这些选择可能是决定护理成本的一个重要因素。

source: Bring in your financial advisor: Your advisor can also help you come up with a way to pay for those expenses.
reference: 联系你的财务顾问:你的顾问也能帮你想出一个支付这些费用的方法。

source: Your funding choices for long-term care can include a traditional long-term care insurance policy, a hybrid cash-value life insurance policy to help cover these expenses or self-insuring with your own wealth - as long as you have the money.
reference: 你对长期护理的资金可以来自传统的长期护理保险，混合现金价值的人寿保险，这些都可以来帮助支付这些费用，或者用你自己的积蓄支付——只要你有钱。

source: Hammer out your legal documents: Head off legal battles at the pass.
reference: 制定法律文件:在开始时就防止法律纠纷。

source: Get a health-care proxy in place so that you designate a trusted individual to oversee your medical care and ensure that professionals comply with your wishes in case you're unable to communicate.
reference: 准备一个健康保险代理，这样你就可以指定一个值得信赖的人来监管你的医疗保健，并确保专业人士在你无法沟通的情况下保证保险是按照你的意愿运作的。

source: Also, consider a power of attorney for your finances.
reference: 此外，考虑为你的财务状况出具一份委托书。

source: You would select a trusted person to make financial decisions for you and ensure your bills get paid if you're incapacitated.
reference: 你会选择一个值得信赖的人来为你做财务决策，并确保你的账单在你资金不足的前提下也能得到支付。

source: Don't forget the small details: Imagine that your elderly parent has a medical emergency and is on the way to the hospital.
reference: 不要忘记这些细节:想象一下，你年迈的父母需要急诊，正在去医院的路上。

source: Would you be able to answer questions on medications and allergies?
reference: 你能回答关于药物和过敏的问题吗?

source: Spell out those details in a written plan so that you're ready.
reference: 把这些细节写在计划书中，这样就万无一失。

source: "It's not just the financials that are in play, but who are the doctors?" asked Martin.
reference: 马丁（Martin）问道:“不仅仅是费用问题，还有谁是医生?

source: "What are the medications?
reference: 需要哪些药物?

source: Who will care for the dog?
reference: 谁来照顾宠物?

source: Have that plan in place."
reference: 都计划好了么?”

source: Man shot multiple times with air rifle in Ilfracombe
reference: 在伊尔弗勒科姆，一名男子用气枪开了好几枪

source: A man has been shot multiple times with an air rifle as he walked home from a night out.
reference: 一名男子在夜间外出回家时被气枪击中多次。

source: The victim, in his 40s, was in the Oxford Grove area of Ilfracombe, Devon, when he was shot in the chest, abdomen and hand.
reference: 受害者40多岁，胸部、腹部和手部中弹，当时他正在德文郡伊尔弗勒科姆的牛津格罗夫地区。

source: Officers described the shooting, which took place at about 02:30 BST, as a "random act."
reference: 警方称这起发生在英国02：30左右的枪击事件是“随机行为”。

source: The victim did not see his attacker.
reference: 受害者没有看到袭击他的人。

source: His injuries are not life-threatening and police have appealed for witnesses.
reference: 他目前没有生命危险，警方已经在寻找目击证人。

source: Earthquakes and tsunamis in Indonesia
reference: 地震和海啸袭击印度尼西亚

source: At least 384 people have been killed by a powerful earthquake and tsunami that hit the Indonesian city of Palu on Friday, officials said, with the death toll expected to rise.
reference: 印尼官员称，周五发生的强震和海啸已造成至少384人死亡，死亡人数预计还会上升。

source: With communications knocked out, relief officials have not been able to get any information from Donggala regency, an area north of Palu that is closer to the epicenter of the 7.5 magnitude quake.
reference: 由于通讯中断，救援官员无法从东加拉获得任何信息。东加拉位于巴鲁以北，距离7.5级地震的震中更近。

source: In Palu, more than 16,000 people were evacuated after the disaster struck.
reference: 在巴鲁，超过16,000人在灾难发生后被疏散。

source: Here are some key facts about Palu and Donggala, on the island of Sulawesi:
reference: 以下是关于苏拉威西岛巴鲁地区和东加拉地区的一些关键信息:

source: Palu is the capital of Central Sulawesi province, located at the end of a narrow bay on the west coast of Sulawesi island, with an estimated population of 379,800 in 2017.
reference: 巴鲁是苏拉威西省中部的首府，位于苏拉威西岛西海岸一个狭窄海湾的尽头，截至2017年，人口估计为379,800。

source: The city was celebrating its 40th anniversary when the quake and tsunami hit.
reference: 地震和海啸发生时，这座城市正在庆祝40周年纪念日。

source: Donggala is a regency stretching along more than 300 km (180 miles) of coastline in the northwest of Sulawesi island.
reference: 东加拉是苏拉威西岛西北部300多公里(180英里)海岸线上的一个行政区。

source: The regency, an administrative region below a province, had an estimated population of 299,200 in 2017.
reference: 据估计，截至2017年，该区人口为299,200人。

source: Fishing and farming are the mainstays of the Central Sulawesi province's economy, especially the coastal region of Donggala.
reference: 渔业和农业是苏拉威西省中部经济的支柱，特别是东加拉沿海地区。

source: Nickel mining is also important in the province, but is mostly concentrated in Morowali, on the opposite coast of Sulawesi.
reference: 镍矿开采在该省也很重要，但主要集中在苏拉威西岛对面海岸的莫罗瓦利。

source: Palu and Donggala have been hit by tsunamis several times in the past 100 years, according to Indonesia's Disaster Mitigation Agency.
reference: 据印尼减灾机构称，在过去100年里，巴鲁岛和东加拉岛曾多次遭受海啸袭击。

source: In 1938, a tsunami killed more than 200 people and destroyed hundreds of houses in Donggala.
reference: 1938年，一场海啸夺去了东加拉200多人的生命，摧毁了数百座房屋。

source: A tsunami also struck western Donggala in 1996, killing nine.
reference: 1996年，一场海啸袭击了东加拉西部，造成9人死亡。

source: Indonesia sits on the seismically Pacific Ring of Fire and is regularly hit by earthquakes.
reference: 印度尼西亚位于太平洋地震带的火环上，经常受到地震的袭击。

source: Here are some of the major quakes and tsunamis in recent years:
reference: 以下是近年来的一些主要地震和海啸:

source: 2004: A major quake on the western coast of Indonesia's Aceh province in northern Sumatra on Dec. 26 triggered a tsunami that struck 14 countries, killing 226,000 people along Indian Ocean coastline, more than half of them in Aceh.
reference: 2004:12月26日，印度尼西亚苏门答腊岛北部亚齐省西海岸发生大地震，引发海啸袭击了14个国家，造成印度洋沿岸226,000人死亡，其中一半以上在亚齐省。

source: 2005: A series of strong quakes hit the western coast of Sumatra in late March and early April.
reference: 2005:3月底和4月初，苏门答腊西海岸发生了一系列强烈地震。

source: Hundreds died in Nias Island, off the coast of Sumatra.
reference: 数百人死于苏门答腊岛附近的尼亚斯岛。

source: 2006: A 6.8 magnitude hit south of Java, Indonesia's most populated island, triggering a tsunami that smashed into the southern coast, killing nearly 700 people.
reference: 2006:印度尼西亚人口最多的岛屿爪哇岛南部发生6.8级地震，引发海啸袭击了南部海岸，造成近700人死亡。

source: 2009: A 7.6 magnitude quake struck near the city of Padang, capital of West Sumatra province.
reference: 2009:西苏门答腊省省会巴东附近发生7.6级地震。

source: More than 1,100 people were killed.
reference: 造成1100多人死亡。

source: 2010: A 7.5 magnitude quake hit one of the Mentawai islands, off Sumatra, triggering up tsunami of up to 10 meters that destroyed dozens of villages and killed around 300 people.
reference: 2010:苏门答腊岛附近的明打威群岛发生7.5级地震，引发高达10米的海啸，摧毁了数十座村庄，造成约300人死亡。

source: 2016: A shallow quake hit the Pidie Jaya regency in Aceh, causing destruction and panic as people were reminded by the devastation of the deadly 2004 quake and tsunami.
reference: 2016:亚齐的毕迪贾雅县发生了一场浅层地震，造成了破坏和恐慌，人们想起了2004年那场致命的地震和海啸造成的破坏。

source: No tsunami was triggered this time, but more than 100 were killed by fallen buildings.
reference: 这次地震没有引发海啸，但是有100多人死于倒塌的建筑物。

source: 2018: Major quakes hit Indonesia's tourist island of Lombok, killing more than 500 people, mostly on the northern side of the island.
reference: 2018:印度尼西亚旅游岛屿龙目岛发生大地震，造成500多人死亡，该岛北部损伤最为严重。

source: The quake destroyed thousands of buildings and left thousands of tourists temporarily stranded.
reference: 地震摧毁了数千栋建筑，导致数千名游客暂时滞留。

source: Tory MP says NIGEL FARAGE should be put in charge of Brexit negotiations
reference: 保守党议员表示奈杰尔·法拉奇（Nigel Farage）应该负责英国脱欧谈判

source: Nigel Farage vowed to 'mobilise the people's army' today during a protest at the Tory conference.
reference: 奈杰尔·法拉奇在保守党大会上抗议时发誓要“动员人民军队”。

source: The former Ukip leader said politicians had to 'feel the heat' from Eurosceptics - as one of Theresa May's own MPs suggested he should be in charge of negotiations with the EU.
reference: 这位前英国独立党(Ukip)领袖表示，政客们必须“感受到”来自疑欧派的“压力”——正如特里萨•梅(Theresa May)的议员所建议的，他应该负责与欧盟的谈判。

source: Conservative backbencher Peter Bone told the march in Birmingham that the UK 'would have been out' by now if Mr Farage was Brexit Secretary.
reference: 保守党后座议员彼得•伯恩(Peter Bone)在伯明翰向游行队伍表示，如果法拉奇担任英国退欧大臣，英国早就脱欧了。

source: But the challenge Mrs May faces in reconciling her deeply divided ranks has been underlined by pro-Remain Tories joining a separate protest against Brexit in the city.
reference: 但支持留欧的保守党人加入了伦敦金融城反对英国退欧的另一场抗议活动，加剧了梅在调和其内部分歧面临的挑战。

source: The premier is struggling to keep her Chequers compromise plan on track amid attacks from Brexiteers, Remainers and the EU.
reference: 在英国退欧派、留欧派和欧盟的斗争中，英国首相正努力让自己的契克斯妥协计划走上正轨。

source: Allies insisted she will push ahead with trying to strike a deal with Brussels despite the backlash - and force Eurosceptics and Labour to choose between her package and 'chaos'.
reference: 她的盟友坚称，尽管遭到强烈反对，但她将努力推动与欧盟达成脱欧协议，并迫使疑欧派和工党在她的协议和“混乱”之间做出选择。

source: Mr Bone told the Leave Means Leave rally in Solihull that he wanted to 'chuck Chequers'.
reference: 波恩先生告诉索利赫尔的“退欧”意味着“退欧”集会，他想放弃“契克斯”计划。

source: He suggested Mr Farage should have been made a peer and given responsibility for negotiations with Brussels.
reference: 他表示，法拉奇本应被视为同僚，并被赋予与布鲁塞尔政府谈判的责任。

source: 'If he had been in charge, we would have been out by now,' he said.
reference: 他表示，如果他当时负责脱欧，我们现在就已经成功了。

source: The Wellingborough MP added: 'I will stand up for Brexit but we need to chuck Chequers.'
reference: 这位韦林堡议员补充道:“我会支持英国脱欧，但我们需要放弃“契克斯”计划”

source: Setting out his opposition to the EU, he said: 'We didn't fight world wars to be subservient.
reference: 他在阐述自己对欧盟的反对时，表示：“我们参加世界大战不是为了臣服于别人。

source: We want to make our own laws in our own country.'
reference: 我们希望在自己的国家制定自己的法律。”

source: Mr Bone dismissed suggestions that public opinion had changed since the 2016 vote: 'The idea that the British people have changed their minds and want to remain is completely untrue.'
reference: 博恩驳斥了自2016年大选以来的社会公众舆论:“英国人民改变了主意，希望继续留在欧盟的想法是完全错误的。”

source: Tory Brexiteer Andrea Jenkyns was also at the march, telling reporters: 'I am simply saying: Prime Minister, listen to the people.
reference: 保守党退欧派议员安德里亚詹金斯（Andrea Jenkyns）也参加了游行，她对记者说:“我只是想让首相请听从民意。

source: 'Chequers is unpopular with the general public, the Opposition's not going to vote for it, it's unpopular with our party and our activists who actually pound the streets and get us elected in the first place.
reference: “契克斯”计划不受公众欢迎，反对派不会投票支持它，它不受我们党和活动人士的欢迎，这些人实际上上街游行，并且让我们当选。

source: Please drop Chequers and start listening.'
reference: 请放弃“契克斯”计划，开始听从民意。”

source: In a pointed message to Mrs May, she added: 'Prime ministers keep their jobs when they keep their promises.'
reference: 在给特雷莎·梅的一封措辞尖锐的邮件中，她补充道:“ 首相只有信守承诺才能继续服务人民。”

source: Mr Farage told the rally politicians must be made to 'feel the heat' if they were about to betray the decision made in the 2016 referendum.
reference: 法拉奇告诉政客们，如果他们要违背2016年公投的决定，就必须让他们“感受到压力”。

source: 'This is now about a matter of trust between us - the people - and our political class,' he said.
reference: 他表示：“现在的问题是我们、人民和政治阶层三者之间的信任问题。

source: 'They are trying to betray Brexit and we are here today to tell them 'we won't let you get away with doing that'.'
reference: 他们试图反对英国脱欧，我们今天在这里告诉他们是不会得逞的。”

source: In a message to the enthusiastic crowd he added: 'I want you to make our political class, who are on the verge of betraying Brexit, feel the heat.
reference: 在给热情民众的信息中，他补充道:“我希望你们能让那些反对英国退欧的政治阶层感受到压力。

source: 'We are mobilising the people's army of this country that gave us victory in Brexit and will never rest until we have become an independent, self-governing, proud United Kingdom.'
reference: 我们正在动员这个国家的人民军队，他们给了我们脱欧的胜利，在我们成为一个独立、自治、自豪的英国之前，他们将永不停歇。”

source: Meanwhile, Remainers marched through Birmingham before holding a two-hour rally in the city centre.
reference: 与此同时，留欧派在伯明翰游行，然后在市中心举行了两个小时的集会。

source: A smattering of activists waved Tories Against Brexit banners after the launch of the group this weekend.
reference: 上周末，该活动发起后，少数活动人士挥舞着保守党的旗帜，反对英国退欧。

source: Labour peer Lord Adonis mocked the Conservatives for the security issues they suffered with a party app as the conference opened.
reference: 工党同僚阿多尼斯勋爵(Lord Adonis)嘲笑保守党在会议开幕时使用一款政党应用程序所遭遇的安全问题。

source: 'These are the people who tell us they can have the IT systems in place and all of the technology for Canada plus plus, for the frictionless border, for free trade without borders in Ireland,' he added.
reference: 他还说：“这些人告诉我们，他们可以把信息技术系统安装到位，把所有的技术都用于加拿大，用于无障碍边境，用于爱尔兰的自由贸易。

source: 'It is a complete farce.
reference: 这完全是一场闹剧。

source: There isn't such a thing as a good Brexit,' he added.
reference: 没有一个好的脱欧方案。”。

source: Warren plans to take a 'hard look' at running for president
reference: 沃伦打算认真考虑是否参与总统竞选

source: U.S. Sen. Elizabeth Warren says she'll take a "hard look at running for president" after the November elections.
reference: 美国参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦(Elizabeth Warren)表示，在11月的大选后，她将“认真考虑竞选总统”。

source: The Boston Globe reports the Massachusetts Democrat spoke about her future during a town hall in western Massachusetts Saturday.
reference: 据《波士顿环球报》报道，这位马萨诸塞州民主党人星期六在马萨诸塞州西部的一个市政厅谈到了她未来的计划。

source: Warren, a frequent critic of President Donald Trump, is running for re-election in November against GOP state Rep. Geoff Diehl, who was co-chairman of Trump's 2016 Massachusetts campaign.
reference: 沃伦经常批评唐纳德·特朗普总统，他将在11月竞选连任，对手是共和党州众议员杰夫·迪尔(Geoff Diehl)，迪尔曾是特朗普2016年马萨诸塞州竞选团队的联合主席。

source: She has been at the center of speculation that she might take on Trump in 2020.
reference: 外界一直猜测，她可能在2020年与特朗普竞争。

source: Saturday afternoon's event in Holyoke was her 36th meeting with constituents using the town hall format since Trump took office.
reference: 周六下午在霍约克举行的活动是她自特朗普上任以来第36次在市政厅与选民见面。

source: An attendee asked her if she planned to run for president.
reference: 一位与会者问她：是否打算竞选总统。

source: Warren replied that it's time "for women to go to Washington to fix our broken government, and that includes a woman at the top."
reference: 沃伦回答说，现在是“让女性到华盛顿来为我们支离破碎的政府做贡献的时候了，其中包括一位女性高层。”

source: Russian Grand Prix: Lewis Hamilton closes in on world title after team orders hand him win over Sebastian Vettel
reference: 俄罗斯大奖赛:在刘易斯·汉密尔顿战胜塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔后，他即将获得世界冠军

source: It became clear from the moment that Valtteri Bottas qualified ahead of Lewis Hamilton on Saturday that Mercedes" team orders would play a large part in the race.
reference: 从周六博尔塔斯超过汉密尔顿获得参赛资格的那一刻起，就很明显，梅赛德斯车队的订单将在比赛中发挥重要作用。

source: From pole, Bottas got a good start and almost hung Hamilton out to dry as he defended his position in the first two turns and invited Vettel to attack his teammate.
reference: 博塔斯在杆位上有一个良好的开局，在前两个弯中，他几乎把汉密尔顿挡在了场边，并邀请维特尔攻击他的队友。

source: Vettel went into the pits first and left Hamilton to run into the traffic at the tail of the pack, something which should have been decisive.
reference: 维特尔先进入维修站，让汉密尔顿跑到车队的最后面，这本该是决定好了的。

source: The Mercedes pitted a lap later and came out behind Vettel, but Hamilton went ahead after some wheel-to-wheel action that saw the Ferrari driver reluctantly leave the inside free at risk of holding out after a double-move to defend on the third corner.
reference: 一圈后，梅赛德斯进站了，落后于维特尔，但汉密尔顿在一些轮对轮的动作后继续前进，看到法拉利车手在第三个弯道双移防守后，不情愿地离开了内线，冒着被阻挡的风险。

source: Max Verstappen started from the back row of the grid and was in seventh by the end of the first lap on his 21st birthday.
reference: 马克斯·维斯塔潘从发车区的后排开始，在他21岁生日的第一圈结束时，他获得了第七名。

source: He then led for a large part of the race as he held onto his tyres to target a quick finish and overtake Kimi Raikkonen for fourth.
reference: 随后，他在比赛的大部分时间里都处于领先地位，他紧紧抓住自己的轮胎，锁定了一个快速的终点，超越了第四名的基米·莱科宁(Kimi Raikkonen)。

source: He eventually came into the pits on the 44th lap but was unable to increase his pace in the remaining eight laps as Raikkonen took fourth.
reference: 他最终在第44圈进入维修站，但在剩下的8圈他无法加快速度，莱科宁获得第四名。

source: It's a difficult day because Valtteri did a fantastic job all weekend and was a real gentleman told let me by.
reference: 这是艰难的一天，因为博尔塔斯整个周末都做得很好，他是一位真正的绅士。

source: The team have done such an exceptional job to have a one two," said Hamilton.
reference: 汉密尔顿表示，车队做了如此出色的工作，才得到这么好的成绩。

source: That Was Really Bad Body Language
reference: 那真是糟糕的肢体语言

source: President Donald Trump mocked Senator Dianne Feinstein at a rally on Saturday over her insistence she did not leak the letter from Christine Blasey Ford accusing Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh of sexual assault.
reference: 上周六，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)在一次集会上嘲笑参议员黛安娜·范斯坦(Dianne Feinstein)，因为她坚称自己没有泄露克里斯汀·布莱西·福特(Christine Blasey Ford)指控最高法院(Supreme Court)提名人布雷特·卡瓦诺(Brett Kavanaugh)性侵犯的信件。

source: Speaking at a rally in West Virginia, the president did not directly address the testimony given by Ford before the Senate Judiciary Committee, instead commenting that what was going on in the Senate showed that people were "mean and nasty and untruthful."
reference: 总统在西维吉尼亚州的一次集会上发表讲话时，并没有直接提到福特在参议院司法委员会面前的证词，而是评论说，参议院发生的事情表明，人们的“卑鄙、肮脏、不诚实”。

source: "The one thing that could happen and the beautiful thing that is going on over the last few days in the Senate, when you see the anger, when you see people that are angry and mean and nasty and untruthful," he said.
reference: 他表示:“过去几天在参议院发生的一件可能发生的事情，也是一件美好的事情，当你看到怒火，看到愤怒、卑鄙、肮脏和不诚实的人。”

source: "When you look at releases and leaks and then they say "oh, I didn't do it.
reference: 当你看到信息的发布和泄露时，他们会说:“哦，这不是我干的。

source: I didn't do it."
reference: 不是我干的。”

source: Remember?
reference: 还记得么？

source: Dianne Feinstein, did you leak?
reference: 黛安·范斯坦，是你泄密了吗?

source: Remember her answer... did you leak the document - "oh, oh, what?
reference: 记得她的回答…你泄露文件了吗?-“啊啊，你在说什么”

source: Oh, no.
reference: 没有啊，没有

source: I didn't leak."
reference: 我没有泄密啊

source: Well, wait one minute.
reference: 稍等一下。

source: Did we leak...No, we didn't leak," he added, in an impression of the senator.
reference: 我们泄漏了？不，我们没有泄露，”他以参议员的口吻补充道。

source: Feinstein was sent the letter detailing the allegations against Kavanaugh by Ford back in July, and it was leaked earlier in September - but Feinstein denied that the leak came from her office.
reference: 今年7月，福特公司向范斯坦发送了这封信，详细描述了对卡瓦诺的指控。今年9月初，这封信被泄露，但范斯坦否认泄露来自她的办公室。

source: "I did not hide Dr. Ford's allegations, I did not leak her story," Feinstein told the committee, The Hill reported.
reference: 国会山报道，范斯坦告诉委员会：“我没有隐瞒福特博士的指控，也没有泄露她的事。”

source: "She asked me to hold it confidential and I kept it confidential as she asked."
reference: “她让我帮她保密，我也按照她的要求，保守了秘密。”

source: But her denial did not appear to sit well with the president, who commented during the Saturday night rally: "I'll tell you what, that was really bad body language.
reference: 但她的否认似乎并没有得到总统的认可，总统在周六晚间的集会上评论道:“我告诉你，那肢体语言真是糟糕。

source: Maybe she didn't, but that's the worst body language I've ever seen."
reference: 也许她真的没有泄密，但这是我见过的最糟糕的肢体语言。”

source: Continuing his defense of the Supreme Court nominee, who has been accused of sexual misconduct by three women, the president suggested that the Democrats were using the allegations for their own ends.
reference: 总统继续为这位最高法院提名人辩护，他被三名女性指控有性骚扰行为。总统表示，民主党人利用这些指控达到了自己的目的。

source: "They are determined to take back power by any means necessary.
reference: 据媒体报道，总统表示：“他们决心用任何必要的手段夺回权力。

source: You see the meanness, the nastiness, they don't care who they hurt, who they have to run over to get power and control," Mediaite reported the president saying.
reference: 你可以看到他们的卑鄙和肮脏，他们不在乎伤害了谁，也不在乎为了获得权力和控制权而损害谁。”

source: Elite League: Dundee Stars 5-3 Belfast Giants
reference: 精英联盟:邓迪队以5-3的比分战胜了贝尔法斯特巨人队

source: Patrick Dwyer hit two goals for the Giants against Dundee
reference: 帕特里克·德怀尔（Patrick Dwyer）在对阵邓迪的比赛中为巨人队夺得两分

source: Dundee Stars atoned for Friday's Elite League loss against Belfast Giants by winning the return match 5-3 in Dundee on Saturday.
reference: 邓迪队在周六的比赛中以5-3的比分战胜了贝尔法斯特巨人队，弥补了周五在精英联赛中的失利。

source: The Giants got an early two-goal lead through strikes from Patrick Dwyer and Francis Beauvillier.
reference: 通过帕特里克·德怀尔和弗朗西斯·波维利耶（Francis Beauvillier）的进球，巨人队早早领先两分。

source: Mike Sullivan and Jordan Cownie brought the home side level before Dwyer restored the Giants' lead.
reference: 在德怀尔恢复了巨人队的领先优势之前，迈克·沙利文和乔丹·考尼发挥主场优势取得领先。

source: Francois Bouchard equalised for Dundee before two Lukas Lundvald Nielsen goals secured their victory.
reference: 弗朗索瓦·布沙尔为邓迪扳平比分，卢卡斯·伦德瓦尔德·尼尔森的两个进球确保了他们的胜利。

source: It was a third Elite League defeat of the season for Adam Keefe's men, who had come from behind to beat Dundee 2-1 in Belfast on Friday night.
reference: 这是亚当·基夫的球队——贝尔法斯特巨人队本赛季第三次在精英联赛中失利，他们之前在周五晚的比赛中2-1击败了邓迪。

source: It was a fourth meeting of the season between the sides, with the Giants winning the previous three matches.
reference: 这是两队本赛季第四次交锋，此前三场比赛都是巨人队获胜。

source: Dwyer's opener came in the fourth minute on 3:35 from a Kendall McFaull assist, with David Rutherford providing the assist as Beauvillier doubled the lead four minutes later.
reference: 德怀尔的首开纪录是在3分35秒，第4分钟，肯德尔·麦克福尔助攻德怀尔破门。4分钟后，波维利耶将比分扩大一倍，大卫·卢瑟福助攻德怀尔破门。

source: In what was a busy opening period, Sullivan brought the home side back into the game on 13:10 before Matt Marquardt became provider for Cownie's equaliser on 15:16.
reference: 在慌乱的开场中，沙利文在13点10分将主队比赛节奏带回来，然后马特·马夸特在15点16分为考尼扳平比分

source: Dwyer made sure the Giants took a lead into the first break when he hit his second goal of the night at the end of the first period.
reference: 德怀尔确保巨人队在第一节休息时取得领先，他在第一节结束时打进了当晚的第二个进球。

source: The home side regrouped and Bouchard once again put them on level terms with a power play goal on 27:37.
reference: 主队重新集结，布沙尔在27分37秒的一记大力射门让他们再次回到了同一水平线上。

source: Cownie and Charles Corcoran combined to help Nielsen give Dundee the lead for the first time in the match late in the second period and he made sure of the win with his team's fifth halfway through the final period.
reference: 考尼和科科伦的配合帮助尼尔森在下半场后半段首次领先，他确保了球队在下半场的第五场比赛中获胜。

source: The Giants, who have now lost four of their last five matches, are at home to Milton Keynes in their next match on Friday.
reference: 巨人队在最近五场比赛中输掉了四场，他们将在周五的下一场比赛中主场迎战米尔顿凯恩斯。

source: Air Traffic Controller Dies To Ensure Hundreds On Plane Can Escape Earthquake
reference: 空中交通管制员牺牲自我，以确保飞机上的数百名乘客能够逃离地震

source: An air traffic controller in Indonesia is being hailed as a hero after he died ensuring that a plane carrying hundreds of people made it safely off the ground.
reference: 这名印度尼西亚的空中交通管制员在确保一架载有数百人的飞机安全起飞后，却被地震夺去了生命，之后人们追思他为英雄。

source: More than 800 people have died and many are missing after a major earthquake hit the island of Sulawesi on Friday, triggering a tsunami.
reference: 周五，苏拉威西岛发生大地震，引发了海啸，造成800多人死亡，并有多人失踪。

source: Strong aftershocks continue to plague the area and many are trapped in debris in the city of Palu.
reference: 强烈的余震继续摧残着该地区，许多人被困在帕鲁市的废墟中。

source: But despite his colleagues fleeing for their lives, 21-year-old Anthonius Gunawan Agung refused to leave his post in the wildly swaying control tower at Mutiara Sis Al Jufri Airport Palu airport.
reference: 但是，尽管他的同事们纷纷逃命，21岁的安东尼奥斯·古纳万阿贡却还坚守在帕鲁穆蒂亚拉机场摇摇欲坠的控制塔里，并且拒绝离开。

source: He stayed put to make sure that the Batik Air Flight 6321, which was on the runway at the time, was able to take off safely.
reference: 他守在原地，确保当时在跑道上的巴蒂克航空 6321航班能够安全起飞。

source: He then jumped off the traffic control tower when he thought it was collapsing.
reference: 然后，他以为交通控制塔正在倒塌，便跳了下去。

source: He died later in hospital.
reference: 之后他在医院去世了。

source: Spokesman for Air Navigation Indonesia, Yohannes Sirait, said the decision may have saved hundreds of lives, Australia's ABC News reported.
reference: 据澳大利亚广播公司报道，印尼航空发言人约翰内斯·西拉伊特表示，这一决定也许挽救了数百人的性命。

source: We prepared a helicopter from Balikpapan in Kalimantan to take him to a bigger hospital in another city.
reference: 我们在加里曼丹的巴厘巴板市准备了一架直升机，将他送往另一座城市的一家更大的医院。

source: Unfortunately we lost him this morning before the helicopter reached Palu.
reference: 不幸的是，今早在直升机到达帕鲁市之前，他就离世了。

source: "Our heart breaks to hear about this," he added.
reference: 他补充道，“听到这个消息，我们真的很悲痛。”

source: Meanwhile, authorities fear that the death toll could reach the thousands with the country's disaster mitigation agency saying that access to the the towns of Donggala, Sigi and Boutong is limited.
reference: 与此同时，国家治灾机构表示，通往东加拉、西吉和布通的道路已中断，所以当局担心死亡人数可能会达到数千人。

source: "The toll is believed to be still increasing since many bodies were still under the wreckage while many have not able to be reached," agency spokesman Sutopo Purwo Nugroho said.
reference: 该机构发言人苏托波说:“死亡人数还会持续增加，因为许多尸体仍被埋在废墟之下，还有许多人也失去了联系。”

source: Waves that reached up to six meters have devastated Palu which will hold a mass burial on Sunday.
reference: 地震引发了高达6米的海浪，摧毁了帕鲁市，周日在帕鲁将举行一场大规模葬礼。

source: Military and commercial aircraft are bringing in aid and supplies.
reference: 军方和商营飞机正在运送救援物资。

source: Risa Kusuma, a 35-year-old mother, told Sky News: "Every minute an ambulance brings in bodies.
reference: 35岁的母亲丽萨·库苏马告诉天空新闻频道:“每分钟都有救护车送来尸体

source: Clean water is scarce.
reference: 干净的水资源非常稀缺。

source: The mini-markets are looted everywhere."
reference: 各地的小超市都被洗劫一空。”

source: Jan Gelfand, head of the International Red Cross in Indonesia, told CNN: "The Indonesian Red Cross is racing to help survivors but we don't know what they'll find there.
reference: 国际红十字会印尼负责人盖尔芬德告诉CNN:“印尼红十字会正在前往灾区帮助幸存者，但我们也不清楚他们在那里会发现什么。

source: This is already a tragedy, but it could get much worse."
reference: 这已经是一场悲剧了，但是它还能变得更糟糕。”

source: Indonesia's President Joko Widodo arrived in Palu on Sunday and told the country's military: "I am asking all of you to work day and night to complete every tasks related to the evacuation.
reference: 印度尼西亚总统佐科·维多多周日抵达帕鲁市，并告诉该国军方:“我要求你们所有人不舍昼夜地工作，完成与疏散工作相关的每一个环节。

source: Are you ready?" CNN reported.
reference: 你们准备好了吗？” CNN报道。

source: Indonesia was hit earlier this year by earthquakes in Lombok in which more than 550 people died.
reference: 今年早些时候，印尼龙目岛发生地震，造成至少550人死亡。

source: Analyst lays out timeline of night woman was burned alive
reference: 分析人士列出了女性夜间工作者被活活烧死的时间表

source: The prosecution rested its case Saturday in the retrial of a man who is accused of burning a Mississippi woman alive in 2014.
reference: 周六，控方停止了对一名男子的重审，该男子被指控在2014年活活烧死密西西比州的一名女子。

source: U.S. Department of Justice Analyst Paul Rowlett testified for hours as an expert witness in the field of intelligence analysis.
reference: 美国司法部分析员保罗·罗莱特，作为情报分析领域的专家证人，对该案件作证了数小时。

source: He outlined for the jury how he used cellphone records to piece together the movements of 29-year-old defendant Quinton Tellis and the 19-year-old victim, Jessica Chambers, on the night she died.
reference: 他向陪审团概述了他如何使用手机上的记录，将29岁被告昆顿·特利斯和19岁受害者杰西卡·钱伯斯在命案发生当晚的行动整合了出来。

source: Rowlett said he received location data from several cellphones that showed Tellis was with Chambers the evening of her death, contradicting his previous claims, The Clarion Ledger reported .
reference: 据号角纪事报报道，罗利特说，他从几部手机上收到的位置数据显示，钱伯斯在去世当晚和特利斯在一起，这与他之前的说法相矛盾。

source: When data showed his cellphone was with Chambers' during the time he said he was with his friend Michael Sanford, police went to talk to Sanford.
reference: 调查数据显示，当晚特利斯的手机就在钱伯斯身边，而他却说他和朋友桑福德在一起，于是警方去找了桑福德谈话。

source: Sanford took the stand Saturday and testified that he wasn't in town that day.
reference: 周六，桑福德出庭作证说，他那天并不在城里。

source: When prosecutors asked if Tellis was telling the truth when he said he was in Sanford's truck that night, Sanford said he was "lying, because my truck was in Nashville."
reference: 特利斯说那晚他在桑福德的卡车里，所以检察官问他特利斯是否说的是实情，桑福德回答说，“他在撒谎，因为我的卡车在纳什维尔。”

source: Another inconsistency was that Tellis said he had known Chambers for about two weeks when she died.
reference: 另一个前后矛盾之处是，特利斯说，直到钱伯斯去世时，他们才认识了大约两周。

source: Cellphone records indicated they'd only known each other for a week.
reference: 而手机记录显示，他们认识才仅仅一个星期。

source: Rowlett said that sometime after Chambers' death, Tellis deleted Chambers' texts, calls and contact information from his phone.
reference: 罗莱特说，钱伯斯死后，特利斯在手机上删掉了钱伯斯的短信、电话和联系方式。

source: "He erased her from his life," Hale said.
reference: 黑尔说：“他把钱伯斯从自己的生活中完全抹去了。”

source: The defense is scheduled to begin its closing arguments Sunday.
reference: 辩方定于周日开始进行结案陈词。

source: The judge said he expected the trial to go to the jury later that day.
reference: 法官说，他预计审判将在当天晚些时候提交陪审团。

source: And Women Need to Wield It.
reference: 女性需要运用它。

source: It is a righteous diatribe, months and years of fury spilling over, and she can't get it out without weeping.
reference: 这是一场正义的谴责，愤怒日复一日年复一年没有消停，她哭泣着，却走不出这个困境。

source: "We cry when we get angry," Ms. Steinem said to me 45 years later.
reference: 45年后，斯泰纳姆对我说：“我们生气的时候就会哭，”

source: "I don't think that's uncommon, do you?"
reference: “我认为这是正常的，你说呢?”

source: She continued, "I was greatly helped by a woman who was an executive someplace, who said she also cried when she got angry, but developed a technique which meant that when she got angry and started to cry, she'd say to the person she was talking to, "You may think I am sad because I am crying.
reference: 她继续说道,“我曾被某个女性总经理帮助过,她说当她生气的时候她也会哭泣,但她却养成了一种习惯，那就是当她生气并开始哭泣的时候,她就会对她正在说话的人倾诉情绪。“你可能会认为因为我哭了，所以我很伤心。

source: I am angry."
reference: 不，那是因为我生气了。”

source: And then she just kept going.
reference: 然后她就继续说着。

source: And I thought that was brilliant."
reference: 我觉得这太棒了。”

source: Tears are permitted as an outlet for wrath in part because they are fundamentally misunderstood.
reference: 之所以认为眼泪是愤怒的宣泄，某种程度来说是因为人们从根本上就误解了眼泪的意义。

source: One of my sharpest memories from an early job, in a male-dominated office, where I once found myself weeping with inexpressible rage, was my being grabbed by the scruff of my neck by an older woman - a chilly manager of whom I'd always been slightly terrified - who dragged me into a stairwell.
reference: 我内心最锋利的记忆之一就是在早期工作的时候,我在一个男性占主导地位的公司上班，有一次我哭了，内心压抑着无法言说的愤怒，那时有一个我一直都比较畏惧的女经理，年长且冷静，她抓住了我的后颈，把我拉进一个楼梯间。

source: "Never let them see you crying," she told me.
reference: 她告诉我：“别让他们看到你在哭泣，”

source: "They don't know you're furious.
reference: “他们不知道你很生气。

source: They think you're sad and will be pleased because they got to you."
reference: 他们认为你很伤心，而且认为最终是他们的关怀让你高兴起来。”

source: Patricia Schroeder, then a Democratic congresswoman from Colorado, had worked with Gary Hart on his presidential runs.
reference: 当时来自科罗拉多州的民主党国会女议员帕特里夏·施罗德曾在加里·哈特竞选总统时与他共事。

source: In 1987, when Mr. Hart was caught in an extramarital affair aboard a boat called Monkey Business and bowed out of the race, Ms. Schroeder, deeply frustrated, figured there was no reason she shouldn't explore the idea of running for president herself.
reference: 1987年，哈特在一艘名为“胡闹”的船上陷入婚外情，随之退出了总统竞选。当时，施罗德深感沮丧，她认为自己没有理由不去竞选总统。

source: "It was not a well-thought-out decision," she said to me with a laugh 30 years later.
reference: 而30年后，她笑着对我说道：“这不是一个深思熟虑的决定，”

source: "There were already seven other candidates in the race, and the last thing they needed was another one.
reference: “当时已经有七位候选人参加竞选，他们最不想的就是再来一位候选人。

source: Somebody called it "Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.""
reference: 有人称之为“白雪公主和七个小矮人”。

source: Because it was late in the campaign, she was behind on fund-raising, and so she vowed that she wouldn't enter the race unless she raised $2 million.
reference: 由于竞选已经进入后期，她在筹款方面不及他人，所以她发誓，除非筹集到200万美元，否则她就不会参加竞选。

source: It was a losing battle.
reference: 这是一场必败之仗。

source: She discovered that some of her supporters who gave $1,000 to men would give her only $250.
reference: 她发现，她有一些支持者给男性候选人捐1000美元，却只给她捐250美元。

source: "Do they think I get a discount?" she wondered.
reference: 她想知道，“他们认为我是个赔钱货吗?”

source: When she made her speech announcing that she would not launch a formal campaign, she was so overcome by emotions - gratitude for the people who'd supported her, frustration with the system that made it so difficult to raise money and to target voters rather than delegates, and anger at the sexism - that she got choked up.
reference: 后来她演讲宣布她不会参与正式的竞选，她抑制不住自己的情绪，感谢了支持她的人，表达了对选举体系的不满，她很难筹集到资金，也很难找到目标选民，而不是找到一些代表，同时也对使她一度感到凝噎的性别歧视表达了愤怒。

source: "You would have thought I'd had a nervous breakdown," recalled Ms. Schroeder about how the press reacted to her.
reference: 施罗德回想起媒体是如何描述她的的，她说：“你也许会以为我精神崩溃了，”

source: "You'd have thought Kleenex was my corporate sponsor.
reference: “你也许会以为舒洁是我的企业赞助商。

source: I remember thinking, what are they going to put on my tombstone?
reference: 我记得我在想，他们要在我的墓碑上刻什么呢?

source: "She cried"?""
reference: 要刻上“她哭了吗”?”

source: How the US-China trade war may be good for Beijing
reference: 中美贸易战对中国有什么好处

source: The opening salvos of the trade war between the US and China were deafening, and while the battle is far from over, a rift between the countries may be beneficial to Beijing in the long term, experts say.
reference: 专家们表示，打响中美贸易战的第一枪震耳欲聋，尽管贸易战尚未结束，但从长期来看，两国之间的裂痕可能对中国有利。

source: Donald Trump, the US President, fired the first warning earlier this year by taxing key Chinese exports including solar panels, steel and aluminium.
reference: 今年早些时候，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普率先发出警告，将对中国的主要出口产品进行征税，包括太阳能电池板，钢铁和铝。

source: The most significant escalation rolled in this week with new tariffs affecting $200 billion (£150 billion) worth of items, effectively taxing half of all goods coming into the US from China.
reference: 本周关税上涨得最厉害，新关税影响了价值2000亿美元(1500亿英镑)的商品，这实际上是对所有从中国出口到美国的商品征收了一半的关税。

source: Beijing has retaliated each time in kind, most recently slapping tariffs of five to ten per cent on $60 billion of American goods.
reference: 中方每次都以同样的方式回敬，最近一次则是对价值600亿美元的美国商品征收5%到10%的关税。

source: China has pledged to match the US shot-for-shot, and the world's second largest economy is unlikely to blink anytime soon.
reference: 中国已承诺要逐渐赶上美国，而这个世界第二大经济体在短期内不太会有所退缩。

source: Getting Washington to back down means caving into demands, but publicly bowing to the US would be far too embarrassing for Xi Jinping, China's president.
reference: 让美国做出让步意味着要满足他们的需求，但对于中国国家主席习近平来说，公开向美国低头则又太过尴尬。

source: Still, experts say if Beijing can play its cards right, US trade war pressures could positively support China over the long term by lowering the inter-dependence of the two economies.
reference: 尽管如此，专家们表示，如果中方策略得当，那么美方的贸易战压力可能会通过降低两国经济的相互依赖性，从而在长期内对中国的经济发展起到积极的帮衬作用。

source: "The fact that a quick political decision in either Washington or Beijing could create the conditions that start an economic tailspin in either country is actually a lot more dangerous than onlookers have acknowledged before," said Abigail Grace, a research associate who focuses on Asia at the Center for New American Security, a think tank.
reference: 阿比盖尔格蕾丝就职于新美国安全中心，也叫美国智库，她是这里的一名研究助理，主要研究对象是亚洲，她说：“无论是中方还是美方，一个快速的政治决策可以都可以在两国造成经济混乱，这实际上比旁观者之前看到的更加危险。”
